There is no obligatory right upon Him by virtue of the servants' deeds; rather, it is He who made the right obligatory upon Himself, out of generosity and bounty from Him. Allah does not let the reward of those who act for Him be lost when they do their deeds well and make them sincerely for Allah the Exalted.
When His servant carries out His commands and complies with obedience to Him, He helps him in that, praises him, commends him, and repays him with light, faith and expansiveness in his heart, strength and vigour in his body, increased blessing and growth in all his states, and increased success in his deeds.
Then after that he comes to the deferred reward with his Lord, complete and abundant, not diminished by these things. Part of His appreciation of His servant is that whoever leaves something for the sake of Allah, Allah compensates him with something better than it; whoever draws near to Him by a hand-span, He draws near to him by a cubit; whoever draws near to Him by a cubit, He draws near to him by an arm's length; whoever comes to Him walking, He comes to him running; and whoever deals with Him profits many times over ".

lesson.ar: أَنْ يَتْرُكَ الْعَبْدُ مَا يَكْرَهُهُ اللَّهُ وَاثِقاً أَنَّ اللَّهَ يُعَوِّضُهُ خَيْراً مِنْهُ، وَأَنْ يَتَقَرَّبَ إِلَيْهِ بِالطَّاعَاتِ، فَمَنْ عَامَلَ رَبَّهُ رَبِحَ عَلَيْهِ أَضْعَافاً مُضَاعَفَةً.
lesson.en: Leave what Allah dislikes, trusting that He will replace it with something better, and draw near to Him with acts of obedience, for whoever deals with his Lord gains many times over.

evidence.text: إِنْ تُقْرِضُوا اللَّهَ قَرْضاً حَسَناً يُضَاعِفْهُ لَكُمْ وَيَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ وَاللَّهُ شَكُورٌ حَلِيمٌ

summary.ar: قَالَ رَحِمَهُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى: "الشَّهِيدُ أَيْ: الْمُطَّلِعُ عَلَى جَمِيعِ الْأَشْيَاءِ سَمِعَ جَمِيعَ الْأَصْوَاتِ خَفِيَّهَا، وَجَلِيَّهَا وَأَبْصَرَ جَمِيعَ الْمَوْجُودَاتِ دَقِيقَهَا، وَجَلِيلَهَا صَغِيرَهَا، وَكَبِيرَهَا، وَأَحَاطَ عِلْمُهُ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ الَّذِي شَهِدَ لِعِبَادِهِ، وَعَلَى عِبَادِهِ بِمَا عَمِلُوهُ".
summary.en: He (may Allah have mercy on him) said: "Ash-Shahid (the Witness), meaning: the One who is aware of all things; who hears all voices, the hidden and the manifest of them; who sees all existing things, the minute and the immense of them, the small and the great of them; whose knowledge encompasses everything; who bears witness for His servants, and against His servants, to what they have done".

lesson.ar: أَنْ يَتَعَبَّدَ الْعَبْدُ لِلَّهِ بِاسْمِهِ الشَّهِيدِ بِمُرَاقَبَتِهِ، فَيَسْتَحْضِرَ أَنَّ اللَّهَ شَاهِدٌ عَلَى حَرَكَاتِهِ الظَّاهِرَةِ وَالْبَاطِنَةِ، فَيَعْبُدَهُ كَأَنَّهُ يَرَاهُ، فَإِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ يَرَاهُ فَإِنَّهُ يَرَاهُ.
lesson.en: Worship Allah by His name Ash-Shahid through constant awareness of Him: remember that He witnesses all your outward and inward movements, so worship Him as though you see Him, and though you do not see Him, He certainly sees you.

evidence.text: وَاللَّهُ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ شَهِيدٌ

note.ar: سبق زيادة إيضاح لهذا الاسم مع اسم الله الرقيب.
note.en: This name has already been explained further together with Allah's name Ar-Raqib (the Watchful).

summary.ar:
قَالَ رَحِمَهُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى:
"الصَّبُورُ مَأْخُوذٌ مِنْ قَوْلِهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِي الْحَدِيثِ الصَّحِيحِ: "لَا أَحَدَ أَصْبَرُ عَلَى أَذًى سَمِعَهُ مِنَ اللَّهِ، يَجْعَلُونَ لَهُ الْوَلَدَ وَهُوَ يُعَافِيهِمْ وَيَرْزُقُهُمْ".
وَبِمَا ثَبَتَ أَيْضاً فِي الصَّحِيحِ قَالَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى: "كَذَّبَنِي ابْنُ آدَمَ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ ذَلِكَ وَشَتَمَنِي ابْنُ آدَمَ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ ذَلِكَ، فَأَمَّا تَكْذِيبُهُ إِيَّايَ فَقَوْلُهُ: لَنْ يُعِيدَنِي كَمَا بَدَأَنِي، وَلَيْسَ أَوَّلُ الْخَلْقِ بِأَهْوَنَ عَلَيَّ مِنْ إِعَادَتِهِ، وَأَمَّا شَتْمُهُ أِيَّايَ فَقَوْلُهُ: إِنَّ لِي وَلَداً وَأَنَا الْوَاحِدُ الْأَحَدُ الْفَرْدُ الصَّمَدُ الَّذِي لَمْ يَلِدْ، وَلَمْ يُولَدْ، وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ كُفُواً أَحَدٌ" وَاللَّهُ تَعَالَى يُدِرُّ عَلَى عِبَادِهِ الْأَرْزَاقَ الْمُطِيعِ مِنْهُمْ، وَالْعَاصِي، وَالْعُصَاةُ لَا يَزَالُونَ فِي مُحَارَبَتِهِ، وَتَكْذِيبِهِ، وَتَكْذِيبِ رُسُلِهِ، وَالسَّعْيِ فِي اِطْفَاءِ دِينِهِ، وَاللَّهُ تَعَالَى حَلِيمٌ صَبُورٌ عَلَى مَا يَقُولُونَ، وَمَا يَفْعَلُونَ، يَتَتَابَعُونَ فِي الشُّرُورِ وَهُوَ يُتَابِعُ عَلَيْهِمُ النِّعَمَ، وَصَبْرُهُ أَكْمَلُ صَبْرٍ، لِأَنَّهُ عَنْ كَمَالِ قُدْرَهْ وَكَمَالِ غِنًى عَنِ الْخَلْقِ وَكَمَالِ رَحْمَهْ وَإِحْسَانٍ، فَتَبَارَكَ الرَّبُّ الرَّحِيمُ الَّذِي لَيْسَ كَمِثْلِهِ شَيْءٌ الصَّبُورُ الَّذِي يُحِبُّ الصَّابِرِينَ وَيُعِينُهُمْ فِي كُلِّ أَمْرِهِمْ".
summary.en:
He (may Allah have mercy on him) said:
"As-Sabur (the Most Patient) is taken from the saying of [the Prophet] ﷺ in the authentic hadith: "No one is more patient with harm he hears than Allah: they ascribe a son to Him, yet He grants them well-being and provides for them".
And from what is also established in the Sahih: Allah the Exalted said: "The son of Adam denied Me, and he had no right to do so; and the son of Adam insulted Me, and he had no right to do so. As for his denying Me, it is his saying: He will not bring me back as He originated me — and the first creation is not easier for Me than bringing him back. As for his insulting Me, it is his saying: I have a son — while I am the One, the Unique, the Single, the Self-Sufficient Master, who does not beget, nor was He begotten, and there is none equivalent to Him". Allah the Exalted pours out provisions upon His servants, the obedient among them and the disobedient, while the disobedient continue to wage war against Him, to deny Him, to deny His messengers and to strive to extinguish His religion; and Allah the Exalted is Forbearing, Patient with what they say and what they do. They follow one evil with another, while He follows one favour upon them with another. His patience is the most perfect patience, because it stems from perfect power, perfect independence of the creation, and perfect mercy and kindness. So blessed is the Most Merciful Lord, like unto whom there is nothing, the Most Patient, who loves the patient and helps them in all their affairs".

lesson.ar: أَنْ يَتَحَلَّى الْعَبْدُ بِالصَّبْرِ، فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ الصَّبُورَ يُحِبُّ الصَّابِرِينَ وَيُعِينُهُمْ فِي كُلِّ أَمْرِهِمْ، وَأَلَّا يَغْتَرَّ بِإِمْهَالِ اللَّهِ لَهُ مَعَ تَتَابُعِ نِعَمِهِ عَلَيْهِ.
lesson.en: Adorn yourself with patience, for Allah, the Most Patient, loves those who are patient and helps them in all their affairs, and do not be deceived when He delays punishment while His blessings keep coming to you.

note.ar: وصف الله عز وجل بالصبر ثابت كما في حديث أبي موسى وسيأتي في الشرح. أما اسم الصبور، فلم أقف على نص يدل على ثبوت هذا الاسم لله تعالى، والله أعلم.
note.en: Describing Allah, Mighty and Majestic, with patience is established, as in the hadith of Abu Musa, which will come in the explanation. As for the name As-Sabur, I have not found a text establishing this name for Allah the Exalted. And Allah knows best.

name: الصَّمَدُ
meaning: The Perfect Master, Sought by All

summary.ar:
قَالَ رَحِمَهُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى: "الصَّمَدُ: أَيِ الرَّبُّ الْكَامِلُ وَالسَّيِّدُ، الْعَظِيمُ، الَّذِي لَمْ يُبْقِ صِفَةَ كَمَالٍ إِلَّا اتَّصَفَ بِهَا، وَوُصِفَ بِغَايَتِهَا، وَكَمَالِهَا بِحَيْثُ لَا تُحِيطُ الْخَلَائِقُ بِبَعْضِ تِلْكَ الصِّفَاتِ بِقُلُوبِهِمْ، وَلَا تُعَبِّرُ عَنْهَا أَلْسِنَتُهُمْ وَهُوَ الْمَصْمُودُ إِلَيْهِ، الْمَقْصُودُ فِي جَمِيعِ الْحَوَائِجِ وَالنَّوَائِبِ ﴿يَسْأَلُهُ مَنْ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالأرْضِ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ هُوَ فِي شَأْنٍ﴾.
فَهُوَ الْغَنِيُّ بِذَاتِهِ، وَجَمِيعُ الْكَائِنَاتِ فَقِيرَةٌ إِلَيْهِ بِذَاتِهِمْ: فِي إِيجَادِهِمْ، وَأِعْدَادِهِمْ، وَإِمْدَادِهِمْ بِكُلِّ مَا هُمْ مُحْتَاجُونَ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ جَمِيعِ الْوُجُوهِ لَيْسَ لِأَحَدٍ مِنْهَا غِنًى مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ، فِي كُلِّ حَالَةٍ مِنْ أَحْوَالِهَا.
وَالصَّمَدُ: هُوَ الَّذِي تَقْصِدُهُ الْخَلَائِقُ كُلُّهَا فِي جَمِيعِ حَاجَاتِهَا وَأَحْوَالِهَا وَضَرُورَاتِهَا لِمَا لَهُ مِنَ الْكَمَالِ الْمُطْلَقِ فِي ذَاتِهِ وَصِفَاتِهِ، وَأَسْمَائِهِ وَأَفْعَالِهِ.
وَالصَّمَدُ الْمُغْنِي الْجَامِعُ الَّذِي يَدْخُلُ فِيهِ كُلُّ مَافُسِّرَ بِهِ هَذَا الِاسْمُ الْكَرِيمُ، فَهُوَ الصَّمَدُ الَّذِي تَصْمُدُ إِلَيْهِ أَيْ: تَقْصِدُهُ جَمِيعُ الْمَخْلُوقَاتِ بِالذُّلِّ وَالْحَاجَةِ وَالِافْتِقَارِ.
وَيَفْزَعُ إِلَيْهِ الْعَالَمُ بِأَسْرِهِ، وَهُوَ الَّذِي قَدْ كَمُلَ بِعِلْمِهِ وَحِكْمَتِهِ وَحِلْمِهِ، وَقُدْرَتِهِ، وَعَظَمَتِهِ وَرَحْمَتِهِ وَسَائِرِ أَوْصَافِهِ".
summary.en:
He (may Allah have mercy on him) said: "As-Samad (the Self-Sufficient Master, sought by all): meaning the perfect Lord, and the Master, the Great, who has left no attribute of perfection except that He is described by it, and described by its utmost extent and its perfection, such that the creatures cannot encompass some of those attributes with their hearts, nor can their tongues express them. He is the One to whom recourse is made, the One sought in all needs and calamities: ﴾Whoever is within the heavens and earth asks Him; every day He is bringing about a matter﴿.
He is the One who is free of need by His very Self, while all beings are in need of Him by their very selves: in their being brought into existence, in their being prepared, and in their being supplied with everything they need in every respect. None of them has independence even to the weight of an atom, in any of its states.
As-Samad is the One whom all creatures seek in all their needs, their states and their necessities, because of the absolute perfection He has in His Self, His attributes, His names and His actions.
As-Samad has a comprehensive meaning, into which enters everything by which this noble name has been explained. He is As-Samad to whom all created things turn, that is: whom they seek, with humility, need and dependence.
The whole world resorts to Him in distress, and He is the One who is perfect in His knowledge, His wisdom, His forbearance, His power, His greatness, His mercy and all His attributes".

lesson.ar: أَنْ يَقْصِدَ الْعَبْدُ رَبَّهُ وَحْدَهُ فِي جَمِيعِ حَوَائِجِهِ وَنَوَائِبِهِ بِالذُّلِّ وَالِافْتِقَارِ، مُسْتَغْنِياً بِهِ عَمَّنْ سِوَاهُ.
lesson.en: Turn to your Lord alone in all your needs and hardships, with humility and a sense of need, and let Him suffice you instead of anyone else.

evidence.text: قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ

summary.ar:
قَالَ رَحِمَهُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى: "مِنْ أَسْمَائِهِ الْحُسْنَى مَا يُؤْتَي بِهِ مُفْرَداً وَيُؤْتَى بِهِ مَقْرُوناً مَعَ غَيْرِهِ وَهُوَ أَكْثَرُ الْأَسْمَاءِ الْحُسْنَى، فَيَدُلُّ ذَلِكَ عَلَى أَنَّ لِلَّهِ كَمَالاً مِنْ إِفْرَادِ كُلٍّ مِنَ الِاسْمَيْنِ فَأَكْثَرَ وَكَمَالً مِنَ اجْتِمَاعِهِمَا أَوِ اجْتِمَاعِهَا.
وَمِنْ أَسْمَائِهِ مَالَا يُؤْتَى بِهِ إِلَّا مَعَ مُقَابَلَةِ الِاسْمِ الْآخَرِ لِأَنَّ الْكَمَالَ الْحَقِيقِيَّ تَمَامُهُ وَكَمَالُهُ مِنَ اجْتِمَاعِهِمَا، وَذَلِكَ مِثْلُ هَذِهِ الْأَسْمَاءِ وَهِيَ مُتَعَلِّقَةٌ بِأَفْعَالِهِ الصَّادِرَةِ عَنْ إِرَادَتِهِ النَّافِذَةِ وَقُدْرَتِهِ الْكَامِلَةِ وَحِكْمَتِهِ الشَّامِلَةِ فَهُوَ تَعَالَى النَّافِعُ لِمَنْ شَاءَ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ بِالْمَنَافِعِ الدِّينِيَّةِ وَالدُّنْيَوِيَّةِ، الضَّارُّ لِمَنْ فَعَلَ الْأَسْبَابَ الَّتِي تُوجِبُ ذَلِكَ، وَكُلُّ هَذَا تَبَعٌ لِحِكْمَتِهِ وَسُنَنِهِ الْكَوْنِيَّةِ وَلِلْأَسْبَابِ الَّتِي جَعَلَهَا مُوصِلَةً إِلَى مُسَبَّبَاتِهَا، فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ تَعَالَى جَعَلَ مَقَاصِدَ لِلْخَلْقِ وَأُمُوراً مَحْبُوبَةً فِي الدِّينِ، وَالدُّنْيَا، وَجَعَلَ لَهَا أَسْبَاباً، وَطُرُقاً، وَأَمَرَ بِسُلُوكِهَا وَيَسَّرَهَا لِعِبَادِهِ غَايَةَ التَّيْسِيرِ، فَمَنْ سَلَكَهَا أَوْصَلَتْهُ إِلَى الْمَقْصُودِ النَّافِعِ، وَمَنْ تَرَكَهَا أَوْ تَرَكَ بَعْضَهَا أَوْ فَوَّتَ كَمَالَهَا أَوْ أَتَاهَا عَلَى وَجْهٍ نَاقِصٍ فَفَاتَهُ الْكَمَالُ الْمَطْلُوبُ فَلَا يَلُومَنَّ إِلَّا نَفْسَهُ وَلَيْسَ لَهُ حُجَّةٌ عَلَى اللَّهِ، فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ أَعْطَاهُ السَّمْعَ، وَالْبَصَرَ، وَالْفُؤَادَ، وَالْقُوَّةَ، وَالْقُدْرَةَ، وَهَذَهُ النَّجْدَيْنِ وَبَيَّنَ لَهُ الْأَسْبَابَ، وَالْمُسَبَّبَاتِ وَلَمْ يَمْنَعْهُ طَرِيقاً يُوصِلُ إِلَى خَيْرٍ دِينِيٍّ، وَلَا دُنْيَوِيٍّ، فَتَخَلُّفُهُ عَنْ هَذِهِ الْأُمُورِ يُوجِبُ أَنْ يَكُونَ هُوَ الْمَلُومَ عَلَيْهَا الْمَذْمُومَ عَلَى تَرْكِهَا.
summary.en:
He (may Allah have mercy on him) said: "Among His beautiful names are those that are mentioned singly and also mentioned paired with another — and this is the case with most of the beautiful names. This indicates that Allah has a perfection from each of the two names (or more) singly, and a perfection from their combination.
And among His names are those that are only mentioned together with the opposite name, because true perfection is completed and perfected by their combination. That is like these names. They are connected to His actions, which issue from His effective will, His perfect power and His all-embracing wisdom. He, the Exalted, is An-Nafi' (the One who benefits), who benefits whom He wills of His servants with religious and worldly benefits, and Ad-Darr (the One who harms), who harms whoever does the causes that necessitate that. All of this follows His wisdom, His laws in the universe, and the causes He has made lead to their effects. For Allah the Exalted has made goals for the creation and matters loved in religion and worldly life, and has made for them causes and paths, commanded [them] to take them, and made them easy for His servants with the utmost ease. Whoever takes them, they bring him to the beneficial goal; and whoever abandons them, or abandons some of them, or misses their completeness, or comes to them in a deficient way, and so misses the desired perfection, let him blame no one but himself, and he has no argument against Allah. For Allah gave him hearing, sight, a heart, strength and ability, guided him to the two ways, made clear to him the causes and their effects, and did not bar him from any path leading to religious or worldly good. So his falling short in these matters necessitates that he is the one to be blamed for them and censured for abandoning them.

lesson.ar: أَنْ يَسْلُكَ الْعَبْدُ الْأَسْبَابَ الَّتِي جَعَلَهَا اللَّهُ مُوصِلَةً إِلَى الْمَنَافِعِ الدِّينِيَّةِ وَالدُّنْيَوِيَّةِ، وَيَجْتَنِبَ أَسْبَابَ الضَّرَرِ، وَلَا يَحْتَجَّ عَلَى اللَّهِ بِتَفْرِيطِهِ، فَإِنَّ الْمَلُومَ هُوَ الْمُفَرِّطُ.
lesson.en: Follow the causes Allah has made to lead to benefit in religion and worldly life, avoid the causes of harm, and never blame Allah for your own negligence, for the one to blame is the one who fell short.

note.ar: لم أقف على دليل صحيح يدل على اسمية هذين الاسمين لله تعالى، والله أعلم.
note.en: I have not found authentic evidence that these two are names of Allah the Exalted. And Allah knows best.

summary.ar:
قَالَ رَحِمَهُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى: "فَسَّرَهَا النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ تَفْسِيرًا كَامِلًا وَاضِحًا فَقَالَ: "أَنْتَ الْأَوَّلُ فَلَيْسَ قَبْلَكَ شَيْءٌ، وَأَنْتَ الْآخِرُ فَلَيْسَ بَعْدَكَ شَيْءٌ، وَأَنْتَ الظَّاهِرُ فَلَيْسَ فَوْقَكَ شَيْءٌ، وَأَنْتَ الْبَاطِنُ فَلَيْسَ دُونَكَ شَيْءٌ" إِلَى آخِرِ الْحَدِيثِ.
فَفَسَّرَ كُلَّ اسْمٍ بِكُلِّ مَعْنَاهُ، وَنَفَى عَنْهُ كُلَّ مَا يُضَادُّهُ وَيُنَافِيهِ فَمَهْمَا قَدَّرَ الْمُقَدِّرُونَ وَفَرَضَ الْفَارِضُونَ مِنَ الْأَوْقَاتِ السَّابِقَةِ الْمُتَسَلْسِلَةِ إِلَى غَيْرِ نِهَايَةٍ فَاللَّهُ قَبْلَ ذَلِكَ، وَكُلُّ وَقْتٍ لَاحِقٍ مَهْمَا قُدِّرَ وَفُرِضَ اللَّهُ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ.
وَلِهَذَا لَا يَسْتَحِقُّ اسْمَ وَاجِبِ الْوُجُودِ إِلَّا هُوَ، فَمِنْ خَصَائِصِهِ أَنَّهُ لَا يَكُونُ إِلَّا مَوْجُودًا كَامِلًا فَلَا يُشَارِكُهُ فِي وُجُوبِ الْوُجُودِ أَحَدٌ فَوُجُوبُ وُجُودِهِ بِنُعُوتِهِ الْكَامِلَةِ فِي جَمِيعِ الْأَوْقَاتِ، وَهُوَ الَّذِي أَوْجَدَ الْأَوْقَاتَ وَجَمِيعَ الْمَوْجُودَاتِ، وَكُلُّهَا مُسْتَنِدَةٌ فِي وُجُودِهَا وَبَقَائِهَا إِلَى اللَّهِ.
فَالْأَوَّلُ: يَدُلُّ عَلَى أَنَّ كُلَّ مَا سِوَاهُ حَادِثٌ كَائِنٌ بَعْدَ أَنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ، وَيُوجِبُ لِلْعَبْدِ أَنْ يَلْحَظَ فَضْلَ رَبِّهِ فِي كُلِّ نِعْمَةٍ دِينِيَّةٍ أَوْ دُنْيَوِيَّةٍ، إِذِ السَّبَبُ وَالْمُسَبَّبُ مِنْهُ تَعَالَى.
وَالْآخِرُ: يَدُلُّ عَلَى أَنَّهُ هُوَ الْغَايَةُ، وَالصَّمَدُ الَّذِي تَصْمُدُ إِلَيْهِ الْمَخْلُوقَاتُ بِتَأَهُّلِهَا، وَرَغْبَتِهَا، وَرَهْبَتِهَا، وَجَمِيعِ مَطَالِبِهَا.
وَالظَّاهِرُ: يَدُلُّ عَلَى عَظَمَةِ صِفَاتِهِ، وَاضْمِحْلَالِ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ عِنْدَ عَظَمَتِهِ مِنْ ذَوَاتٍ وَصِفَاتٍ وَعَلَى عُلُوِّهِ.
وَالْبَاطِنُ: يَدُلُّ عَلَى اطِّلَاعِهِ عَلَى السَّرَائِرِ، وَالضَّمَائِرِ، وَالْخَبَايَا، وَالْخَفَايَا، وَدَقَائِقِ الْأَشْيَاءِ، كَمَا يَدُلُّ عَلَى كَمَالِ قُرْبِهِ وَدُنُوِّهِ، وَلَا يَتَنَافَى الظَّاهِرُ، وَالْبَاطِنُ لِأَنَّ اللَّهَ لَيْسَ كَمِثْلِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي كُلِّ النُّعُوتِ فَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ فِي دُنُوِّهِ الْقَرِيبُ فِي عُلُوِّهِ.
summary.en:
He (may Allah have mercy on him) said: "The Prophet ﷺ explained them with a complete and clear explanation, saying: "You are the First, so there is nothing before You; and You are the Last, so there is nothing after You; and You are the Manifest, so there is nothing above You; and You are the Hidden, so there is nothing beneath You" to the end of the hadith.
So he explained each name with its full meaning, and negated from Him everything that contradicts and opposes it. So however many earlier times, following one another without end, those who estimate may estimate and those who suppose may suppose, Allah is before that; and every later time, however it is estimated and supposed, Allah is after that.
For this reason, no one deserves the name of the Necessarily Existent except Him. Among His exclusive characteristics is that He cannot be except existent and perfect, so no one shares with Him in necessary existence. His necessary existence, with His perfect attributes, is at all times; and He is the One who brought the times and all existing things into existence, and all of them depend upon Allah for their existence and continuance.
So Al-Awwal (the First) indicates that everything other than Him is originated, coming into being after it had not been; and it requires the servant to notice the favour of his Lord in every religious or worldly blessing, since the cause and its effect are [both] from Him, the Exalted.
And Al-Akhir (the Last) indicates that He is the final goal, and As-Samad (the Self-Sufficient Master) to whom created beings turn with their devotion, their desire, their fear and all their needs.
And Az-Zahir (the Manifest) indicates the greatness of His attributes, and the vanishing of everything, of beings and attributes, before His greatness, and [it indicates] His highness.
And Al-Batin (the Hidden) indicates His awareness of secrets, hidden thoughts, concealed matters, hidden things and the finest details of things, just as it indicates the perfection of His nearness and closeness. And Az-Zahir and Al-Batin do not contradict each other, because there is nothing like Allah in any of His descriptions; so He is the Most High in His closeness, the Near in His highness.

lesson.ar: أَنْ يُعَظِّمَ الْعَبْدُ رَبَّهُ وَيُؤْمِنَ بِعُلُوِّهِ فَوْقَ جَمِيعِ خَلْقِهِ، وَيَسْتَصْغِرَ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ عِنْدَ عَظَمَتِهِ، فَلَا يَتَعَلَّقُ قَلْبُهُ إِلَّا بِهِ.
lesson.en: Glorify your Lord and believe that He is above all His creation; see everything as small before His greatness, so that your heart attaches itself to Him alone.

evidence.text: هُوَ الأَوَّلُ وَالآخِرُ وَالظَّاهِرُ وَالْبَاطِنُ

note.ar: سبق الكلام على هذا الاسم مع اسمه تعالى "الأول".
note.en: This name has already been discussed together with His name "Al-Awwal" (the First).

summary.ar:
قَالَ رَحِمَهُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى: "وَمِنْ أَسْمَائِهِ الْحَكَمُ الْعَدْلُ الَّذِي يَحْكُمُ بَيْنَ عِبَادِهِ فِي الدُّنْيَا، وَالْآخِرَةِ بِعَدْلِهِ، وَقِسْطِهِ فَلَايَظْلِمُ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ، وَلَا يُحَمِّلُ أَحَدًا وِزْرَ أَحَدٍ، وَلَا يُجَازِي الْعَبْدَ بِأَكْثَرَ مِنْ ذَنْبِهِ، وَيُؤَدِّي الْحُقُوقَ إِلَى أَهْلِهَا، فَلَا يَدَعُ صَاحِبَ حَقٍّ إِلَّا وَصَلَ إِلَيْهِ حَقُّهُ.
وَهُوَ الْعَدْلُ فِي تَدْبِيرِهِ، وَتَقْدِيرِهِ ﴿إِنَّ رَبِّي عَلَى صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ﴾.
وَالْحَكَمُ الْعَدْلُ الَّذِي إِلَيْهِ الْحُكْمُ فِي كُلِّ شَيْءٍ فَيَحْكُمُ تَعَالَى بِشَرْعِهِ، وَيُبَيِّنُ لِعِبَادِهِ جَمِيعَ الطُّرُقِ الَّتِي يُحْكَمُ بِهَا بَيْنَ الْمُتَخَاصِمِينَ، وَيُفْصَلُ بَيْنَ الْمُتَنَازِعِينَ، مِنَ الطُّرُقِ الْعَادِلَةِ الْحَكِيمَةِ، وَيَحْكُمُ بَيْنَ النَّاسِ فِيمَا اخْتَلَفُوا فِيهِ وَيَحْكُمُ فِيهَا بِأَحْكَامِ الْقَضَاءِ، وَالْقَدَرِ، فَيُجْرِي عَلَيْهِمْ مِنْهَا مَا تَقْتَضِيهِ حِكْمَتُهُ وَيَضَعُ الْأَشْيَاءَ مَوَاضِعَهَا وَيُنْزِلُهَا مَنَازِلَهَا، وَيَقْضِي بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَ الْجَزَاءِ، وَالْحِسَابِ، فَيَقْضِي بَيْنَهُمْ بِالْحَقِّ، وَيَحْمَدُهُ الْخَلَائِقُ عَلَى حُكْمِهِ حَتَّى مَنْ قَضَى عَلَيْهِمْ بِالْعَذَابِ يَعْتَرِفُونَ لَهُ بِالْعَدْلِ، وَأَنَّهُ لَمْ يَظْلِمْهُمْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ".
summary.en:
He (may Allah have mercy on him) said: "And among His names are Al-Hakam (the Judge) and Al-'Adl (the Just), who judges between His servants in this world and the Hereafter with His justice and His equity. So He does not wrong [anyone] by an atom's weight, nor does He make anyone bear the burden of another, nor does He recompense the servant with more than his sin; and He delivers rights to those entitled to them, so He does not leave anyone with a right except that his right reaches him.
He is just in His management and His decree: ﴾Indeed, my Lord is on a path [that is] straight﴿.
And Al-Hakam Al-'Adl is the One to whom judgement belongs in everything. So He, the Exalted, judges by His Law, and makes clear to His servants all the ways by which judgement is made between disputants and a decision is made between those who contend, of just and wise ways. He judges between people in that in which they differed, and He judges in [these matters] with the rulings of predestination and decree, so He carries out upon them of these what His wisdom requires, and He puts things in their places and assigns them their positions. And He will judge between them on the Day of Recompense and Reckoning, judging between them with the truth, and the creatures will praise Him for His judgement; even those against whom He decrees punishment will acknowledge His justice, and that He did not wrong them by an atom's weight".

lesson.ar: أَنْ يُوقِنَ الْعَبْدُ بِأَنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَظْلِمُ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ، فَيُؤَدِّيَ الْحُقُوقَ إِلَى أَهْلِهَا وَيَحْذَرَ الظُّلْمَ، عَالِماً أَنَّ كُلَّ صَاحِبِ حَقٍّ سَيَصِلُ إِلَيْهِ حَقُّهُ.
lesson.en: Be certain that Allah does not wrong anyone by even a speck's weight, so give every right to its owner and beware of injustice, knowing that everyone who is owed a right will receive it.

note.ar:
سبق الكلام عن هذا الاسم مع اسمه تعالى "الحكم".
لم أقف على دليل صحيح يدل على إسميته لله تعالى والله أعلم.
note.en:
This name has already been discussed together with His name "Al-Hakam" (the Judge).
I have not found authentic evidence that it is a name of Allah the Exalted. And Allah knows best.

summary.ar:
قَالَ رَحِمَهُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى: "هَذِهِ الْأَسْمَاءُ الْعَظِيمَةُ مَعَانِيهَا مُتَقَارِبَةٌ فَهُوَ تَعَالَى كَامِلُ الْقُوَّةِ عَظِيمُ الْقُدْرَةِ شَامِلُ الْعِزَّةِ ﴿إِنَّ الْعِزَّةَ لِلَّهِ جَمِيعاً﴾.
الْعَزِيزُ الَّذِي لَهُ الْعِزَّةُ كُلُّهَا عِزَّةُ الْقُوَّةِ، وَعِزَّةُ الْغَلَبَةِ وَعِزَّةُ الِامْتِنَاعِ، فَمُمْتَنِعٌ أَنْ يَنَالَهُ أَحَدٌ مِنَ الْمَخْلُوقَاتِ وَقَهَرَ جَمِيعَ الْمَوْجُودَاتِ، وَدَانَتْ لَهُ الْخَلِيقَةُ وَخَضَعَتْ لِعَظَمَتِهِ.
فَمَعَانِي الْعِزَّةِ الثَّلَاثُ كُلُّهَا كَامِلَةٌ لِلَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ عِزَّةُ الْقُوَّةِ الدَّالُّ عَلَيْهَا مِنْ أَسْمَائِهِ الْقَوِيُّ الْمَتِينُ، وَهِيَ وَصْفُهُ الْعَظِيمُ الَّذِي لَا تُنْسَبُ إِلَيْهِ قُوَّةُ الْمَخْلُوقَاتِ وَإِنْ عَظُمَتْ، وَعِزَّةُ الِامْتِنَاعِ فَإِنَّهُ هُوَ الْغَنِيُّ بِذَاتِهِ فَلَا يَحْتَاجُ إِلَى أَحَدٍ، وَلَا يَبْلُغُ الْعِبَادُ ضَرَّةْ فَيَضُرُّونَهُ، وَلَا نَفْعَهُ فَيَنْفَعُونَهُ بَلْ هُوَ الضَّارُّ النَّافِعُ الْمُعْطِي الْمَانِعُ، وَعِزَّةُ الْقَهْرِ وَالْغَلَبَةِ لِكُلِّ الْكَائِنَاتِ فَهِيَ كُلُّهَا مَقْصُورَةٌ لِلَّهِ خَاضِعَةٌ لِعَظَمَتِهِ مُنْقَادَةٌ لِإِرَادَتِهِ، فَجَمِيعُ نَوَاصِي الْمَخْلُوقَاتِ بِيَدِهِ، لَا يَتَحَرَّكُ مِنْهَا مُتَحَرِّكٌ وَلَا يَتَصَرَّفُ مُتَصَرِّفٌ إِلَّا بِحَوْلِهِ وَقُوَّتِهِ وَإِذْنِهِ، فَمَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ كَانَ، وَمَا لَمْ يَشَأْ لَمْ يَكُنْ، وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِهِ، فَمِنْ قُوَّتِهِ وَاقْتِدَارِهِ أَنَّهُ خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ، وَالْأَرْضَ، وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِي سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ، وَأَنَّهُ خَلَقَ الْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ يُمِيتُهُمْثُمَّ يُحْيِيهِمْ ثُمَّ إِلَيْهِ يُرْجَعُونَ ﴿مَا خَلْقُكُمْ وَلا بَعْثُكُمْ إلا كَنَفْسٍ وَاحِدَةٍ﴾. ﴿وَهُوَ الَّذِي يَبْدأُ الْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُ وَهُوَ أَهْوَنُ عَلَيْه﴾ وَمِنْ آثَارِ قُدْرَتِهِ أَنَّكَ تَرَى الْأَرْضَ هَامِدَةً، فَإِذَا أَنْزَلَ عَلَيْهَا الْمَاءَ اعْتَزَّتْ وَرَبَتْ وَأَنْبَتَتْ مِنْ كُلِّ زَوْجٍ بَهِيجٍ، وَمِنْ آثَارِ قُدْرَتِهِ مَا أَوْقَعَهُ بِالْأُمَمِ الْمُكَذِّبِينَ، وَالْكُفَّارِ الظَّالِمِينَ مِنْ أَنْوَاعِ الْعُقُوبَاتِ وَحُلُولِ الْمَثُلَاتِ، وَأَنَّهُ لَمْ يُغْنِ عَنْهُمْ كَيْدُهُمْ، وَمَكْرُهُمْ، وَلَا أَمْوَالُهُمْ، وَلَا جُنُودُهُمْ، وَلَا حُصُونُهُمْ مِنْ عَذَابِ اللَّهِ مِنْ شَيْءٍ لَمَّا جَاءَ أَمْرُ رَبِّكَ، وَمَا زَادُوهُمْ غَيْرَ تَتْبِيبٍ، وَخُصُوصاً فِي هَذِهِ الْأَوْقَاتِ فَإِنَّ هَذِهِ الْقُوَّةَ الْهَائِلَةَ، وَالْمُخْتَرَعَاتِ الْبَاهِرَةَ الَّتِي وَصَلَتْ إِلَيْهَا مَقْدِرَةُ هَذِهِ الْأُمَمِ هِيَ مِنْ أِقْدَارِ اللَّهِ لَهُمْ وَتَعْلِيمِهِ لَهُمْ، مَا لَمْ يَكُونُوا يَعْلَمُونَهُ، فَمِنْ آيَاتِ اللَّهِ أَنَّ قُوَاهُمْ، وَقُدَرَهُمْ وَمُخْتَرَعَاتِهِمْ لَمْ تُغْنِ عَنْهُمْ شَيْئاً فِي صَدِّ مَا أَصَابَهُمْ مِنَ النَّكَبَاتِ، وَالْعُقُوبَاتِ الْمُهْلِكَةِ مَعَ بَذْلِ جِدِّهِمْ وَاجْتِهَادِهِمْ فِي تَوَقِّي ذَلِكَ، وَلَكِنَّ أَمْرَ اللَّهِ غَالِبٌ، وَقُدْرَتُهُ تَنْقَادُ لَهَا عَنَاصِرُ الْعَالَمِ الْعُلْوِيِّ، وَالسُّفْلِيِّ.
وَمِنْ تَمَامِ عِزَّتِهِ وَقُدْرَتِهِ وَشُمُولِهِمَا أَنَّهُ كَمَا أَنَّهُ هُوَ الْخَالِقُ لِلْعِبَادِ فَهُوَ خَالِقُ أَعْمَالِهِمْ وَطَاعَتِهِمْ وَمَعَاصِيهِمْ، وَهِيَ أَيْضاً أَفْعَالُهُمْ، فَهِيَ تُضَافُ إِلَى اللَّهِ خَلْقاً وَتَقْدِيراً وَتُضَافُ إِلَيْهِمْ فِعْلاً وَمُبَاشَرَةً عَلَى الْحَقِيقَةِ وَلَا مُنَافَاةَ بَيْنَ الْأَمْرَيْنِ، فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ خَالِقُ قُدْرَتِهِمْ وَإِرَادَتِهِمْ، وَخَالِقُ السَّبَبِ التَّامِّ خَالِقٌ لِلْمُسَبَّبِ قَالَ تَعَالَى: ﴿وَاللَّهُ خَلَقَكُمْ وَمَا تَعْمَلُونَ﴾.
وَمِنْ آثَارِ قُدْرَتِهِ مَا ذَكَرَهُ فِي كِتَابِهِ مِنْ نُصْرَةِ أَوْلِيَاءِهِ عَلَى قِلَّةِ عَدَدِهِمْ وَعُدَدِهِمْ عَلَى أَعْدَائِهِمُ الَّذِينَ فَاقُوهُمْ بِكَثْرَةِ الْعَدَدِ، وَالْعُدَّةِ، قَالَ تَعَالَى: ﴿كَمْ مِنْ فِئَةٍ قَلِيلَةٍ غَلَبَتْ فِئَةً كَثِيرَةً بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ﴾.
وَمِنْ آثَارِ قُدْرَتِهِ وَرَحْمَتِهِ مَا يُحْدِثُهُ لِأَهْلِ النَّارِ، وَأَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ مِنْ أَنْوَاعِ الْعِقَابِ، وَأَصْنَافِ النَّعِيمِ الْمُسْتَمِرِّ الْكَثِيرِ الْمُتَتَابِعِ الَّذِي لَا يَنْقَطِعُ، وَلَا يَتَنَاهَى".
summary.en:
He (may Allah have mercy on him) said: "These great names have closely related meanings. He, the Exalted, is perfect in strength, great in power, all-encompassing in might: ﴾Indeed, might belongs to Allah entirely﴿.
Al-'Aziz (the Almighty) is the One to whom belongs all might: the might of strength, the might of dominance, and the might of being unassailable. So it is impossible for any created being to reach Him; He has subdued all existing things, and the creation has submitted to Him and humbled itself before His greatness.
So the three meanings of might are all perfect for Allah, the Great: the might of strength, which is indicated among His names by Al-Qawi (the Strong) and Al-Matin (the Firm), and it is His great attribute to which the strength of created beings bears no comparison, however great it may be; the might of being unassailable, for He is the One free of need by His very Self, so He needs no one, and the servants cannot attain harming Him so as to harm Him, nor benefiting Him so as to benefit Him — rather He is the One who harms and benefits, who gives and withholds; and the might of subjugation and dominance over all beings, for they are all subjugated to Allah, submissive to His greatness, yielding to His will. The forelocks of all created beings are in His hand; nothing moves among them and nothing acts except by His might, His strength and His permission. Whatever Allah wills happens, and whatever He does not will does not happen, and there is no might nor power except by Him. Part of His strength and power is that He created the heavens, the earth and what is between them in six days, and that He created the creation, then He causes them to die, then gives them life, then to Him they return: ﴾Your creation and your resurrection will not be but as that of a single soul﴿. ﴾And it is He who begins creation; then He repeats it, and that is [even] easier for Him﴿ Among the effects of His power is that you see the earth barren, and when He sends down rain upon it, it quivers and swells and grows [something] of every beautiful kind. Among the effects of His power is what He inflicted upon the nations who denied and the wrongdoing disbelievers of various punishments and exemplary chastisements, and that neither their scheming, nor their plotting, nor their wealth, nor their soldiers, nor their fortresses availed them anything against the punishment of Allah when the command of your Lord came, and they did not increase them other than ruin. This is especially so in these times: this tremendous strength and these dazzling inventions which the capability of these nations has reached are from Allah's enabling them and His teaching them what they did not know. And among the signs of Allah is that their strengths, their capabilities and their inventions did not avail them anything in warding off the disasters and destructive punishments that befell them, despite their exerting their utmost effort and striving to guard against that. But the command of Allah prevails, and the elements of the upper and lower worlds submit to His power.
Part of the completeness and all-inclusiveness of His might and power is that, just as He is the Creator of the servants, He is the Creator of their deeds, their acts of obedience and their acts of disobedience — and they are also their [own] actions. So they are ascribed to Allah in terms of creation and decree, and ascribed to them in terms of doing and carrying out, in reality, and there is no contradiction between the two matters. For Allah is the Creator of their ability and their will, and the Creator of the complete cause is the Creator of the effect. The Exalted said: ﴾While Allah created you and that which you do﴿.
Among the effects of His power is what He mentioned in His Book of His giving victory to His allies, despite their small number and scant equipment, over their enemies who surpassed them in great numbers and equipment. The Exalted said: ﴾How many a small company has overcome a large company by permission of Allah﴿.
Among the effects of His power and His mercy is what He brings about for the people of the Fire and the people of Paradise: kinds of punishment, and varieties of bliss that is lasting, abundant and continuous, that is neither cut off nor comes to an end".

lesson.ar: أَنْ يَطْلُبَ الْعَبْدُ الْعِزَّةَ وَالْقُوَّةَ مِنَ اللَّهِ وَحْدَهُ، وَيُكْثِرَ مِنْ قَوْلِ: لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ، وَلَا يَغْتَرَّ بِقُوَّةِ الْمَخْلُوقِينَ وَإِنْ عَظُمَتْ، فَإِنَّ أَمْرَ اللَّهِ غَالِبٌ.
lesson.en: Seek might and strength from Allah alone, say often «La hawla wa la quwwata illa billah» (there is no power and no strength except by Allah), and never be deceived by the strength of any creature, however great, for Allah's command always prevails.

evidence.text: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ الْقَوِيُّ الْعَزِيزُ

summary.ar:
قَالَ رَحِمَهُ اللَّهُ: "الْعَظِيمُ الْجَامِعُ فَجَمِيعُ صِفَاتِ الْعَظَمَةِ وَالْكِبْرِيَاءِ وَالْمَجْدِ وَالْبَهَاءِ الَّذِي تُحِبُّهُ الْقُلُوبُ، وَتُعَظِّمُهُ الْأَرْوَاحُ، وَيَعْرِفُ الْعَارِفُونَ أَنَّ عَظَمَةَ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ، وَإِنْ جَلَّتْ فِي الصِّفَةِ، فَإِنَّهَا مُضْمَحِلَّةٌ فِي جَانِبِ عَظَمَةِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيمِ.
وَاللَّهُ تَعَالَى عَظِيمٌ لَهُ كُلُّ وَصْفٍ وَمَعْنًى يُوجِبُ التَّعْظِيمَ فَلَا يَقْدِرُ مَخْلُقٌ أَنْ يُثْنِيَ عَلَيْهِ كَمَا يَنْبَغِي لَهُ وَلَا يُحْصِى ثَنَاءً عَلَيْهِ، بَلْ هُوَ كَمَا أَثْنَى عَلَى نَفْسِهِ وَفَوْقَ مَا يَتَثَنَّى عَلَيْهِ عِبَادُهُ.
وَاعْلَمْ أَنَّ مَعَانِيَ التَّعْظِيمِ الثَّابِتَةَ لِلَّهِ وَحْدَهُ نَوْعَانِ:
أَحَدُهُمَا: أَنَّهُ مَوْصُوفٌ بِكُلِّ صِفَةِ كَمَالٍ، وَلَهُ مِنْ ذَلِكَ الْكَمَالِ أَكْمَلُهُ، وَأَعْظَمُهُ وَأَوْسَعُهُ، فَلَهُ الْعِلْمُ الْمُحِيطُ، وَالْقُدْرَةُ النَّافِذَةُ، وَالْكِبْرِيَاءُ، وَالْعَظَمَةُ، وَمِنْ عَظَمَتِهِ أَنَّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ فِي كَفِّ الرَّحْمَنِ أَصْغَرُ مِنَ الْخَرْدَلَةِ كَمَا قَالَ ذَلِكَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ وَغَيْرُهُ وَقَالَ تَعَالَى ﴿وَمَا قَدَرُوا اللَّهَ حَقَّ قَدْرِهِ وَالأرْضُ جَمِيعاً قَبْضَتُهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَالسَّمَاوَاتُ مَطْوِيَّاتٌ بِيَمِينِهِ﴾.
وَقَالَ: ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُمْسِكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالأرْضَ أَنْ تَزُولا وَلَئِنْ زَالَتَا إِنْ أَمْسَكَهُمَا مِنْ أَحَدٍ مِنْ بَعْدِهِ﴾.
وَقَالَ تَعَالَى وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ: ﴿تَكَادُ السَّمَاوَاتُ يَتَفَطَّرْنَ مِنْ فَوْقِهِنَّ﴾ الْآيَةَ.
وَفِي الصَّحِيحِ عَنْهُ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: "إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَقُولُ الْكِبْرِيَاءُ رِدَائِي وَالْعَظَمَةُ إِزَارِي، فَمَنْ نَازَعَنِي وَاحِداً مِنْهُمَا عَذَّبْتُهُ" فَلِلَّهِ تَعَالَى الْكِبْرِيَاءُ وَالْعَظَمَةُ، وَالْوَصْفَانِ اللَّذَانِ لَا يُقْدَرُ قَدْرُهُمَا وَلَا يُبْلَغُ كُنْهُهُمَا.
النَّوْعُ الثَّانِي: مِنْ مَعَانِي عَظَمَتِهِ تَعَالَى أَنَّهُ لَا يَسْتَحِقُّ أَحَدٌ مِنَ الْخَلْقِ أَنْ يُعَظَّمَ كَمَا يُعَظَّمُ اللَّهُ فَيَسْتَحِقُّ جَلَّ جَلَالُهُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ أَنْ يُعَظِّمُوهُ بِقُلُوبِهِمْ، وَأَلْسِنَتِهِمْ، وَجَوَارِحِهِمْ وَذَلِكَ بِبَذْلِ الْجُهْدِ فِي مَعْرِفَتِهِ، وَمَحَبَّتِهِ، وَالذُّلِّ لَهُ، وَالْإِنْكِسَارِ لَهُ، وَالْخُضُوعِ لِكِبْرِيَائِهِ، وَالْخَوْفِ مِنْهُ وَإِعْمَالِ اللِّسَانِ بِالثَّنَاءِ عَلَيْهِ، وَقِيَامِ الْجَوَارِحِ بِشُكْرِهِ وَعُبُودِيَّتِهِ، وَمِنْ تَعْظِيمِهِ أَنْ يُتَّقَى حَقَّ تُقَاتِهِ فَيُطَاعَ فَلَا يُعْصَى، وَيُذْكَرَ فَلَا يُنْسَى، وَيُشْكَرَ فَلَا يُكْفَرُ، وَمِنْ تَعْظِيمِهِ تَعْظِيمُ مَا حَرَّمَهُ وَشَرَعَهُ مِنْ زَمَانٍ وَمَكَانٍ وَأَعْمَالٍ ﴿ذَلِكَ وَمَنْ يُعَظِّمْ شَعَائِرَ اللَّهِ فَإِنَّهَا مِنْ تَقْوَى الْقُلُوبِ﴾ وَ ﴿ذَلِكَ وَمَنْ يُعَظِّمْ حُرُمَاتِ اللَّهِ فَهُوَ خَيْرٌ لَهُ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِ﴾ وَمِنْ تَعْظِيمِهِ أَنْ لَايُعْتَرَضَ عَلَى شَيْءٍ مِمَّا خَلَقَهُ أَوْ شَرَعَهُ.
summary.en:
He (may Allah have mercy on him) said: "Al-'Azim (the Magnificent) is the One who combines all the attributes of greatness, grandeur, glory and splendour, whom hearts love and souls revere. Those who know [Him] know that the greatness of everything, however majestic in description, fades away beside the greatness of the Most High, the Magnificent.
Allah the Exalted is Magnificent; to Him belongs every description and meaning that necessitates magnification. No created being is able to praise Him as is due to Him, nor can praise of Him be enumerated; rather, He is as He has praised Himself, and above what His servants praise Him with.
Know that the meanings of magnification established for Allah alone are of two kinds:
The first: that He is described with every attribute of perfection, and He has the most perfect, greatest and most vast of that perfection. To Him belong all-encompassing knowledge, effective power, grandeur and greatness. Part of His greatness is that the heavens and the earth in the palm of Ar-Rahman (the Most Merciful) are smaller than a mustard seed, as Ibn 'Abbas and others said. And the Exalted said: ﴾They have not appraised Allah with true appraisal, while the earth entirely will be [within] His grip on the Day of Resurrection, and the heavens will be folded in His right hand﴿.
And He said: ﴾Indeed, Allah holds the heavens and the earth, lest they cease. And if they should cease, no one could hold them [in place] after Him﴿.
And the Exalted — and He is the Most High, the Magnificent — said: ﴾The heavens almost break apart from above them﴿ — the verse.
In the Sahih, from him ﷺ: "Allah says: Grandeur is My cloak and greatness is My lower garment; whoever contends with Me for either of them, I will punish him". So to Allah the Exalted belong grandeur and greatness, the two attributes whose measure cannot be estimated and whose essence cannot be reached.
The second kind of the meanings of His greatness (the Exalted): that none of the creation deserves to be magnified as Allah is magnified. He, glorified be His majesty, deserves from His servants that they magnify Him with their hearts, their tongues and their limbs. That is by exerting effort in knowing Him, loving Him, humbling oneself before Him, being broken before Him, submitting to His grandeur and fearing Him; by employing the tongue in praising Him; and by the limbs carrying out gratitude to Him and servitude to Him. Part of magnifying Him is that He is feared as He deserves to be feared: so He is obeyed and not disobeyed, remembered and not forgotten, thanked and not met with ingratitude. Part of magnifying Him is magnifying what He has made sacred and legislated, of times, places and deeds: ﴾That [is so]. And whoever honours the symbols of Allah — indeed, it is from the piety of hearts﴿ and ﴾That [has been commanded], and whoever honours the sacred ordinances of Allah — it is best for him in the sight of his Lord﴿. And part of magnifying Him is not objecting to anything He has created or legislated.

lesson.ar: أَنْ يُعَظِّمَهُ الْعَبْدُ بِبَذْلِ الْجُهْدِ فِي مَعْرِفَتِهِ وَمَحَبَّتِهِ وَالذُّلِّ لَهُ وَالْخَوْفِ مِنْهُ، فَيُطَاعَ فَلَا يُعْصَى، وَيُذْكَرَ فَلَا يُنْسَى، وَيُشْكَرَ فَلَا يُكْفَرُ، وَيُعَظِّمَ مَا حَرَّمَهُ وَشَرَعَهُ، وَلَا يَعْتَرِضَ عَلَى شَيْءٍ مِمَّا خَلَقَهُ أَوْ شَرَعَهُ.
lesson.en: Glorify Him by striving to know and love Him, humbling yourself before Him and fearing Him: obey Him and do not disobey, remember Him and do not forget, thank Him and do not be ungrateful, honour what He has made sacred, and never object to anything He has created or legislated.

evidence.text: وَلا يَؤُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ

summary.ar:
قَالَ رَحِمَهُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى: "الْعَفُوُّ الْغَفُورُ الْغَفَّارُ: الَّذِي لَمْ يَزَلْ، وَلَا يَزَالُ بِالْعَفْوِ مَعْرُوفاً، وَبِالْغُفْرَانِ، وَالصَّفْحِ عَنْ عِبَادِهِ مَوْصُوفاً.
كُلُّ أَحَدٍ مُضْطَرٌّ إِلَى عَفْوِهِ، وَمَغْفِرَتِهِ كَمَا هُوَ مُضْطَرٌّ إِلَى رَحْمَتِهِ، وَكَرَمِهِ وَقَدْ وَعَدَ بِالْمَغْفِرَةِ، وَالْعَفْوِ لِمَنْ أَتَى بِأَسْبَابِهَا قَالَ تَعَالَى: ﴿وَإِنِّي لَغَفَّارٌ لِمَنْ تَابَ وَآمَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَالِحاً ثُمَّ اهْتَدَى﴾.
summary.en:
He (may Allah have mercy on him) said: "Al-'Afuww (the Pardoning), Al-Ghafur (the Forgiving), Al-Ghaffar (the Oft-Forgiving): the One who has always been, and will always be, known for pardon, and described by forgiveness and overlooking [the faults] of His servants.
Everyone is in dire need of His pardon and His forgiveness, just as they are in dire need of His mercy and His generosity. He has promised forgiveness and pardon to whoever brings about their causes. The Exalted said: ﴾But indeed, I am the Perpetual Forgiver of whoever repents and believes and does righteousness and then continues in guidance﴿.

lesson.ar: أَنْ يُلِحَّ الْعَبْدُ عَلَى رَبِّهِ فِي طَلَبِ الْعَفْوِ لِشِدَّةِ اضْطِرَارِهِ إِلَيْهِ، وَيَسْعَى فِي أَسْبَابِهِ مِنَ التَّوْبَةِ وَالِاسْتِغْفَارِ وَالسَّعْيِ فِي مَرْضَاتِهِ وَالْإِحْسَانِ إِلَى الْخَلْقِ وَالْعَفْوِ عَنْهُمْ.
lesson.en: Keep asking your Lord for pardon, knowing how badly you need it, and take the means to it: repentance, seeking forgiveness, seeking His pleasure, and being good to people and pardoning them.

evidence.text: إن الله لعفو غفور

note.ar:
سبق زيادة بيان لمعنى هذا الاسم مع اسمه تعالى "الحليم".
سيأتي إن شاء الله زيادة إيضاح على هذه الأسماء مع اسمه تعالى: الغفور.
note.en:
The meaning of this name has already been explained further together with His name "Al-Halim" (the Forbearing).
Further explanation of these names will come, if Allah wills, together with His name Al-Ghafur (the Forgiving).

name: الْعَلِيُّ
meaning: The Most High, Exalted above all

summary.ar:
قَالَ رَحِمَهُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى: "مِنْ أَسْمَائِهِ الْحُسْنَى (الْعَلِيُّ الْأَعْلَى) وَذَلِكَ دَالٌّ عَلَى أَنَّ جَمِيعَ مَعَانِي الْعُلُوِّ ثَابِتَةٌ لِلَّهِ مِنْ كُلِّ وَجْهٍ، فَلَهُ عُلُوُّ الذَّاتِ.
وَهُوَ أَنَّهُ مُسْتَوٍ عَلَى عَرْشِهِ، فَوْقَ جَمِيعِ خَلْقِهِ، مُبَايِنٌ لَهُمْ، وَهُوَ مَعَ هَذَا مُطَّلِعٌ عَلَى أَحْوَالِهِمْ، مُشَاهِدٌ لَهُمْ، مُدَبِّرٌ لِأُمُورِهِمُ الظَّاهِرَةِ وَالْبَاطِنَةِ مُتَكَلِّمٌ بِأَحْكَامِهِ الْقَدَرِيَّةِ، وَتَدْبِيرَاتِهِ الْكَوْنِيَّةِ، وَبِأَحْكَامِهِ الشَّرْعِيَّةِ.
وَأَمَّا عُلُوُّ الْقَدْرِ فَهُوَ عُلُوُّ صِفَاتِهِ، وَعَظَمَتُهَا فَلَا يُمَاثِلُهُ صِفَةُ مَخْلُوقٍ، بَلْ لَا يَقْدِرُ الْخَلَائِقُ كُلُّهُمْ أَنْ يُحِيطُوا بِبَعْضِ مَعَانِي صِفَةٍ وَاحِدَةٍ مِنْ صِفَاتِهِ، قَالَ تَعَالَى: ﴿وَلا يُحِيطُونَ بِهِ عِلْماً﴾ وَبِذَلِكَ يُعْلَمُ أَنَّهُ لَيْسَ كَمِثْلِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي كُلِّ نُعُوتِهِ وَلَهُ عُلُوُّ الْقَهْرِ فَإِنَّهُ الْوَاحِدُ الْقَهَّارُ الَّذِي قَهَرَ بِعِزَّتِهِ وَعُلُوِّهِ الْخَلْقَ كُلَّهُمْ، فَنَوَاصِيهِمْ بِيَدِهِ، وَمَا شَاءَ كَانَ لَا يُمَانِعُهُ فِيهِ مُمَانِعٌ، وَمَا لَمْ يَشَأْ لَمْ يَكُنْ فَلَوِ اجْتَمَعَ الْخَلْقُ عَلَى إِيجَادِ مَا لَمْ يَشَأْهُ اللَّهُ لَمْ يَقْدِرُوا، وَلَوِ اجْتَمَعُوا عَلَى مَنْعِ مَا حَكَمَتْ بِهِ مَشِيئَتُهُ لَمْ يَمْنَعُوهُ، وَذَلِكَ لِكَمَالِ اقْتِدَارِهِ، وَنُفُوذِ مَشِيئَتِهِ وَشِدَّةِ افْتِقَارِ الْمَخْلُوقَاتِ كُلِّهَا إِلَيْهِ مِنْ كُلِّ وَجْهٍ.
فَهُوَ الَّذِي عَلَى الْعَرْشِ اسْتَوَى وَعَلَى الْمُلْكِ احْتَوَى، وَبِجَمِيعِ صِفَاتِ الْعَظَمَةِ وَالْكِبْرِيَاءِ، وَالْجَلَالِ وَالْجَمَالِ وَغَايَةِ الْكَمَالِ اتَّصَفَ وَإِلَيْهِ فِيهَا الْمُنْتَهَى".
summary.en:
He (may Allah have mercy on him) said: "Among His Most Beautiful Names are (Al-'Aliyy, the Most High; Al-A'la, the Highest), and this indicates that all the meanings of highness are affirmed for Allah in every respect. So He has highness of essence.
That is, He has risen over His Throne, above all His creation, separate from them; and along with this He is aware of their states, witnessing them, managing their outward and inward affairs, speaking with His rulings of predestination, His dispositions in the universe, and His legislative rulings.
As for highness of status, it is the highness of His attributes and their greatness, so no attribute of a created being is like them. Rather, all the creatures together are unable to encompass even some of the meanings of a single one of His attributes. The Exalted said: ﴾and they do not encompass Him in knowledge﴿. By this it is known that there is nothing like Him in any of His descriptions. And He has the highness of subjugation, for He is the One, Al-Qahhar (the Subduer), who has subdued all of the creation by His might and His highness. Their forelocks are in His Hand; whatever He wills happens, with no one able to prevent Him from it, and whatever He does not will does not happen. So if the creation gathered together to bring into existence something that Allah did not will, they would not be able to; and if they gathered together to prevent what His will has decreed, they would not prevent it. That is due to the perfection of His power, the carrying out of His will, and the intense need of all created things for Him in every respect.
So He is the One who rose over the Throne, and encompassed the dominion, and is described with all the attributes of greatness and grandeur, majesty and beauty, and the utmost perfection, and to Him is the ultimate end in them".

lesson.ar: أَنْ يُثْبِتَ الْعَبْدُ لِرَبِّهِ الْعُلُوَّ بِجَمِيعِ مَعَانِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ تَمْثِيلٍ، وَيَعْلَمَ أَنَّهُ مَعَ عُلُوِّهِ فَوْقَ عَرْشِهِ مُطَّلِعٌ عَلَيْهِ مُدَبِّرٌ لِأُمُورِهِ، فَيُعَظِّمَهُ وَيُرَاقِبَهُ وَلَا يَلْجَأَ إِلَّا إِلَيْهِ.
lesson.en: Affirm Allah's highness in all its meanings without likening Him to anything, and know that, while He is above His Throne, He sees you and manages your affairs — so revere Him, be mindful of Him, and turn to no one but Him.

evidence.text: وَلا يَؤُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ

note.ar: سبق الكلام على هذا الاسم مع اسمه عز وجل "الأعلى".
note.en: This name has already been discussed together with His name "Al-A'la" (the Most High).

summary.ar:
قَالَ رَحِمَهُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى: "الْخَبِيرُ الْعَلِيمُ: هُوَ الَّذِي أَحَاطَ عِلْمُهُ بِالظَّوَاهِرِ، وَالْبَوَاطِنِ، وَالْإِسْرَارِ، وَالْإِعْلَانِ، وَالْوَاجِبَاتِ، وَالْمُسْتَحِيلَاتِ، وَالْمُمْكِنَاتِ. وَبِالْعَالَمِ الْعُلْوِيِّ وَالسُّفْلِيِّ، وَبِالْمَاضِي، وَالْحَاضِرِ، وَالْمُسْتَقْبَلِ، فَلَا يَخْفَى عَلَيْهِ شَيْءٌ مِنَ الْأَشْيَاءِ.
وَهُوَ الْعَلِيمُ الْمُحِيطُ عِلْمُهُ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ: بِالْوَاجِبَاتِ، وَالْمُمْتَنِعَاتِ، وَالْمُمْكِنَاتِ، فَيَعْلَمُ تَعَالَى نَفْسَهُ الْكَرِيمَهْ، وَنُعُوتَهُ الْمُقَدَّسَةَ، وَأَوْصَافَهُ الْعَظِيمَةَ، وَهِىَ الْوَاجِبَاتُ الَّتِي لَا يُمْكِنُ إِلَّا وُجُودُهَا، وَيَعْلَمُ الْمُمْتَنِعَاتِ حَالَ امْتِنَاعِهَا، وَيَعْلَمُ مَا يَتَرَتَّبُ عَلَى وُجُودِهَا لَوْ وُجِدَتْ كَمَا قَالَ تَعَالَى: ﴿لَوْ كَانَ فِيهِمَا آلِهَةٌ إِلا اللَّهُ لَفَسَدَتَا﴾ وَقَالَ تَعَالَى: ﴿مَا اتَّخَذَ اللَّهُ مِنْ وَلَدٍ وَمَا كَانَ مَعَهُ مِنْ إِلَهٍ إِذاً لَذَهَبَ كُلُّ إِلَهٍ بِمَا خَلَقَ وَلَعَلا بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَى بَعْضٍ﴾.
فَهَذَا وَشِبْهُهُ مِنْ ذِكْرِ عِلْمِهِ بِالْمُمْتَنِعَاتِ الَّتِي يَعْلَمُهَا، وَاِخْبَارِهِ بِمَا يَنْشَأُ مِنْهَا لَوْ وُجِدَتْ عَلَى وَجْهِ الْفَرْضِ، وَالتَّقْدِيرِ، وَيَعْلَمُ تَعَالَى الْمُمْكِنَاتِ، وَهِىَ الَّتِي يَجُوزُ وُجُودُهَا وَعَدَمُهَا مَا وُجِدَ مِنْهَا، وَمَا لَمْ يُوجَدْ مِمَّا لَمْ تَقْتَضِ الْحِكْمَةُ إِيجَادَهُ، فَهُوَ الْعَلِيمُ الَّذِي أَحَاطَ عِلْمُهُ بِالْعَالَمِ الْعُلْوِيِّ، وَالسُّفْلِيِّ لَا يَخْلُو عَنْ عِلْمِهِ مَكَانٌ، وَلَا زَمَانٌ وَيَعْلَمُ الْغَيْبَ، وَالشَّهَادَةَ، وَالظَّوَاهِرَ، وَالْبَوَاطِنَ، وَالْجَلِيَّ، وَالْخَفِيَّ، قَالَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى: ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيمٌ﴾.
وَالنُّصُوصُ فِي ذِكْرِ إِحَاطَةِ عِلْمِ اللَّهِ، وَتَفْصِيلِ دَقَائِقِ مَعْلُومَاتِهِ كَثِيرَةٌ جِدّاً لَا يُمْكِنُ حَصْرُهَا، وَإِحْصَاؤُهَا، وَأَنَّهُ لَا يَعْزُبُ عَنْهُ مِثْقَالُ ذَرَّةٍ فِي الْأَرْضِ، وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ، وَلَا أَصْغَرُ مِنْ ذَلِكَ، وَلَا أَكْبَرُ، وَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفُلُ، وَلَا يَنْسَى ﴿وَمَا تَسْقُطُ مِنْ وَرَقَةٍ إلا يَعْلَمُهَا وَلا حَبَّةٍ فِي ظُلُمَاتِ الأَرْضِ وَلا رَطْبٍ وَلا يَابِسٍ إلا فِي كِتَابٍ مُبِينٍ﴾ ﴿يَعْلَمُ السِّرَّ وَأَخْفَى﴾.
وَإِنَّ عُلُومَ الْخَلَائِقِ عَلَى سَعَتِهَا، وَتَنَوُّعِهَا إِذَا نُسِبَتْ إِلَى عِلْمِ اللَّهِ اضْمَحَلَّتْ، وَتَلَاشَتْ، كَمَا أَنَّ قُدْرَتَهُمْ إِذَا نُسِبَتْ إِلَى قُدْرَةِ اللَّهِ لَمْ يَكُنْ لَهَا نِسْبَةٌ إِلَيْهَا بِوَجْهٍ مِنَ الْوُجُوهِ، فَهُوَ الَّذِي عَلَّمَهُمْ مَا لَمْ يَكُونُوا يَعْلَمُونَ وَأَقْدَرَهُمْ عَلَى مَا لَمْ يَكُونُوا عَلَيْهِ قَادِرِينَ.
وَكَمَا أَنَّ عِلْمَهُ مُحِيطٌ بِجَمِيعِ الْعَالَمِ الْعُلْوِيِّ، وَالسُّفْلِيِّ، وَمَا فِيهِ مِنَ الْمَخْلُوقَاتِ ذَوَاتِهَا، وَأَوْصَافِهَا، وَأَفْعَالِهَا، وَجَمِيعِ أُمُورِهَا.
فَهُوَ يَعْلَمُ مَا كَانَ، وَمَا يَكُونُ فِي الْمُسْتَقْبَلَاتِ الَّتِي لَا نِهَايَةَ لَهَا، وَمَا لَمْ يَكُنْ لَوْ كَانَ كَيْفَ كَانَ يَكُونُ، وَيَعْلَمُ أَحْوَالَ الْمُكَلَّفِينَ مُنْذُ أَنْشَأَهُمْ، وَبَعْدَ مَا يُمِيتُهُمْ، وَبَعْدَ مَا يُحْيِيهِمْ، قَدْ أَحَاطَ عِلْمُهُ بِأَعْمَالِهِمْ كُلِّهَا خَيْرِهَا، وَشَرِّهَا، وَجَزَاءِ تِلْكَ الْأَعْمَالِ وَتَفَاصِيلِ ذَلِكَ فِي دَارِ الْقَرَارِ.
فَيَنْبَغِي لِلْمُؤْمِنِ النَّاصِحِ لِنَفْسِهِ أَنْ يَبْذُلَ مَا اسْتَطَاعَ مِنْ مَقْدُورِهِ فِي مَعْرِفَةِ أَسْمَاءِ اللَّهِ، وَصِفَاتِهِ، وَتَقْدِيسِهِ، وَيَجْعَلَ هَذِهِ الْمَسْأَلَةَ أَهَمَّ الْمَسَائِلِ عِنْدَهُ، وَأَوْلَاهَا بِالْإِيثَارِ، وَأَحَقَّهَا بِالتَّحْقِيقِ لِيَفُوزَ مِنَ الْخَيْرِ بِأَوْفَرِ نَصِيبٍ.
فَيَتَدَبَّرُ مَثَلاً اسْمَ الْعَلِيمِ: فَيَعْلَمُ إِنَّ الْعِلْمَ كُلَّهُ بِجَمِيعِ وُجُوهِهِ، وَاعْتِبَارَاتِهِ لِلَّهِ تَعَالَى فَيَعْلَمُ تَعَالَى الْأُمُورَ الْمُتَأَخِّرَةَ أَزَلاً وَأَبَداً وَيَعْلَمُ جَلِيلَ الْأُمُورِ، وَحَقِيرَهَا، وَصَغِيرَهَا، وَكَبِيرَهَا، وَيَعْلَمُ تَعَالَى ظَوَاهِرَ الْأَشْيَاءِ، وَبَوَاطِنَهَا غَيْبَهَا، وَشَهَادَتَهَا مَا يَعْلَمُ الْخَلْقُ مِنْهَا، وَمَا لَا يَعْلَمُونَ، وَيَعْلَمُ تَعَالَى الْوَاجِبَاتِ أَوِ الْمُسْتَحِيلَاتِ، وَالْجَائِزَاتِ، وَيَعْلَمُ تَعَالَى مَا تَحْتَ الْأَرْضِ السُّفْلَى كَمَا يَعْلَمُ مَا فَوْقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ الْعُلَى، وَيَعْلَمُ تَعَالَى جُزْئِيَّاتِ الْأُمُورِ وَخَبَايَا الصُّدُورِ، وَخَفَايَا مَا وَقَعَ، وَيَقَعُ فِي أَرْجَاءِ الْعَالَمِ، وَأَنْحَاءِ الْمَمْلَكَةِ، فَهُوَ الَّذِي أَحَاطَ عِلْمُهُ جَمِيعَ الْأَشْيَاءِ فِي كُلِّ الْأَوْقَاتِ، وَلَا يَعْرِضُ تَعَالَى لِعِلْمِهِ خَفَاءٌ، وَلَا نِسْيَانٌ، وَيَتْلُو عَلَى هَذِهِ الْآيَاتِ الْمُقَرِّرَةِ لَهُ كَقَوْلِهِ فِي غَيْرِ مَوْضِعٍ: ﴿وَاللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيمٌ﴾ ﴿عَلِيمٌ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُورِ﴾ ﴿يَعْلَمُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا تُسِرُّونَ وَمَا تُعْلِنُونَ وَاللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُورِ﴾ ﴿وَإِنْ تَجْهَرْ بِالْقَوْلِ فَإِنَّهُ يَعْلَمُ السِّرَّ وَأَخْفَى﴾ ﴿سَوَاءٌ مِنْكُمْ مَنْ أَسَرَّ الْقَوْلَ وَمَنْ جَهَرَ بِهِ وَمَنْ هُوَ مُسْتَخْفٍ بِاللَّيْلِ وَسَارِبٌ بِالنَّهَارِ﴾ ﴿أَلَمْ تَعْلَمْ أَنَّ اللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ مَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَالأَرْضِ إِنَّ ذَلِكَ فِي كِتَابٍ إِنَّ ذَلِكَ عَلَى اللَّهِ يَسِيرٌ﴾ ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ لا يَخْفَى عَلَيْهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الأَرْضِ وَلا فِي السَّمَاءِ هُوَ الَّذِي يُصَوِّرُكُمْ فِي الأَرْحَامِ كَيْفَ يَشَاءُ لا إِلَهَ إِلا هُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ﴾ ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ عِنْدَهُ عِلْمُ السَّاعَةِ وَيُنَزِّلُ الْغَيْثَ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا فِي الأَرْحَامِ وَمَا تَدْرِي نَفْسٌ مَاذَا تَكْسِبُ غَداً وَمَا تَدْرِي نَفْسٌ بِأَيِّ أَرْضٍ تَمُوتُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلِيمٌ خَبِيرٌ﴾ ﴿وَعِنْدَهُ مَفَاتِحُ الْغَيْبِ لا يَعْلَمُهَا إلا هُوَ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا فِي الْبَرِّ وَالْبَحْرِ وَمَا تَسْقُطُ مِنْ وَرَقَةٍ إِلا يَعْلَمُهَا وَلا حَبَّةٍ فِي ظُلُمَاتِ الأَرْضِ وَلا رَطْبٍ وَلا يَابِسٍ إِلا فِي كِتَابٍ مُبِينٍ﴾ ﴿أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ اللَّهَ أَنْزَلَ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً فَتُصْبِحُ الأَرْضُ مُخْضَرَّةً إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَطِيفٌ خَبِيرٌ عَالِمُ الْغَيْبِ فَلا يُظْهِرُ عَلَى غَيْبِهِ أَحَداً إِلا مَنِ ارْتَضَى مِنْ رَسُولٍ﴾ ﴿يَعْلَمُ مَا يَلِجُ فِي الأرْضِ وَمَا يَخْرُجُ مِنْهَا وَمَا يَنْزِلُ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ وَمَا يَعْرُجُ فِيهَا﴾ ﴿وَلَوْ أَنَّمَا فِي الأرْضِ مِنْ شَجَرَةٍ أَقْلامٌ وَالْبَحْرُ يَمُدُّهُ مِنْ بَعْدِهِ سَبْعَةُ أَبْحُرٍ مَا نَفِدَتْ كَلِمَاتُ اللَّهِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌ﴾ ﴿وَاللَّهُ خَبِيرٌ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ﴾ ﴿أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ اللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الأرْضِ مَا يَكُونُ مِنْ نَجْوَى ثَلاثَةٍ إلا هُوَ رَابِعُهُمْ وَلا خَمْسَةٍ إلا هُوَ سَادِسُهُمْ وَلا أَدْنَى مِنْ ذَلِكَ وَلا أَكْثَرَ إلا هُوَ مَعَهُمْ أَيْنَ مَا كَانُوا ثُمَّ يُنَبِّئُهُمْ بِمَا عَمِلُوا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيمٌ﴾ ﴿فَلا تَعْلَمُ نَفْسٌ مَا أُخْفِيَ لَهُمْ مِنْ قُرَّةِ أَعْيُنٍ﴾.
وَغَيْرُ ذَلِكَ مِنَ النُّصُوصِ الْكَثِيرَةِ عَلَى هَذَا الْمَعْنَى فَإِنَّ تَدَبُّرَ بَعْضِ ذَلِكَ يَكْفِي الْمُؤْمِنَ الْبَصِيرَ مَعْرِفَتَهُ بِاِحَاطَةِ عِلْمِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى وَكَمَالِ عَظَمَتِهِ وَجَلِيلِ قَدْرِهِ إِنَّهُ الرَّبُّ الْعَظِيمُ الْمَالِكُ.
summary.en:
He (may Allah have mercy on him) said: "Al-Khabir Al-'Alim (the All-Aware, the All-Knowing): He is the One whose knowledge encompasses the outward and the inward, the secret and the open, the necessary, the impossible and the possible; the upper world and the lower; and the past, the present and the future. So nothing at all is hidden from Him.
And He is Al-'Alim, whose knowledge encompasses everything: the necessary, the impossible and the possible. So He, the Most High, knows His noble Self, His holy descriptions and His great attributes, which are the necessary things that cannot but exist. And He knows the impossible things in their state of impossibility, and knows what would result from their existence if they were to exist, as He, the Most High, said: ﴾Had there been within them [the heavens and earth] gods besides Allah, they both would have been ruined﴿, and He, the Most High, said: ﴾Allah has not taken any son, nor has there ever been with Him any deity. [If there had been], then each deity would have taken what it created, and some of them would have sought to overcome others﴿.
So this and its like are mentions of His knowledge of the impossible things which He knows, and of His informing of what would arise from them if they existed, by way of supposition and hypothesis. And He, the Most High, knows the possible things, which are those whose existence and non-existence are both possible: what has come into existence of them, and what has not come into existence, of what wisdom did not require to be brought into existence. So He is Al-'Alim, whose knowledge encompasses the upper world and the lower; no place and no time is outside His knowledge. He knows the unseen and the witnessed, the outward and the inward, the manifest and the hidden. Allah, the Most High, said: ﴾Indeed, Allah is Knowing of all things﴿.
And the texts mentioning the comprehensiveness of Allah's knowledge, and detailing the minute things He knows, are very many and cannot be enumerated or counted: that not an atom's weight escapes Him in the earth or in the heaven, nor what is smaller than that or greater, and that He is not heedless and does not forget. ﴾And no leaf falls but that He knows it. And no grain is there within the darknesses of the earth and no moist or dry [thing] but that it is [written] in a clear record﴿ ﴾He knows the secret and what is [even] more hidden﴿.
And the knowledge of the creatures, despite its vastness and variety, when compared to the knowledge of Allah, fades away and vanishes; just as their power, when compared to the power of Allah, bears no comparison to it in any way. For He is the One who taught them what they did not know, and enabled them to do what they were not able to do.
And just as His knowledge encompasses the entire upper world and the lower, and the creations in it: their essences, their attributes, their actions and all their affairs.
So He knows what has been, and what will be in the endless future, and what has not been, if it were to be, how it would be. And He knows the states of the accountable beings from when He brought them into being, after He causes them to die, and after He brings them back to life. His knowledge has encompassed all their deeds, the good of them and the bad of them, and the recompense of those deeds and its details in the Abode of Permanence.
So the believer who is sincere to himself should expend whatever he is able to in knowing the Names of Allah and His attributes and in declaring Him holy, and should make this matter the most important of matters to him, the most deserving of being given preference, and the most deserving of being studied thoroughly, so that he may win the most abundant share of good.
So let him reflect, for example, on the name Al-'Alim: he will know that all knowledge, in all its aspects and considerations, belongs to Allah, the Most High. He, the Most High, knows the matters that come later, from eternity and forever. He knows matters great and insignificant, small and large. He, the Most High, knows the outward aspects of things and their inner aspects, their unseen and their witnessed, what the creation knows of them and what they do not know. He, the Most High, knows the necessary or the impossible, and the possible. He, the Most High, knows what is beneath the lowest earth just as He knows what is above the highest heavens. He, the Most High, knows the particulars of matters, the secrets of the breasts, and the hidden aspects of what has happened and what happens in the regions of the world and the corners of the dominion. He is the One whose knowledge has encompassed all things at all times; no obscurity or forgetfulness befalls His knowledge, the Most High. And let him recite in this regard the verses that establish it, such as His saying in more than one place: ﴾And Allah is Knowing of all things﴿ ﴾Knowing of that within the breasts﴿ ﴾He knows what is within the heavens and earth and knows what you conceal and what you declare. And Allah is Knowing of that within the breasts﴿ ﴾And if you speak aloud - then indeed, He knows the secret and what is [even] more hidden﴿ ﴾It is the same [to Him] concerning you whether one conceals [his] speech or publicizes it and whether one is hidden by night or conspicuous [among others] by day﴿ ﴾Do you not know that Allah knows what is in the heaven and earth? Indeed, that is in a Record. Indeed that, for Allah, is easy﴿ ﴾Indeed, from Allah nothing is hidden in the earth nor in the heaven. It is He who forms you in the wombs however He wills. There is no deity except Him, the Exalted in Might, the Wise﴿ ﴾Indeed, Allah [alone] has knowledge of the Hour and sends down the rain and knows what is in the wombs. And no soul perceives what it will earn tomorrow, and no soul perceives in what land it will die. Indeed, Allah is Knowing and Acquainted﴿ ﴾And with Him are the keys of the unseen; none knows them except Him. And He knows what is on the land and in the sea. Not a leaf falls but that He knows it. And no grain is there within the darknesses of the earth and no moist or dry [thing] but that it is [written] in a clear record﴿ ﴾Do you not see that Allah has sent down rain from the sky and the earth becomes green? Indeed, Allah is Subtle and Acquainted. [He is] Knower of the unseen, and He does not disclose His [knowledge of the] unseen to anyone, except whom He has approved of messengers﴿ ﴾He knows what penetrates into the earth and what emerges from it and what descends from the heaven and what ascends therein﴿ ﴾And if whatever trees upon the earth were pens and the sea [was ink], replenished thereafter by seven [more] seas, the words of Allah would not be exhausted. Indeed, Allah is Exalted in Might and Wise﴿ ﴾And Allah is Acquainted with what you do﴿ ﴾Have you not considered that Allah knows what is in the heavens and what is on the earth? There is in no private conversation three but that He is the fourth of them, nor are there five but that He is the sixth of them, and no less than that and no more except that He is with them wherever they are. Then He will inform them of what they did, on the Day of Resurrection. Indeed Allah is, of all things, Knowing﴿ ﴾And no soul knows what has been hidden for them of comfort for eyes﴿.
And there are many other texts with this meaning. Reflecting on some of that is enough for the discerning believer to know the comprehensiveness of the knowledge of Allah, the Most High, the perfection of His greatness and the majesty of His standing, and that He is the Great Lord, the Sovereign.

lesson.ar: أَنْ يَتَدَبَّرَ الْعَبْدُ اسْمَهُ الْعَلِيمَ فَيَعْلَمَ أَنَّ رَبَّهُ مُحِيطٌ بِظَاهِرِهِ وَبَاطِنِهِ، فَيَحْفَظَ سِرَّهُ وَعَلَانِيَتَهُ مِمَّا يَكْرَهُ اللَّهُ، وَيَبْذُلَ جُهْدَهُ فِي مَعْرِفَةِ أَسْمَاءِ اللَّهِ وَصِفَاتِهِ، فَإِنَّهَا أَهَمُّ الْمَسَائِلِ وَأَوْلَاهَا بِالْإِيثَارِ.
lesson.en: Reflect on the name Al-'Alim: your Lord fully knows your outward and inward, so guard both your private and public life from what He dislikes, and strive to learn His names and attributes, for that is the most important of all matters.

evidence.text: إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلِيمٌ خَبِيرٌ

note.ar: سبق الكلام على هذا الاسم مع اسمه تعالى "الخبير".
note.en: This name has already been discussed together with His name "Al-Khabir" (the All-Aware).

summary.ar:
قَالَ رَحِمَهُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى: "الْغَفُورُ الَّذِي لَمْ يَزَلْ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ وَيَتُوبُ عَلَ كُلِّ مَنْ يَتُوبُ فَفِي الْحَدِيثِ: "إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَقُولُ يَابْنَ آدَمَ إِنَّكَ لَوْ أَتَيْتَنِي بِقُرَابِ الْأَرْضِ خَطَايَا ثُمَّ لَقِيتَنِي لَا تُشْرِكُ بِي شَيْئاً لَأَتَيْتُكَ بِقُرَابِهَا مَغْفِرَةً".
وَقَالَ تَعَالَى: ﴿إِنَّ رَبَّكَ وَاسِعُ الْمَغْفِرَةِ﴾.
وَقَدْ فَتَحَ اللَّهُ الْأَسْبَابَ لِنَيْلِ مَغْفِرَتِهِ بِالتَّوْبَةِ، وَالِاسْتِغْفَارِ، وَالْإِيمَانِ، وَالْعَمَلِ الصَّالِحِ، وَالْإِحْسَانِ إِلَى عِبَادِ اللَّهِ، وَالْعَفْوِ عَنْهُمْ، وَقُوَّةِ الطَّمَعِ فِي فَضْلِ اللَّهِ، وَحُسْنِ الظَّنِّ بِاللَّهِ، وَغَيْرِ ذَلِكَ مِمَّا جَعَلَهُ اللَّهُ مُقَرِّباً لِمَغْفِرَتِهِ".
summary.en:
He (may Allah have mercy on him) said: "Al-Ghafur (the Forgiving) is the One who never ceases to forgive sins and to accept the repentance of everyone who repents. In the hadith: "Allah says: O son of Adam, if you were to come to Me with nearly an earthful of sins, then meet Me not associating anything with Me, I would come to you with nearly its fill of forgiveness".
And the Exalted said: ﴾Indeed, your Lord is vast in forgiveness﴿.
Allah has opened the causes for attaining His forgiveness: repentance, seeking forgiveness, faith, righteous deeds, kindness to the servants of Allah and pardoning them, strong hope in Allah's favour, thinking well of Allah, and other things which Allah has made a means of drawing near to His forgiveness".

lesson.ar: أَنْ يُكْثِرَ الْعَبْدُ مِنَ التَّوْبَةِ وَالِاسْتِغْفَارِ وَلَا يَيْأَسَ مِنْ مَغْفِرَةِ رَبِّهِ مَهْمَا كَثُرَتْ ذُنُوبُهُ، مَعَ الْأَخْذِ بِأَسْبَابِهَا مِنَ الْإِيمَانِ وَالْعَمَلِ الصَّالِحِ وَالْإِحْسَانِ إِلَى الْخَلْقِ.
lesson.en: Repent and seek forgiveness often, and never despair of your Lord's forgiveness however many your sins, while taking its means: faith, good deeds and kindness to others.

note.ar: سبق زيادة إيضاح لهذين الاسمين مع اسمه تعالى "العفو".
note.en: These two names have already been explained further together with His name "Al-'Afuww" (the Pardoner).

قَالَ رَحِمَهُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى: "الْغَفُورُ الَّذِي لَمْ يَزَلْ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ وَيَتُوبُ عَلَ كُلِّ مَنْ يَتُوبُ فَفِي الْحَدِيثِ: "إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَقُولُ يَابْنَ آدَمَ إِنَّكَ لَوْ أَتَيْتَنِي بِقُرَابِ الْأَرْضِ خَطَايَا ثُمَّ لَقِيتَنِي لَا تُشْرِكُ بِي شَيْئاً لَأَتَيْتُكَ بِقُرَابِهَا مَغْفِرَةً".

And the Exalted said: ﴾Indeed, your Lord is vast in forgiveness﴿.
Allah has opened the causes for attaining His forgiveness: repentance, seeking forgiveness, faith, righteous deeds, kindness to the servants of Allah and pardoning them, strong hope in Allah's favour, thinking well of Allah, and other things which Allah has made a means of drawing near to His forgiveness".

lesson.ar: أَنْ يُحْسِنَ الْعَبْدُ الظَّنَّ بِرَبِّهِ وَيَقْوَى طَمَعُهُ فِي فَضْلِهِ فَلَا تُقَنِّطُهُ كَثْرَةُ ذُنُوبِهِ، وَيُحَقِّقَ التَّوْحِيدَ، وَيَسْلُكَ الْأَسْبَابَ الَّتِي جَعَلَهَا اللَّهُ مُقَرِّبَةً لِمَغْفِرَتِهِ.
lesson.en: Think well of your Lord and keep strong hope in His bounty, never letting the number of your sins make you despair; hold firmly to Tawheed (worshipping Allah alone) and take the means He has made to bring His forgiveness near.

evidence.text: إن الله لعفو غفور

note.ar: سبق زيادة إيضاح لهذين الاسمين مع اسمه تعالى "العفو".
note.en: These two names have already been explained further together with His name "Al-'Afuww" (the Pardoner).

name: الْغَنِيُّ
meaning: The Self-Sufficient, Free of All Need

summary.ar:
قَالَ رَحِمَهُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى: قَالَ تَعَالَى ﴿يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ أَنْتُمُ الْفُقَرَاءُ إِلَى اللَّهِ وَاللَّهُ هُوَ الْغَنِيُّ الْحَمِيد﴾.
فَهُوَ الْغَنِيُّ بِذَاتِهِ، الَّذِي لَهُ الْغِنَى التَّامُّ الْمُطْلَقُ، مِنْ جَمِيعِ الْوُجُوهِ، وَالِاعْتِبَارَاتِ لِكَمَالِهِ، وَكَمَالِ صِفَاتِهِ.
فَلَا يَتَطَرَّقُ إِلَيْهَا نَقْصٌ بِوَجْهٍ مِنَ الْوُجُوهِ، وَلَا يُمْكِنُ أَنْ يَكُونَ إِلَّا غَنِيّاً، لِأَنَّ غِنَاهُ مِنْ لَوَازِمِ ذَاتِهِ، كَمَا لَا يَكُونُ إِلَّا خَالِقاً قَادِراً رَازِقاً مُحْسِناً فَلَا يَحْتَاجُ إِلَى أَحَدٍ بِوَجْهٍ مِنَ الْوُجُوهِ.
فَهُوَ الْغَنِيُّ الَّذِي بِيَدِهِ خَزَائِنُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ، وَخَزَائِنُ الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ الْمُغْنِي جَمِيعَ خَلْقِهِ غِنًي عَامّاً، وَالْمُغْنِي لِخَوَاصِّ خَلْقِهِ مِمَّا أَفَاضَ عَلَى قُلُوبِهِمْ مِنَ الْمَعَارِفِ الرَّبَّانِيَّةِ وَالْحَقَائِقِ الْإِيمَانِيَّةِ.
وَمِنْ كَمَالِ غِنَاهُ وَكَرَمِهِ أَنَّهُ يَأْمُرُ عِبَادَهُ بِدُعَائِهِ، وَيَعِدُهُمْ بِإِجَابَةِ دَعَوَاتِهِمْ، وَإِسْعَافِهِمْ بِجَمِيعِ مُرَادَاتِهِمْ، وَيُؤْتِيهِمْ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ مَا سَأَلُوهُ، وَمَا لَمْ يَسْأَلُوهُ، وَمِنْ كَمَالِ غِنَاهُ أَنَّهُ لَوِ اجْتَمَعَ أَوَّلُ الْخَلْقِ وَآخِرُهُمْ فِي صَعِيدٍ وَاحِدٍ فَسَأَلُوهُ، فَأَعْطَى كُلًّا مِنْهُمْ مَا سَأَلَهُ وَمَا بَلَغَتْ أَمَانِيُّهُ مَا نَقَصَ مِنْ مُلْكِهِ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ، وَمِنْ كَمَالِ غِنَاهُ، وَسَعَةِ عَطَايَاهُ مَا يَبْسُطُهُ عَلَى أَهْلِ دَارِ كَرَامَتِهِ مِنَ النَّعِيمِ، وَاللَّذَّاتِ الْمُتَتَابِعَاتِ، وَالْخَيْرَاتِ الْمُتَوَاصِلَاتِ، مِمَّا لَا عَيْنٌ رَأَتْ وَلَا أُذُنٌ سَمِعَتْ وَلَا خَطَرَ عَلَى قَلْبِ بَشَرٍ.
وَمِنْ كَمَالِ غِنَاهُ أَنَّهُ لَمْ يَتَّخِذْ صَاحِباً وَلَا وَلَداً وَلَا شَرِيكاً فِي الْمُلْكِ، وَلَا وَلِيّاً مِنَ الذُّلِّ، وَهُوَ الْغَنِيُّ الَّذِي كَمُلَ بِنُعُوتِهِ، وَأَوْصَافِهِ، الْمُغْنِي لِجَمِيعِ مَخْلُوقَاتِهِ.
summary.en:
He (may Allah have mercy on him) said: The Exalted said: ﴾O mankind, you are those in need of Allah, while Allah is the Free of need, the Praiseworthy﴿.
So He is Al-Ghani (the Free of Need) by His very Self, to whom belongs complete and absolute freedom from need in every respect and every consideration, because of His perfection and the perfection of His attributes.
No deficiency can touch them in any respect, and He cannot be other than free of need, because His freedom from need is inseparable from His Self — just as He cannot be other than Creator, Able, Provider, Beneficent. So He does not need anyone in any respect.
He is Al-Ghani in whose hand are the treasuries of the heavens and the earth, and the treasuries of this world and the Hereafter; Al-Mughni (the Enricher), who enriches all His creation with a general enrichment, and who enriches the elect of His creation with what He has poured into their hearts of divine knowledge and the realities of faith.
Part of the perfection of His freedom from need and His generosity is that He commands His servants to call upon Him, promises them to answer their supplications and to grant them all they desire, and gives them from His bounty what they asked and what they did not ask. Part of the perfection of His freedom from need is that if the first of the creation and the last of them gathered on a single plain and asked Him, and He gave each of them what he asked and what his hopes reached, that would not decrease His dominion by the weight of an atom. And part of the perfection of His freedom from need and the vastness of His gifts is what He spreads out for the people of the abode of His honour of bliss, successive delights and continuous good things — such as no eye has seen, no ear has heard, and has never occurred to the heart of a human being.
Part of the perfection of His freedom from need is that He has not taken a companion or a son, nor had a partner in dominion, nor any protector out of weakness. He is Al-Ghani, who is perfect in His qualities and His attributes, Al-Mughni to all His creatures.

lesson.ar: أَنْ يُظْهِرَ الْعَبْدُ فَقْرَهُ إِلَى رَبِّهِ الْغَنِيِّ فِي كُلِّ أَحْوَالِهِ، وَيَسْأَلَهُ مِنْ خَزَائِنِهِ الَّتِي لَا تَنْفَدُ، فَإِنَّهُ يَأْمُرُ عِبَادَهُ بِدُعَائِهِ وَيَعِدُهُمْ بِالْإِجَابَةِ، وَيُؤْتِيهِمْ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ مَا سَأَلُوهُ وَمَا لَمْ يَسْأَلُوهُ.
lesson.en: Show your complete need of your Rich Lord in every situation and ask Him from His treasures that never run out, for He commands His servants to call on Him, promises to answer them, and gives them from His bounty what they ask and what they do not ask.

evidence.text: يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ أَنْتُمُ الْفُقَرَاءُ إِلَى اللَّهِ وَاللَّهُ هُوَ الْغَنِيُّ الْحَمِيد

summary.ar:
قَالَ رَحِمَهُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى: "الْفَتَّاحُ: الَّذِي يَحْكُمُ بَيْنَ عِبَادِهِ، بِأَحْكَامِهِ الشَّرْعِيَّةِ، وَأَحْكَامِهِ الْقَدَرِيَّةِ، وَأَحْكَامِ الْجَزَاءِ، الَّذِي فَتَحَ بِلُطْفِهِ بَصَائِرَ الصَّادِقِينَ، وَفَتَحَ قُلُوبَهُمْ لِمَعْرِفَتِهِ، وَمَحَبَّتِهِ، وَالْإِنَابَةِ إِلَيْهِ، وَفَتَحَ لِعِبَادِهِ أَبْوَابَ الرَّحْمَةِ وَالْأَرْزَاقِ الْمُتَنَوِّعَةِ، وَسَبَّبَ لَهُمُ الْأَسْبَابَ الَّتِي يَنَالُونَ بِهَا خَيْرَ الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ.
وَفَتْحُهُ تَعَالَى قِسْمَانِ:
أَحَدُهُمَا: فَتْحُهُ بِحُكْمِهِ الدِّينِيِّ، وَحُكْمِهِ الْجَزَائِيِّ.
وَالثَّانِي: الْفَتَّاحُ بِحُكْمِهِ الْقَدَرِيِّ.
فَفَتْحُهُ بِحُكْمِهِ الدِّينِيِّ هُوَ شَرْعُهُ عَلَى الّسنة رُسُلِهِ جَمِيعَ مَا يَحْتَاجُهُ الْمُكَلَّفُونَ، وَيَسْتَقِيمُونَ بِهِ عَلَى الصِّرَاطِ الْمُسْتَقِيمِ، وَأَمَّا فَتْحُهُ بِجَزَائِهِ فَهُوَ فَتْحُهُ بَيْنَ أَنْبِيَائِهِ وَمُخَالِفِيهِمْ وَبَيْنَ أَوْلِيَائِهِ وَأَعْدَائِهِ بِإِكْرَامِ الْأَنْبِيَاءِ وَاَتْبَاعِهِمْ وَنَجَاتِهِمْ، وَبِإِهَانَةِ أَعْدَائِهِمْ وَعُقُوبَاتِهِمْ، وَكَذَلِكَ فَتْحُهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ، وَحُكْمُهُ بَيْنَ الْخَلَائِقِ حِينَ يُوَفَّى كُلُّ عَامِلٍ مَا عَمِلَهُ. وَأَمَّا فَتْحُهُ الْقَدَرِيُّ فَهُوَ مَا يُقَدِّرُهُ عَلَى عِبَادِهِ مِنْ خَيْرٍ، وَشَرٍّ، وَنَفْعٍ، وَضَرٍّ، وَعَطَاءٍ، وَمَنْعٍ، قَالَ تَعَالَى: ﴿مَا يَفْتَحِ اللَّهُ لِلنَّاسِ مِنْ رَحْمَةٍ فَلا مُمْسِكَ لَهَا وَمَا يُمْسِكْ فَلا مُرْسِلَ لَهُ مِنْ بَعْدِهِ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ﴾.
فَالرَّبُّ تَعَالَى هُوَ الْفَتَّاحُ الْعَلِيمُ الَّذِي يَفْتَحُ لِعِبَادِهِ الطَّائِعِينَ خَزَائِنَ جُودِهِ وَكَرَمِهِ، وَيَفْنَحُ عَلَى أَعْدَائِهِ ضِدَّ ذَلِكَ، وَذَلِكَ بِفَضْلِهِ وَعَدْلِهِ.
summary.en:
He (may Allah have mercy on him) said: "Al-Fattah (the Judge, the Opener): the One who judges between His servants with His legislative rulings, His decreed rulings and His rulings of recompense; who by His kindness has opened the insights of the truthful, and opened their hearts to knowing Him, loving Him and turning to Him in repentance; who has opened for His servants the doors of mercy and of various provisions, and has set up for them the causes by which they attain the good of this world and the Hereafter.
His opening (the Exalted) is of two types:
The first: His opening by His religious judgement and His judgement of recompense.
The second: [His being] Al-Fattah by His decreed judgement.
His opening by His religious judgement is His legislating, upon the tongues of His messengers, all that the accountable need and by which they remain upright upon the straight path. As for His opening by His recompense, it is His judging between His prophets and those who opposed them, and between His allies and His enemies, by honouring the prophets and their followers and saving them, and by humiliating their enemies and punishing them. Likewise is His judging on the Day of Resurrection, and His judgement between the creatures when every doer is paid in full for what he did. As for His decreed opening, it is what He decrees for His servants of good and evil, benefit and harm, giving and withholding. The Exalted said: ﴾Whatever Allah grants to people of mercy — none can withhold it; and whatever He withholds — none can release it thereafter. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise﴿.
So the Lord, the Exalted, is Al-Fattah, Al-'Alim (the All-Knowing), who opens for His obedient servants the treasuries of His bounty and His generosity, and opens upon His enemies the opposite of that — and that is by His favour and His justice.

lesson.ar: أَنْ يَسْأَلَ الْعَبْدُ الْفَتَّاحَ وَحْدَهُ أَنْ يَفْتَحَ لَهُ أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِهِ وَرِزْقِهِ، وَيَفْتَحَ قَلْبَهُ لِمَعْرِفَتِهِ وَمَحَبَّتِهِ وَالْإِنَابَةِ إِلَيْهِ، وَيَلْزَمَ طَاعَتَهُ؛ فَإِنَّهُ يَفْتَحُ لِعِبَادِهِ الطَّائِعِينَ خَزَائِنَ جُودِهِ وَكَرَمِهِ.
lesson.en: Ask Al-Fattah alone to open for you the doors of His mercy and provision and to open your heart to knowing, loving and turning to Him, and hold firmly to obeying Him, for He opens the treasures of His generosity to those who obey Him.

evidence.text: قُلْ يَجْمَعُ بَيْنَنَا رَبُّنَا ثُمَّ يَفْتَحُ بَيْنَنَا بِالْحَقِّ وَهُوَ الْفَتَّاحُ الْعَلِيمُ

name: الْفَعَّالُ لِمَا يُرِيدُ
meaning: The Doer of whatever He wills

summary.ar:
قَالَ رَحِمَهُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى: "الْفَعَّالُ لِمَا يُرِيدُ هَذَا مِنْ كَمَالِ قُوَّتِهِ، وَنُفُوذِ مَشِيئَتِهِ، وَقُدْرَتِهِ، أَنَّ كُلَّ أَمْرٍ يُرِيدُهُ يَفْعَلُهُ بِلَا مُمَانِعٍ، وَلَا مُعَارِضٍ.
وَلَيْسَ لَهُ ظَهِيرٌ، وَلَا عَوِينٌ عَلَى أَيِّ أَمْرٍ يَكُونُ، بَلْ إِذَا أَرَادَ شَيْئاً قَالَ لَهُ: كُنْ فَيَكُونُ.
وَمَعَ أَنَّهُ الْفَعَّالُ لِمَا يُرِيدُ فَإِرَادَتُهُ تَابِعَةٌ لِحِكْمَتِهِ، وَحَمْدِهِ، فَهُوَ مَوْصُوفٌ بِكَمَالِ الْقُدْرَةِ، وَنُفُوذِ الْمَشِيئَةِ، وَمَوْصُوفٌ بِشُمُولِ الْحِكْمَةِ لِكُلِّ مَافَعَلَهُ وَيَفْعَلُهُ.
وَلَيْسَ أَحَدٌ فَعَّالٌ لِمَا يُرِيدُ إِلَّا اللَّهُ".
summary.en:
He (may Allah have mercy on him) said: "Al-Fa''al lima yurid (the Doer of whatever He wills): this is part of the perfection of His strength and the effectiveness of His will and His power — that every matter He wills, He does without anyone preventing or opposing.
He has no supporter or helper in any matter whatsoever; rather, when He wills a thing, He says to it: Be, and it is.
And although He is the Doer of whatever He wills, His will follows His wisdom and His praiseworthiness. He is described by perfect power and effective will, and described by wisdom encompassing all that He has done and does.
No one is a doer of whatever he wills except Allah".

lesson.ar: أَنْ يَعْلَمَ الْعَبْدُ أَنَّ مَا أَرَادَهُ اللَّهُ كَائِنٌ لَا مَحَالَةَ، فَيُعَلِّقَ رَجَاءَهُ وَخَوْفَهُ بِهِ وَحْدَهُ، وَيَرْضَى بِأَفْعَالِهِ لِأَنَّهَا صَادِرَةٌ عَنْ حِكْمَتِهِ وَحَمْدِهِ.
lesson.en: Know that whatever Allah wills will certainly happen, so place your hope and fear in Him alone, and accept His actions with contentment, for they all come from His wisdom and praiseworthiness.

note.ar: لم أقف على دليل يدل على اسمية لله تعالى، وقال الشيخ سليمان بن عبد الله في تيسير العزيز الحميد (ص٦٤٤): "ولا يصح تسمية الله تعالى بالفعال والفالق والمخرج ... مع أنها لم ترد في شيء من الأحاديث"أ. هـ.
note.en: I have not found evidence that it is a name of Allah the Exalted. Shaykh Sulayman ibn 'Abdullah said in Taysir al-'Aziz al-Hamid (p. 644): "It is not correct to name Allah the Exalted 'Al-Fa''al', 'Al-Faliq' and 'Al-Mukhrij' … since they have not come in any of the hadiths." End of quote.

name: الْقَابِضُ
meaning: The One who withholds and takes

summary.ar:
قَالَ رَحِمَهُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى: " الْقَابِضُ الْبَاسِطُ، الْخَافِضُ الرَّافِعُ، الْمُعِزُّ الْمُذِلُّ، الْمَانِعُ الْمُعْطِي، الضَّارُّ النَّافِعُ".
"هَذِهِ الْأَسْمَاءُ الْكَرِيمَةُ مِنَ الْأَسْمَاءِ الْمُتَقَابِلَاتِ الَّتِي لَا يَنْبَغِي أَنْ يُثْنَى عَلَى اللَّهِ بِهَا إِلَّا كُلُّ وَاحِدٍ مَعَ الْآخَرِ لِأَنَّ الْكَمَالَ الْمُطْلَقَ مِنِ اجْتِمَاعِ الْوَصْفَيْنِ، فَهُوَ الْقَابِضُ لِلْأَرْزَاقِ وَالْأَرْوَاحِ وَالنُّفُوسِ، وَالْبَاسِطُ لِلْأَرْزَاقِ، وَالرَّحْمَةِ، وَالْقُلُوبِ، وَهُوَ الرَّافِعُ لِلْأَقْوَامِ الْقَائِمِينَ بِالْعِلْمِ وَالْإِيمَانِ الْخَافِضُ لِأَعْدَائِهِ، وَهُوَ الْمُعِزُّ لِأَهْلِ طَاعَتِهِ، وَهَذَا عِزٌّ حَقِيقِيٌّ، فَإِنَّ الْمُطِيعَ لِلَّهِ عَزِيزٌ وَإِنْ كَانَ فَقِيرًا لَيْسَ لَهُ أَعْوَانٌ، الْمُذِلُّ لِأَهْلِ مَعْصِيَتِهِ، وَأَعْدَائِهِ ذُلًّا فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ فَالْعَاصِي وَإِنْ ظَهَرَ بِمَظَاهِرِ الْعِزِّ فَقَلْبُهُ حَشْوُهُ الذُّلُّ وَإِنْ لَمْ يَشْعُرْ بِهِ لِانْغِمَاسِهِ فِي الشَّهَوَاتِ فَإِنَّ الْعِزَّ كُلَّ الْعِزِّ بِطَاعَةِ اللَّهِ، وَالذُّلَّ بِمَعْصِيَتِهِ ﴿وَمَنْ يُهِنِ اللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُ مِنْ مُكْرِمٍ﴾ ﴿مَنْ كَانَ يُرِيدُ الْعِزَّةَ فَلِلَّهِ الْعِزَّةُ جَمِيعاً﴾ ﴿وَلِلَّهِ الْعِزَّةُ وَلِرَسُولِهِ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ وَهُوَ تَعَالَى الْمَانِعُ الْمُعْطِي فَلَا مُعْطِيَ لِمَا مَنَعَ وَلَا مَانِعَ لِمَا أَعْطَى وَهُوَ تَعَالَى النَّافِعُ لِمَنْ شَاءَ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ بِالْمَنَافِعِ الدِّينِيَّةِ وَالدُّنْيَوِيَّةِ، الضَّارُّ لِمَنْ فَعَلَ الْأَسْبَابَ الَّتِي تُوجِبُ ذَلِكَ.
وَهَذِهِ الْأُمُورُ كُلُّهَا تَبَعٌ لِعَدْلِهِ، وَحِكْمَتِهِ، وَحَمْدِهِ، فَإِنَّ لَهُ الْحِكْمَةَ فِي خَفْضِ مَنْ يَخْفِضُهُ، وَيُذِلُّهُ، وَيَحْرِمُهُ، وَلَا حُجَّةَ لِأَحَدٍ عَلَى اللَّهِ، كَمَا لَهُ الْفَضْلُ الْخَفِيُّ عَلَى مَنْ رَفَعَهُ وَأَعْطَاهُ وَيَبْسُطُ لَهُ الْخَيْرَاتِ.
فَعَلَى الْعَبْدِ أَنْ يَعْتَرِفَ بِحِكْمَةِ اللَّهِ، كَمَا عَلَيْهِ أَنْ يَعْتَرِفَ بِفَضْلِهِ وَيَشْكُرَهُ بِلِسَانِهِ وَجَنَانِهِ وَأَرْكَانِهِ.
وَكَمَا أَنَّهُ هُوَ الْمُنْفَرِدُ بِهَذِهِ الْأُمُورِ كُلُّهَا جَارِيَةٌ تَحْتَ أَقْدَارِهِ، فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ جَعَلَ لِرَفْعِهِ وَعَطَائِهِ وَإِكْرَامِهِ أَسْبَابًا، وَلِضِدِّ ذَلِكَ أَسْبَابًا مَنْ قَامَ بِهَا تَرَتَّبَتْ عَلَيْهِ مُسَبَّبَاتُهَا، وَكُلٌّ مُيَسَّرٌ لِمَا خُلِقَ لَهُ أَمَّا أَهْلُ السَّعَادَةِ فَيُيَسَّرُونَ لِعَمَلِ أَهْلِ السَّعَادَةِ، وَأَمَّا أَهْلُ الشَّقَاوَةِ فَيُيَسَّرُونَ لِعَمَلِ أَهْلِ الشَّقَاوَةِ، وَهَذَا يُوجِبُ لِلْعَبْدِ الْقِيَامَ بِتَوْحِيدِ اللَّهِ، وَالِاعْتِمَادَ عَلَى رَبِّهِ فِي حُصُولِ مَا يُحِبُّ، وَيَجْتَهِدُ فِي فِعْلِ الْأَسْبَابِ النَّافِعَةِ فَإِنَّهَا مَحَلُّ حِكْمَةِ اللَّهِ".
summary.en:
He (may Allah have mercy on him) said: "Al-Qabid (the Withholder), Al-Basit (the Extender); Al-Khafid (the Abaser), Ar-Rafi' (the Exalter); Al-Mu'izz (the Giver of honour), Al-Mudhill (the Giver of humiliation); Al-Mani' (the Preventer), Al-Mu'ti (the Giver); Ad-Darr (the Bringer of harm), An-Nafi' (the Bringer of benefit)".
"These noble names are among the names that are paired opposites, by which Allah should not be praised except each one together with the other, because absolute perfection comes from the combination of the two descriptions. So He is the One who withholds provisions, spirits and souls, and the One who extends provisions, mercy and hearts. He is the One who raises the peoples who uphold knowledge and faith, and who lowers His enemies. He is the One who gives honour to the people who obey Him, and this is true honour, for the one who obeys Allah is honoured even if he is poor and has no helpers; and who humiliates the people who disobey Him and His enemies, with humiliation in this world and the Hereafter. So the disobedient one, even if he appears with the outward signs of honour, his heart is filled with humiliation, even if he does not feel it because of his immersion in desires. For honour, all honour, is in obeying Allah, and humiliation is in disobeying Him. ﴾And he whom Allah humiliates - for him there is no bestower of honour﴿ ﴾Whoever desires honour - then to Allah belongs all honour﴿ ﴾And to Allah belongs [all] honour, and to His Messenger, and to the believers﴿. And He, the Exalted, is the Preventer, the Giver: there is no giver of what He withholds, and no preventer of what He gives. And He, the Exalted, is the One who benefits whomever He wills of His servants with religious and worldly benefits, and who harms whoever does the things that bring that about.
All of these matters follow from His justice, His wisdom and His praiseworthiness. For He has wisdom in lowering whomever He lowers, humiliating him and depriving him, and no one has any argument against Allah; just as He has hidden grace towards the one whom He raises and gives, and for whom He extends good things.
So the servant must acknowledge the wisdom of Allah, just as he must acknowledge His grace and thank Him with his tongue, his heart and his limbs.
And just as He alone does all of these things, which run under His decrees, Allah has made causes for His raising, His giving and His honouring, and causes for the opposite of that; whoever carries them out, their effects follow for him. And everyone is facilitated for what he was created for: as for the people of happiness, they are facilitated to do the deeds of the people of happiness, and as for the people of misery, they are facilitated to do the deeds of the people of misery. This requires the servant to uphold the oneness of Allah, to rely upon his Lord for attaining what he loves, and to strive hard in doing the beneficial causes, for they are the place of Allah's wisdom".

lesson.ar: أَنْ يَعْتَرِفَ الْعَبْدُ بِحِكْمَةِ اللَّهِ فِيمَا قَبَضَهُ عَنْهُ، وَبِفَضْلِهِ فِيمَا بَسَطَهُ لَهُ فَيَشْكُرَهُ بِلِسَانِهِ وَجَنَانِهِ وَأَرْكَانِهِ، وَيَعْتَمِدَ عَلَى رَبِّهِ فِي حُصُولِ مَا يُحِبُّ، وَيَجْتَهِدَ فِي فِعْلِ الْأَسْبَابِ النَّافِعَةِ.
lesson.en: Acknowledge Allah's wisdom in what He withholds from you and His grace in what He extends to you, thanking Him with your tongue, heart and limbs; rely on your Lord to obtain what you love, and work hard at the beneficial means.

note.ar: سبق الكلام على هذا الاسم مع اسمه تعالى "الباسط".
note.en: This name has already been discussed together with His name "Al-Basit" (the Extender).

summary.ar:
قَالَ الْمُؤَلِّفُ رَحِمَهُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى: "الْقَرِيبُ أَيْ: هُوَ الْقَرِيبُ مِنْ كُلِّ أَحَدٍ، وَقُرْبُهُ نَوْعَانِ:
قُرْبٌ عَامٌّ مِنْ كُلِّ أَحَدٍ بِعِلْمِهِ، وَخِبْرَتِهِ، وَمُرَاقَبَتِهِ، وَمُشَاهَدَتِهِ، وَاِحَاطَتِهِ وَهُوَ أَقْرَبُ إِلَى الْإِنْسَانِ مِنْ حَبْلِ الْوَرِيدِ.
وَقُرْبٌ خَاصٌّ مِنْ عَابِدِيهِ، وَسَائِلِيهِ، وَمُجِيبِيهِ، وَهُوَ قُرْبٌ يَقْتَضِي الْمَحَبَّةَ، وَالنُّصْرَةَ، وَالتَّأْيِيدَ فِي الْحَرَكَاتِ، وَالسَّكَنَاتِ، وَالْإِجَابَةَ لِلدَّاعِينَ، وَالْقَبُولَ، وَالْإِثَابَةَ.
