وَهُوَ الْمَذْكُورُ فِي قَوْلِهِ تَعَالَى: ﴿وَاسْجُدْ وَاقْتَرِبْ﴾ وَفِي قَوْلِهِ: ﴿إِنَّ رَبِّي قَرِيبٌ مُجِيبٌ﴾ وَفِي قَوْلِهِ ﴿وَإِذَا سَأَلَكَ عِبَادِي عَنِّي فَإِنِّي قَرِيبٌ أُجِيبُ دَعْوَةَ الدَّاعِ إِذَا دَعَانِ﴾ وَهَذَا النَّوْعُ قُرْبٌ يَقْتَضِي اَلْطَافَهُ تَعَالَى، وَإِجَابَتَهُ لِدَعَوَاتِهِمْ، وَتَحْقِيقَهُ لِمُرَادَاتِهِمْ وَلِهَذَا يُقْرَنُ بِاسْمِهِ "الْقَرِيبِ" اسْمُهُ "الْمُجِيبُ" وَهَذَا الْقُرْبُ قُرْبُهُ لَا تُدْرَكُ لَهُ حَقِيقَةٌ، وَإِنَّمَا تُعْلَمُ آثَارُهُ مِنْ لُطْفٍ بِعَبْدِهِ، وَعِنَايَتِهِ بِهِ وَتَوْفِيقِهِ، وَتَسْدِيدِهِ، وَمِنْ آثَارِهِ الْإِجَابَةُ لِلدَّاعِينَ وَالْإِثَابَةُ لِلْعَابِدِينَ".
summary.en:
The author (may Allah have mercy on him) said: "Al-Qarib (the Near), meaning: He is near to everyone, and His nearness is of two kinds:
A general nearness to everyone, by His knowledge, His awareness, His watchfulness, His witnessing and His encompassing; and He is nearer to man than [his] jugular vein.
And a special nearness to those who worship Him, those who ask Him and those who respond to Him. It is a nearness that entails love, support, aid in movements and stillness, answering those who call, acceptance, and reward.
It is what is mentioned in His saying (the Exalted): ﴾But prostrate and draw near﴿, and in His saying: ﴾Indeed, my Lord is near and responsive﴿, and in His saying: ﴾And when My servants ask you concerning Me — indeed I am near. I respond to the invocation of the supplicant when he calls upon Me﴿. This kind is a nearness that entails His kindnesses (the Exalted), His answering their supplications and His fulfilling their wishes. For this reason His name "Al-Mujib" (the Responsive) is paired with His name "Al-Qarib". This nearness is a nearness whose true nature is not grasped; rather, its effects are known: His kindness to His servant, His care for him, His granting him success and keeping him on the right course. And among its effects are answering those who call and rewarding those who worship".

lesson.ar: أَنْ يَتَقَرَّبَ الْعَبْدُ إِلَى رَبِّهِ بِالْعِبَادَةِ وَالسُّجُودِ وَالدُّعَاءِ، كَمَا قَالَ تَعَالَى: وَاسْجُدْ وَاقْتَرِبْ، لِيَحْظَى بِقُرْبِهِ الْخَاصِّ الَّذِي يَقْتَضِي الْمَحَبَّةَ وَالنُّصْرَةَ وَالْإِجَابَةَ.
lesson.en: Draw near to your Lord through worship, prostration and supplication — as He says, «Prostrate and draw near» — so that you may gain His special nearness, which brings His love, His help and His answer.

evidence.text: وَإِذَا سَأَلَكَ عِبَادِي عَنِّي فَإِنِّي قَرِيبٌ أُجِيبُ دَعْوَةَ الدَّاعِ إِذَا دَعَانِ

name: الْقُدُّوسُ
meaning: The Most Holy, Free of All Faults

summary.ar:
قَالَ رَحِمَهُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى: " وَمِنْ أَسْمَائِهِ الْقُدُّوسُ السَّلَامُ، أَيْ: الْمُعَظَّمُ الْمُنَزَّهُ عَنْ صِفَاتِ النَّقْصِ كُلِّهَا وَأَنْ يُمَاثِلَهُ أَحَدٌ مِنَ الْخَلْقِ، فَهُوَ الْمُتَنَزِّهُ عَنْ جَمِيعِ الْعُيُوبِ، وَالْمُتَنَزِّهُ عَنْ أَنْ يُقَارِبَهُ أَوْ يُمَاثِلَهُ أَحَدٌ فِي شَيْءٍ مِنَ الْكَمَالِ ﴿لَيْسَ كَمِثْلِهِ شَيْءٌ﴾ ﴿وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ كُفُواً أَحَدٌ﴾ ﴿هَلْ تَعْلَمُ لَهُ سَمِيّاً﴾ ﴿فَلا تَجْعَلُوا لِلَّهِ أَنْدَاداً﴾ فَالْقُدُّوسُ كَالسَّلَامِ، يَنْفِيَانِ كُلَّ نَقْصٍ مِنْ جَمِيعِ الْوُجُوهِ، وَيَتَضَمَّنَانِ الْكَمَالَ الْمُطْلَقَ مِنْ جَمِيعِ الْوُجُوهِ، لِأَنَّ النَّقْصَ إِذَا انْتَفَى ثَبَتَ الْكَمَالُ كُلُّهُ فَهُوَ الْمُقَدَّسُ الْمُعَظَّمُ الْمُنَزَّهُ عَنْ كُلِّ سُوءٍ، السَّالِمُ مِنْ مُمَاثَلَةِ أَحَدٍ مِنْ خَلْقِهِ وَمِنَ النُّقْصَانِ وَمِنْ كُلِّ مَا يُنَافِي كَمَالَهُ. فَهَذَا ضَابِطُ مَا يُنَزَّهُ عَنْهُ، يُنَزَّهُ عَنْ كُلِّ نَقْصٍ بِوَجْهٍ مِنَ الْوُجُوهِ، وَيُنَزَّهُ وَيُعَظَّمُ أَنْ يَكُونَ لَهُ مَثِيلٌ أَوْ شَبِيهٌ أَوْ كُفْوٌ أَوْ سَمِيٌّ أَوْ نِدٌّ أَوْ مُضَادٌّ، وَيُنَزَّهُ عَنْ نَقْصِ صِفَةٍ مِنْ صِفَاتِهِ الَّتِي هِىَ أَكْمَلُ الصِّفَاتِ وَأَعْظَمُهَا وَأَوْسَعُهَا.
وَمِنْ تَمَامِ تَنْزِيهِهِ عَنْ ذَلِكَ إِثْبَاتُ صِفَاتِ الْكِبْرِيَاءِ وَالْعَظَمَةِ لَهُ فَإِنَّ التَّنْزِيهَ مُرَادٌ لِغَيْرِهِ وَمَقْصُودٌ بِهِ حِفْظُ كَمَالِهِ عَنِ الظُّنُونِ السَّيِّئَةِ كَظَنِّ الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ الَّذِينَ يَظُنُّونَ بِهِ ظَنَّ السَّوْءِ، ظَنَّ غَيْرِ مَا يَلِيقُ بِجَلَالِهِ وَإِذَا قَالَ الْعَبْدُ مُثْنِياً عَلَى رَبِّهِ "سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ" أَوْ "تَقَدَّسَ اللَّهُ" أَوْ "تَعَالَى اللَّهُ" وَنَحْوَهَا كَانَ مُثْنِياً عَلَيْهِ بِالسَّلَامَةِ مِنْ كُلِّ نَقْصٍ وَإِثْبَاتِ كُلِّ كَمَالٍ ".
summary.en:
He (may Allah have mercy on him) said: " Among His names are Al-Quddus (the Most Holy) and As-Salam (the Perfect, free of all defects), meaning: the One who is magnified and exalted above all attributes of deficiency, and above anyone of the creation resembling Him. He is free from all faults, and free from anyone approaching or resembling Him in anything of perfection. ﴾There is nothing like unto Him﴿ ﴾Nor is there to Him any equivalent﴿ ﴾Do you know of any similarity to Him?﴿ ﴾So do not attribute to Allah equals﴿. So Al-Quddus is like As-Salam: both negate every deficiency in every respect, and both include absolute perfection in every respect, because when deficiency is negated, perfection in its entirety is established. He is the Holy, the Magnified, the One exalted above every evil, the One safe from resembling any of His creation, from deficiency, and from all that contradicts His perfection. This is the rule for what He is declared free of: He is declared free of every deficiency in any respect whatsoever; He is declared free of, and too great for, having a like, a resemblance, an equal, a namesake, a rival or an opposite; and He is declared free of deficiency in any of His attributes, which are the most perfect, the greatest and the most vast of attributes.
Part of the completeness of declaring Him free of that is affirming for Him the attributes of grandeur and greatness, for declaring [Him] free [of imperfection] is intended for something else, and its purpose is to preserve His perfection from evil suppositions, like the supposition of the people of ignorance who think of Him an evil thought — a thought other than what befits His majesty. When the servant, praising his Lord, says "Glory be to Allah", "Holy is Allah", "Exalted is Allah" and the like, he is praising Him with freedom from every deficiency and the affirmation of every perfection ".

lesson.ar: أَنْ يُنَزِّهَ الْعَبْدُ رَبَّهُ عَنْ كُلِّ نَقْصٍ وَعَنْ مُمَاثَلَةِ خَلْقِهِ، وَيُكْثِرَ مِنَ التَّسْبِيحِ وَالتَّقْدِيسِ مُسْتَحْضِرًا مَعْنَاهُ، وَيَحْذَرَ مِنْ ظَنِّ السَّوْءِ بِرَبِّهِ.
lesson.en: Declare your Lord free of every deficiency and of any likeness to His creation, glorify Him often while keeping the meaning in mind, and beware of thinking ill of your Lord.

evidence.text: هُوَ اللَّهُ الَّذِي لا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْمَلِكُ الْقُدُّوسُ السَّلام ...

note.ar: سبق الكلام على هذا الاسم مع اسمه تعالى "السلام".
note.en: This name has already been discussed together with His name "As-Salam" (the Source of Peace).

summary.ar: قَالَ رَحِمَهُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى: "الْقَدِيرُ: كَامِلُ الْقُدْرَةِ بِقُدْرَتِهِ أَوْجَدَ الْمَوْجُودَاتِ، وَبِقُدْرَتِهِ دَبَّرَهَا، بِقُدْرَتِهِ سَوَّاهَا وَأَحْكَمَهَا، وَبِقُدْرَتِهِ يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ، وَيَبْعَثُ الْعِبَادَ لِلْجَزَاءِ، وَيُجَازِي الْمُحْسِنَ بِإِحْسَانِهِ، وَالْمُسِيءَ بِإِسَاءَتِهِ، الَّذِي إِذَا أَرَادَ شَيْئاً قَالَ لَهُ: كُنْ فَيَكُونُ، وَبِقُدْرَتِهِ يُقَلِّبُ الْقُلُوبَ وَيُصَرِّفُهَا عَلَى مَايَشَاءُ وَيُرِيدُ".
summary.en: He (may Allah have mercy on him) said: "Al-Qadir (the All-Powerful): perfect in power. By His power He brought all existing things into existence; by His power He manages them; by His power He fashioned them and perfected them; by His power He gives life and causes death, and resurrects the servants for recompense, rewarding the doer of good for his good and the doer of evil for his evil; the One who, when He wills a thing, says to it: Be, and it is; and by His power He turns hearts about and directs them however He wills and wants".

lesson.ar: أَنْ يَسْأَلَ الْعَبْدُ رَبَّهُ الْقَدِيرَ أَنْ يُثَبِّتَ قَلْبَهُ عَلَى دِينِهِ، فَإِنَّهُ يُقَلِّبُ الْقُلُوبَ وَيُصَرِّفُهَا كَيْفَ يَشَاءُ، وَلَا يَسْتَعْظِمَ عَلَيْهِ شَيْئًا يَطْلُبُهُ، فَإِنَّهُ إِذَا أَرَادَ شَيْئًا قَالَ لَهُ: كُنْ فَيَكُونُ.
lesson.en: Ask your All-Powerful Lord to keep your heart firm upon His religion, for He turns hearts as He wills, and never think anything you ask of Him is too great, for when He wills a thing He only says to it «Be», and it is.

evidence.text: وَاللَّهُ قَدِيرٌ وَاللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ

note.ar: قال الله تعالى: ﴿وَاللَّهُ قَدِيرٌ وَاللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ﴾ (الممتحنة: ٧). وسبق زيادة إيضاح لهذا الإسم مع اسمه تعالى "العزيز".
note.en: Allah the Exalted said: ﴾And Allah is competent, and Allah is Forgiving and Merciful﴿ (Al-Mumtahanah: 7). This name has already been explained further together with His name "Al-'Aziz" (the Almighty).

summary.ar:
قَالَ رَحِمَهُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى: "الْقَهَّارُ: لِجَمِيعِ الْعَالَمِ الْعُلْوِيِّ، وَالسُّفْلِيِّ، الْقَهَّارُ لِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ الَّذِي خَضَعَتْ لَهُ الْمَخْلُوقَاتُ وَذَلِكَ لِعِزَّتِهِ وَقُوَّتِهِ، وَكَمَالِ اقْتِدَارِهِ.
وَهُوَ الَّذِي قَهَرَ جَمِيعَ الْكَائِنَاتِ، وَذَلَّتْ لَهُ جَمِيعُ الْمَخْلُوقَاتِ أَوْ دَانَتْ لِقُدْرَتِهِ، وَمَشِيئَتِهِ مَوَادُّ وَعَنَاصِرُ الْعَالَمِ الْعُلْوِيِّ وَالسُّفْلِىِّ، فَلَا يَحْدُثُ حَادِثٌ، وَلَا يَسْكُنُ سَاكِنٌ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِ، وَمَا شَاءَ كَانَ، وَمَا لَمْ يَشَأْ لَمْ يَكُنْ، وَجَمِيعُ الْخَلْقِ فُقَرَاءُ إِلَى اللَّهِ عَاجِزُونَ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ لِأَنْفُسِهِمْ نَفْعاً، وَلَا ضَرّاً، وَلَا خَيْراً، وَلَا شَرّاً ثُمَّ إِنَّ قَهْرَهُ مُسْتَلْزِمٌ لِحَيَاتِهِ وَعِزَّتِهِ وَقُدْرَتِهِ، فَلَا يَتِمُّ قَهْرُهُ لِلْخَلِيقَةِ إِلَّا بِاِتْمَامِ حَيَاتِهِ، وَقُوَّةِ عِزَّتِهِ، وَاقْتِدَارِهِ".
summary.en:
He (may Allah have mercy on him) said: "Al-Qahhar (the Subduer): of the entire upper and lower worlds; the Subduer of everything, to whom the created things have submitted — and that is because of His might, His strength and His perfect power.
He is the One who has subdued all beings, and all created things have been humbled before Him, and the substances and elements of the upper and lower worlds have yielded to His power and His will. Nothing occurs and nothing becomes still except by His permission. Whatever He wills happens, and whatever He does not will does not happen. All of the creation are in need of Allah, incapable; they possess for themselves neither benefit nor harm, neither good nor evil. Moreover, His subduing necessarily entails His life, His might and His power, for His subduing of the creation is not complete except through the completeness of His life, the strength of His might, and His power".

lesson.ar: أَنْ يَعْلَمَ الْعَبْدُ أَنَّ الْخَلْقَ كُلَّهُمْ فُقَرَاءُ عَاجِزُونَ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ لِأَنْفُسِهِمْ نَفْعًا وَلَا ضَرًّا، فَلَا يَخَافُهُمْ وَلَا يَرْجُوهُمْ، وَيَخْضَعَ لِلْقَهَّارِ وَحْدَهُ وَيَتَوَكَّلَ عَلَيْهِ.
lesson.en: Know that all creatures are poor and helpless, owning no benefit or harm even for themselves, so neither fear them nor pin your hopes on them; submit to Al-Qahhar alone and rely on Him.

evidence.text: قُلِ اللَّهُ خَالِقُ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَهُوَ الْوَاحِدُ الْقَهَّارُ

summary.ar:
قَالَ رَحِمَهُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى: "هَذِهِ الْأَسْمَاءُ الْعَظِيمَةُ مَعَانِيهَا مُتَقَارِبَةٌ فَهُوَ تَعَالَى كَامِلُ الْقُوَّةِ عَظِيمُ الْقُدْرَةِ شَامِلُ الْعِزَّةِ ﴿إِنَّ الْعِزَّةَ لِلَّهِ جَمِيعاً﴾.
الْعَزِيزُ الَّذِي لَهُ الْعِزَّةُ كُلُّهَا عِزَّةُ الْقُوَّةِ، وَعِزَّةُ الْغَلَبَةِ وَعِزَّةُ الِامْتِنَاعِ، فَمُمْتَنِعٌ أَنْ يَنَالَهُ أَحَدٌ مِنَ الْمَخْلُوقَاتِ وَقَهَرَ جَمِيعَ الْمَوْجُودَاتِ، وَدَانَتْ لَهُ الْخَلِيقَةُ وَخَضَعَتْ لِعَظَمَتِهِ.
فَمَعَانِي الْعِزَّةِ الثَّلَاثُ كُلُّهَا كَامِلَةٌ لِلَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ عِزَّةُ الْقُوَّةِ الدَّالُّ عَلَيْهَا مِنْ أَسْمَائِهِ الْقَوِيُّ الْمَتِينُ، وَهِيَ وَصْفُهُ الْعَظِيمُ الَّذِي لَا تُنْسَبُ إِلَيْهِ قُوَّةُ الْمَخْلُوقَاتِ وَإِنْ عَظُمَتْ، وَعِزَّةُ الِامْتِنَاعِ فَإِنَّهُ هُوَ الْغَنِيُّ بِذَاتِهِ فَلَا يَحْتَاجُ إِلَى أَحَدٍ، وَلَا يَبْلُغُ الْعِبَادُ ضَرَّةْ فَيَضُرُّونَهُ، وَلَا نَفْعَهُ فَيَنْفَعُونَهُ بَلْ هُوَ الضَّارُّ النَّافِعُ الْمُعْطِي الْمَانِعُ، وَعِزَّةُ الْقَهْرِ وَالْغَلَبَةِ لِكُلِّ الْكَائِنَاتِ فَهِيَ كُلُّهَا مَقْصُورَةٌ لِلَّهِ خَاضِعَةٌ لِعَظَمَتِهِ مُنْقَادَةٌ لِإِرَادَتِهِ، فَجَمِيعُ نَوَاصِي الْمَخْلُوقَاتِ بِيَدِهِ، لَا يَتَحَرَّكُ مِنْهَا مُتَحَرِّكٌ وَلَا يَتَصَرَّفُ مُتَصَرِّفٌ إِلَّا بِحَوْلِهِ وَقُوَّتِهِ وَإِذْنِهِ، فَمَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ كَانَ، وَمَا لَمْ يَشَأْ لَمْ يَكُنْ، وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِهِ، فَمِنْ قُوَّتِهِ وَاقْتِدَارِهِ أَنَّهُ خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ، وَالْأَرْضَ، وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِي سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ، وَأَنَّهُ خَلَقَ الْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ يُمِيتُهُمْثُمَّ يُحْيِيهِمْ ثُمَّ إِلَيْهِ يُرْجَعُونَ ﴿مَا خَلْقُكُمْ وَلا بَعْثُكُمْ إلا كَنَفْسٍ وَاحِدَةٍ﴾. ﴿وَهُوَ الَّذِي يَبْدأُ الْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُ وَهُوَ أَهْوَنُ عَلَيْه﴾ وَمِنْ آثَارِ قُدْرَتِهِ أَنَّكَ تَرَى الْأَرْضَ هَامِدَةً، فَإِذَا أَنْزَلَ عَلَيْهَا الْمَاءَ اعْتَزَّتْ وَرَبَتْ وَأَنْبَتَتْ مِنْ كُلِّ زَوْجٍ بَهِيجٍ، وَمِنْ آثَارِ قُدْرَتِهِ مَا أَوْقَعَهُ بِالْأُمَمِ الْمُكَذِّبِينَ، وَالْكُفَّارِ الظَّالِمِينَ مِنْ أَنْوَاعِ الْعُقُوبَاتِ وَحُلُولِ الْمَثُلَاتِ، وَأَنَّهُ لَمْ يُغْنِ عَنْهُمْ كَيْدُهُمْ، وَمَكْرُهُمْ، وَلَا أَمْوَالُهُمْ، وَلَا جُنُودُهُمْ، وَلَا حُصُونُهُمْ مِنْ عَذَابِ اللَّهِ مِنْ شَيْءٍ لَمَّا جَاءَ أَمْرُ رَبِّكَ، وَمَا زَادُوهُمْ غَيْرَ تَتْبِيبٍ، وَخُصُوصاً فِي هَذِهِ الْأَوْقَاتِ فَإِنَّ هَذِهِ الْقُوَّةَ الْهَائِلَةَ، وَالْمُخْتَرَعَاتِ الْبَاهِرَةَ الَّتِي وَصَلَتْ إِلَيْهَا مَقْدِرَةُ هَذِهِ الْأُمَمِ هِيَ مِنْ أِقْدَارِ اللَّهِ لَهُمْ وَتَعْلِيمِهِ لَهُمْ، مَا لَمْ يَكُونُوا يَعْلَمُونَهُ، فَمِنْ آيَاتِ اللَّهِ أَنَّ قُوَاهُمْ، وَقُدَرَهُمْ وَمُخْتَرَعَاتِهِمْ لَمْ تُغْنِ عَنْهُمْ شَيْئاً فِي صَدِّ مَا أَصَابَهُمْ مِنَ النَّكَبَاتِ، وَالْعُقُوبَاتِ الْمُهْلِكَةِ مَعَ بَذْلِ جِدِّهِمْ وَاجْتِهَادِهِمْ فِي تَوَقِّي ذَلِكَ، وَلَكِنَّ أَمْرَ اللَّهِ غَالِبٌ، وَقُدْرَتُهُ تَنْقَادُ لَهَا عَنَاصِرُ الْعَالَمِ الْعُلْوِيِّ، وَالسُّفْلِيِّ.
وَمِنْ تَمَامِ عِزَّتِهِ وَقُدْرَتِهِ وَشُمُولِهِمَا أَنَّهُ كَمَا أَنَّهُ هُوَ الْخَالِقُ لِلْعِبَادِ فَهُوَ خَالِقُ أَعْمَالِهِمْ وَطَاعَتِهِمْ وَمَعَاصِيهِمْ، وَهِيَ أَيْضاً أَفْعَالُهُمْ، فَهِيَ تُضَافُ إِلَى اللَّهِ خَلْقاً وَتَقْدِيراً وَتُضَافُ إِلَيْهِمْ فِعْلاً وَمُبَاشَرَةً عَلَى الْحَقِيقَةِ وَلَا مُنَافَاةَ بَيْنَ الْأَمْرَيْنِ، فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ خَالِقُ قُدْرَتِهِمْ وَإِرَادَتِهِمْ، وَخَالِقُ السَّبَبِ التَّامِّ خَالِقٌ لِلْمُسَبَّبِ قَالَ تَعَالَى: ﴿وَاللَّهُ خَلَقَكُمْ وَمَا تَعْمَلُونَ﴾.
وَمِنْ آثَارِ قُدْرَتِهِ مَا ذَكَرَهُ فِي كِتَابِهِ مِنْ نُصْرَةِ أَوْلِيَاءِهِ عَلَى قِلَّةِ عَدَدِهِمْ وَعُدَدِهِمْ عَلَى أَعْدَائِهِمُ الَّذِينَ فَاقُوهُمْ بِكَثْرَةِ الْعَدَدِ، وَالْعُدَّةِ، قَالَ تَعَالَى: ﴿كَمْ مِنْ فِئَةٍ قَلِيلَةٍ غَلَبَتْ فِئَةً كَثِيرَةً بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ﴾.
وَمِنْ آثَارِ قُدْرَتِهِ وَرَحْمَتِهِ مَا يُحْدِثُهُ لِأَهْلِ النَّارِ، وَأَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ مِنْ أَنْوَاعِ الْعِقَابِ، وَأَصْنَافِ النَّعِيمِ الْمُسْتَمِرِّ الْكَثِيرِ الْمُتَتَابِعِ الَّذِي لَا يَنْقَطِعُ، وَلَا يَتَنَاهَى".
summary.en:
He (may Allah have mercy on him) said: "These great names have closely related meanings. He, the Exalted, is perfect in strength, great in power, all-encompassing in might: ﴾Indeed, might belongs to Allah entirely﴿.
Al-'Aziz (the Almighty) is the One to whom belongs all might: the might of strength, the might of dominance, and the might of being unassailable. So it is impossible for any created being to reach Him; He has subdued all existing things, and the creation has submitted to Him and humbled itself before His greatness.
So the three meanings of might are all perfect for Allah, the Great: the might of strength, which is indicated among His names by Al-Qawi (the Strong) and Al-Matin (the Firm), and it is His great attribute to which the strength of created beings bears no comparison, however great it may be; the might of being unassailable, for He is the One free of need by His very Self, so He needs no one, and the servants cannot attain harming Him so as to harm Him, nor benefiting Him so as to benefit Him — rather He is the One who harms and benefits, who gives and withholds; and the might of subjugation and dominance over all beings, for they are all subjugated to Allah, submissive to His greatness, yielding to His will. The forelocks of all created beings are in His hand; nothing moves among them and nothing acts except by His might, His strength and His permission. Whatever Allah wills happens, and whatever He does not will does not happen, and there is no might nor power except by Him. Part of His strength and power is that He created the heavens, the earth and what is between them in six days, and that He created the creation, then He causes them to die, then gives them life, then to Him they return: ﴾Your creation and your resurrection will not be but as that of a single soul﴿. ﴾And it is He who begins creation; then He repeats it, and that is [even] easier for Him﴿ Among the effects of His power is that you see the earth barren, and when He sends down rain upon it, it quivers and swells and grows [something] of every beautiful kind. Among the effects of His power is what He inflicted upon the nations who denied and the wrongdoing disbelievers of various punishments and exemplary chastisements, and that neither their scheming, nor their plotting, nor their wealth, nor their soldiers, nor their fortresses availed them anything against the punishment of Allah when the command of your Lord came, and they did not increase them other than ruin. This is especially so in these times: this tremendous strength and these dazzling inventions which the capability of these nations has reached are from Allah's enabling them and His teaching them what they did not know. And among the signs of Allah is that their strengths, their capabilities and their inventions did not avail them anything in warding off the disasters and destructive punishments that befell them, despite their exerting their utmost effort and striving to guard against that. But the command of Allah prevails, and the elements of the upper and lower worlds submit to His power.
Part of the completeness and all-inclusiveness of His might and power is that, just as He is the Creator of the servants, He is the Creator of their deeds, their acts of obedience and their acts of disobedience — and they are also their [own] actions. So they are ascribed to Allah in terms of creation and decree, and ascribed to them in terms of doing and carrying out, in reality, and there is no contradiction between the two matters. For Allah is the Creator of their ability and their will, and the Creator of the complete cause is the Creator of the effect. The Exalted said: ﴾While Allah created you and that which you do﴿.
Among the effects of His power is what He mentioned in His Book of His giving victory to His allies, despite their small number and scant equipment, over their enemies who surpassed them in great numbers and equipment. The Exalted said: ﴾How many a small company has overcome a large company by permission of Allah﴿.
Among the effects of His power and His mercy is what He brings about for the people of the Fire and the people of Paradise: kinds of punishment, and varieties of bliss that is lasting, abundant and continuous, that is neither cut off nor comes to an end".

lesson.ar: أَلَّا يَغْتَرَّ الْعَبْدُ بِقُوَّةِ الْمَخْلُوقِينَ وَمُخْتَرَعَاتِهِمْ وَإِنْ عَظُمَتْ، فَإِنَّهَا لَا تُغْنِي عَنْهُمْ مِنْ أَمْرِ اللَّهِ شَيْئًا، وَأَنْ يَعْتَمِدَ عَلَى رَبِّهِ الْقَوِيِّ وَيُكْثِرَ مِنْ قَوْلِ: لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ.
lesson.en: Never be dazzled by the strength and inventions of people, however great, for they cannot protect them from Allah's command; rely on your Strong Lord and say often «La hawla wa la quwwata illa billah» (there is no power and no strength except by Allah).

evidence.text: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ الْقَوِيُّ الْعَزِيزُ

note.ar: سبق الكلام على هذا الاسم مع اسمه تعالى "العزيز".
note.en: This name has already been discussed together with His name "Al-'Aziz" (the Almighty).

summary.ar:
قَالَ رَحِمَهُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى: "الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ كَامِلُ الْحَيَاةِ وَالْقَائِمُ بِنَفْسِهِ.
الْقَيُّومُ لِأَهْلِ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ الْقَائِمُ بِتَدْبِيرِهِمْ وَأَرْزَاقِهِمْ وَجَمِيعِ أَحْوَالِهِمْ فَالْحَيُّ: الْجَامِعُ لِصِفَاتِ الذَّاتِ، وَالْقَيُّومُ: الْجَامِعُ لِصِفَاتِ الْأَفْعَالِ وَجَمْعُهُمَا فِي غَايَةِ الْمُنَاسَبَةِ كَمَا جَمَعَهُمَا اللَّهُ فِي عِدَّةِ مَوَاضِعَ مِنْ كِتَابِهِ كَقَوْلِهِ: ﴿اللَّهُ لا إِلَهَ إِلا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّوم﴾، وَذَلِكَ أَنَّهُمَا مُحْتَوِيَانِ عَلَى جَمِيعِ صِفَاتِ الْكَمَالِ، فَالْحَيُّ هُوَ كَامِلُ الْحَيَاةِ، وَذَلِكَ يَتَضَمَّنُ جَمِيعَ الصِّفَاتِ الذَّاتِيَّةِ لِلَّهِ كَالْعِلْمِ وَالْعِزَّةِ وَالْقُدْرَةِ، وَالْإِرَادَةِ، وَالْعَظَمَةِ، وَالْكِبْرِيَاءِ، وَغَيْرِهَا مِنْ صِفَاتِ الذَّاتِ الْمُقَدَّسَةِ.
وَالْقَيُّومُ هُوَ كَامِلُ الْقَيُّومِيَّةِ الَّذِي قَامَ بِنَفْسِهِ، وَعَظُمَتْ صِفَاتُهُ، وَاسْتَغْنَى عَنْ جَمِيعِ مَخْلُوقَاتِهِ، وَقَامَتْ بِهِ الْأَرْضُ، وَالسَّمَاوَاتُ، وَمَا فِيهِمَا مِنَ الْمَخْلُوقَاتِ، فَهُوَ الَّذِي أَوْجَدَهَا، وَأَمَدَّهَا، وَأَعَدَّهَا لِكُلِّ مَا فِيهِ بَقَاؤُهَا، وَصَلَاحُهَا، وَقِيَامُهَا، فَهُوَ الْغَنِيُّ عَنْهَا مِنْ كُلِّ وَجْهٍ، وَهِيَ الَّتِي افْتَقَرَتْ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ كُلِّ وَجْهٍ، فَالْحَيُّ، وَالْقَيُّومُ مَنْ لَهُ صِفَةُ كُلِّ كَمَالٍ، وَهُوَ الْفَعَّالُ لِمَا يُرِيدُ الَّذِي إِذَا أَرَادَ شَيْئاً قَالَ لَهُ كُنْ فَيَكُونُ، وَكُلُّ الصِّفَاتِ الْفِعْلِيَّةِ، وَالْمَجْدُ، وَالْعَظَمَةُ، وَالْجَلَالُ تَرْجِعُ إِلَى اسْمِهِ الْقَيُّومِ، وَمَرْجِعُ صِفَاتِ الْكَمَالِ كُلُّهَا تَرْجِعُ إِلَى هَذَيْنِ الِاسْمَيْنِ الْكَرِيمَيْنِ، وَلِذَلِكَ وَرَدَ الْحَدِيثُ أَنَّ اسْمَ اللَّهِ الْأَعْظَمَ الَّذِي إِذَا دُعِيَ بِهِ أَجَابَ، وَإِذَا سُئِلَ بِهِ أَعْطَى ﴿اللَّهُ لا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ﴾ لِاشْتِمَالِهِمَا عَلَى جَمِيعِ الْكَمَالَاتِ.
فَصِفَاتُ الذَّاتِ تَرْجِعُ إِلَى الْحَيِّ، وَمَعَانِي الْأَفْعَالِ تَرْجِعُ إِلَى الْقَيُّومِ".
summary.en:
He (may Allah have mercy on him) said: "Al-Hayy Al-Qayyum (the Ever-Living, the Self-Subsisting Sustainer of all): perfect in life, and subsisting by Himself.
Al-Qayyum for the inhabitants of the heavens and the earth, the One who undertakes the management of their affairs, their provision and all their conditions. So Al-Hayy comprises the attributes of the Essence, and Al-Qayyum comprises the attributes of action, and combining them is extremely fitting, just as Allah combined them in several places in His Book, such as His saying: ﴾Allah - there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of [all] existence﴿. That is because they contain all the attributes of perfection. Al-Hayy is the One perfect in life, and that includes all the essential attributes of Allah, such as knowledge, might, power, will, greatness, grandeur, and other attributes of the holy Essence.
And Al-Qayyum is the One perfect in self-subsistence, who subsists by Himself, whose attributes are great, who is free of need of all His creations, and by whom the earth and the heavens and the creations in them subsist. He is the One who brought them into existence, sustained them, and prepared them for everything in which lies their continuance, their soundness and their subsistence. He is free of need of them in every respect, and they are in need of Him in every respect. So Al-Hayy and Al-Qayyum is the One who has the attribute of every perfection, and He is the Doer of whatever He wills, who, when He wills a thing, says to it 'Be' and it is. All the attributes of action, glory, greatness and majesty return to His name Al-Qayyum, and all the attributes of perfection return to these two noble names. For this reason the hadith has come that the greatest name of Allah, by which, when He is called upon, He answers, and when He is asked, He gives, is ﴾Allah - there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of [all] existence﴿, because they comprise all perfections.
So the attributes of the Essence return to Al-Hayy, and the meanings of the actions return to Al-Qayyum".

lesson.ar: أَنْ يَسْتَشْعِرَ الْعَبْدُ افْتِقَارَهُ إِلَى رَبِّهِ الْقَيُّومِ فِي كُلِّ أَحْوَالِهِ، وَيَدْعُوَهُ بِهَذَيْنِ الِاسْمَيْنِ الْكَرِيمَيْنِ، إِذْ وَرَدَ أَنَّ فِيهِمَا اسْمَهُ الْأَعْظَمَ الَّذِي إِذَا دُعِيَ بِهِ أَجَابَ وَإِذَا سُئِلَ بِهِ أَعْطَى.
lesson.en: Feel your need of Al-Qayyum in every situation, and call on Him by these two noble names, since it is reported that Allah's Greatest Name — by which He answers when called and gives when asked — is found in them.

evidence.text: اللَّهُ لا إِلَهَ إِلا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّوم

note.ar: سبق الكلام على هذا الاسم مع اسمه تعالى "الحي".
note.en: This name has already been discussed together with His name "Al-Hayy" (the Ever-Living).

summary.ar: قَالَ رَحِمَهُ تَعَالَى: "الْكَافِي عِبَادَهُ جَمِيعَ مَا يَحْتَاجُونَ وَيَضْطَرُّونَ إِلَيْهِ. الْكَافِي كِفَايَةً خَاصَّةً مَنْ آمَنَ بِهِ وَتَوَكَّلَ عَلَيْهِ وَاسْتَمَدَّ مِنْهُ حَوَائِجَ دِينِهِ وَدُنْيَاهُ".
summary.en: He (may Allah have mercy on him) said: "Al-Kafi (the Sufficient): who suffices His servants in all they need and are compelled to. Al-Kafi, with a special sufficiency, for whoever believes in Him, relies upon Him, and seeks from Him the needs of his religion and his worldly life".

lesson.ar: أَنْ يُؤْمِنَ الْعَبْدُ بِرَبِّهِ وَيَتَوَكَّلَ عَلَيْهِ وَيَسْتَمِدَّ مِنْهُ حَوَائِجَ دِينِهِ وَدُنْيَاهُ، لِيَنَالَ كِفَايَتَهُ الْخَاصَّةَ.
lesson.en: Believe in your Lord, rely on Him, and seek from Him all you need for your religion and your worldly life, so that you receive His special sufficiency.

note.ar: لم أقف على نص يدل على تسمية الله تعالى بالكافي.
note.en: I have not found a text naming Allah the Exalted "Al-Kafi".

summary.ar: قَالَ رَحِمَهُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى: " الْكَبِيرُ: الَّذِي لَهُ الْكِبْرِيَاءُ فِي ذَاتِهِ، وَصِفَاتِهِ وَلَهُ الْكِبْرِيَاءُ فِي قُلُوبِ أَهْلِ السَّمَاءِ، وَالْأَرْضِ".
summary.en: He (may Allah have mercy on him) said: " Al-Kabir (the Great): to whom belongs grandeur in His Self and His attributes, and to whom belongs grandeur in the hearts of the people of the heaven and the earth".

lesson.ar: أَنْ يَمْلَأَ الْعَبْدُ قَلْبَهُ بِتَعْظِيمِ رَبِّهِ وَإِجْلَالِهِ وَالْخُضُوعِ لَهُ وَالتَّذَلُّلِ لِكِبْرِيَائِهِ، وَيَحْذَرَ مِنْ مُنَازَعَتِهِ الْكِبْرِيَاءَ، فَإِنَّهَا لَهُ وَحْدَهُ.
lesson.en: Fill your heart with glorifying and revering your Lord, submitting to Him and humbling yourself before His greatness, and beware of any arrogance, for supreme greatness belongs to Him alone.

evidence.text: عَالِمُ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ الْكَبِيرُ الْمُتَعَالِ

summary.ar: قَالَ رَحِمَهُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى: "الْكَرِيمُ: كَثِيرُ الْخَيْرِ يَعُمُّ بِهِ الشَّاكِرَ، وَالْكَافِرَ، إِلَّا أَنَّ شُكْرَ نِعَمِهِ دَاعٍ لِلْمَزِيدِ مِنْهَا، وَكُفْرَهَا دَاعٍ لِزَوَالِهَا".
summary.en: He (may Allah have mercy on him) said: "Al-Karim (the Generous): abundant in good, with which He covers both the grateful and the ungrateful; except that gratitude for His favours calls for their increase, and ingratitude for them calls for their removal".

lesson.ar: أَنْ يَشْكُرَ الْعَبْدُ نِعَمَ رَبِّهِ الْكَرِيمِ لِتَدُومَ وَتَزِيدَ، وَلَا يَكْفُرَهَا فَتَزُولَ، وَيَسْأَلَهُ رَحْمَتَهُ الْخَاصَّةَ بِالتَّوْفِيقِ لِلْإِيمَانِ وَالْعِلْمِ وَالْعَمَلِ.
lesson.en: Thank your Generous Lord for His blessings so they last and increase, never be ungrateful lest they vanish, and ask Him for His special mercy: success in faith, knowledge and good deeds.

evidence.text: وَمَنْ شَكَرَ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِ وَمَنْ كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ رَبِّي غَنِيٌّ كَرِيمٌ

summary.ar:
قَالَ الْمُؤَلِّفُ رَحِمَهُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى: "وَمِنْ أَسْمَائِهِ الْحُسْنَى "اللَّطِيفُ": الَّذِي لَطُفَ عِلْمُهُ حَتَّى أَدْرَكَ الْخَفَايَا، وَالْخَبَايَا، وَمَا احْتَوَتْ عَلَيْهِ الصُّدُورُ، وَمَا فِي الْأَرَاضِي مِنْ خَفَايَا الْبُذُورِ وَلَطَفَ بِأَوْلِيَائِهِ، وَأَصْفِيَائِهِ، فَيَسَّرَهُمْ لِلْيُسْرَى وَجَنَّبَهُمُ الْعُسْرَى، وَسَهَّلَ لَهُمْ كُلَّ طَرِيقٍ يُوصِلُ إِلَى مَرْضَاتِهِ وَكَرَامَتِهِ وَحَفِظَهُمْ مِنْ كُلِّ سَبَبٍ وَوَسِيلَةٍ تُوصِلُ إِلَى سَخَطِهِ، مِنْ طُرُقٍ يَشْعُرُونَ بِهَا، وَمِنْ طُرُقٍ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ بِهَا، وَقَدَّرَ عَلَيْهِمْ أُمُوراً يَكْرَهُونَهَا لِيُنِيلَهُمْ مَا يُحِبُّونَ، فَلَطَفَ بِهِمْ فِي أَنْفُسِهِمْ فَأَجْرَاهُمْ عَلَى عَوَائِدِهِ الْجَمِيلَةِ، وَصَنَائِعِهِ الْكَرِيمَةِ، وَلَطَفَ لَهُمْ فِي أُمُورٍ خَارِجَةٍ عَنْهُمْ لَهُمْ فِيهَا كُلُّ خَيْرٍ وَصَلَاحٍ وَنَجَاحٍ، فَاللَّطِيفُ مُتَقَارِبٌ لِمَعَانِي الْخَبِيرِ، الرَّؤُوفِ، الْكَرِيمِ.
وَمِنْ لُطْفِهِ بِعَبْدِهِ وَوَلِيِّهِ الَّذِي يُرِيدُ أَنْ يُتِمَّ عَلَيْهِ إِحْسَانَهُ، وَيَشْمَلَهُ بِكَرَمِهِ وَيُرَقِّيَهُ إِلَى الْمَنَازِلِ الْعَالِيَةِ فَيُيَسِّرُهُ لِلْيُسْرَى، وَيُجَنِّبُهُ الْعُسْرَى، وَيُجْرِي عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَصْنَافِ الْمِحَنِ الَّتِي يَكْرَهُهَا وَتَشُقُّ عَلَيْهِ وَهِيَ عَيْنُ صَلَاحِهِ، وَالطَّرِيقُ إِلَى سَعَادَتِهِ، كَمَا أِمْتَحَنَ الْأَنْبِيَاءَ بِأَذَى قَوْمِهِمْ وَبِالْجِهَادِ فِي سَبِيلِهِ وَكَمَا ذَكَرَ اللَّهُ عَنْ يُوسُفَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ وَكَيْفَ تَرَقَّتْ بِهِ الْأَحْوَالُ وَلَطَفَ اللَّهُ بِهِ وَلَهُ بِمَا قَدَّرَهُ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ تِلْكَ الْأَحْوَالِ الَّتِي حَصَلَتْ لَهُ فِي عَاقِبَتِهَا حُسْنُ الْعُقْبَى فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ. وَكَمَا يَمْتَحِنُ أَوْلِيَاءَهُ بِمَا يَكْرَهُونَهُ لِيُنِيلَهُمْ مَا يُحِبُّونَ، وَكَمْ لِلَّهِ مِنْ لُطْفٍ، وَكَرَمٍ لَا تُدْرِكُةْ الْأَفْهَامُ وَلَا تَتَصَوَّرُهُ الْأَوْهَامُ، وَكَمِ اسْتَشْرَفَ الْعَبْدُ عَلَى مَطْلُوبٍ مِنْ مَطَالِبِ الدُّنْيَا مِنْ وِلَايَةٍ وَرِيَاسَةٍ أَوْ سَبَبٍ مِنَ الْأَسْبَابِ الْمَحْبُوبَةِ فَيَصْرِفُهُ اللَّهُ عَنْهَا وَيَصْرِفُهَا عَنْهُ رَحْمَةً بِهِ لِئَلَّا تَضُرَّهُ فِي دِينِهِ، فَيَظَلُّ الْعَبْدُ حَزِينًا مِنْ جَهْلِهِ وَعَدَمِ مَعْرِفَتِهِ بِرَبِّهِ، وَلَوْ عَلِمَ مَا دُخِرَ لَهُ فِي الْغَيْبِ وَأُرِيدَ إِصْلَاحُهُ لَحَمِدَ اللَّهَ وَشَكَرَهُ عَلَى ذَلِكَ، فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ بِعِبَادِهِ رَؤُوفٌ رَحِيمٌ، لَطِيفٌ بِأَوْلِيَائِهِ.
وَفِي الدُّعَاءِ الْمَأْثُورِ: "اللَّهُمَّ مَا رَزَقْتَنِي مِمَّا أُحِبُّ فَاجْعَلْهُ قُوَّةً لِي فِيمَا تُحِبُّ، وَمَا زَوَيْتَ عَنِّي مِمَّا أُحِبُّ فَاجْعَلْهُ فَرَاغاً لِي فِيمَا تُحِبُّ" اللَّهُمَّ الْطُفْ بِنَا فِي قَضَائِكَ وَبَارِكْ لَنَا فِي قُدْرَتِكَ حَتَّى لَا نُحِبَّ تَعْجِيلَ مَاأَخَّرْتَ وَلَا تَأْخِيرَ مَا عَجَّلْتَ.
وَاعْلَمْ أَنَّ اللُّطْفَ الَّذِي يَطْلُبُهُ الْعِبَادُ مِنَ اللَّهِ بِلِسَانِ الْمَقَالِ، وَلِسَانِ الْحَالِ هُوَ مِنَ الرَّحْمَةِ بَلْ هُوَ رَحْمَةٌ خَاصَّةٌ فَالرَّحْمَةُ الَّتِي تَصِلُ الْعَبْدَ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَشْعُرُ بِهَا أَوْ لَا يَشْعُرُ بِأَسْبَابِهَا هِيَ اللُّطْفُ فَإِذَا قَالَ الْعَبْدُ: يَالَطِيفُ الْطُفْ بِي أَوْ لِي وَأَسْأَلُكَ لُطْفَكَ فَمَعْنَاهُ تَوَلَّنِي وِلَايَةً خَاصَّةً بِهَا تَصْلُحُ أَحْوَالِي الظَّاهِرَةُ، وَالْبَاطِنَةُ وَبِهَا تَنْدَفِعُ عَنِّي جَمِيعُ الْمَكْرُوهَاتِ مِنَ الْأُمُورِ الدَّاخِلِيَّةِ وَالْأُمُورِ الْخَارِجِيَّةِ.
فَالْأُمُورُ الدَّاخِلِيَّةُ لُطْفٌ بِالْعَبْدِ.
وَالْأُمُورُ الْخَارِجِيَّةُ لُطْفٌ لِلْعَبْدِ فَإِذَا يَسَّرَ اللَّهُ عَبْدَهُ وَسَهَّلَ طَرِيقَ الْخَيْرِ وَأَعَانَهُ عَلَيْهِ فَقَدْ لَطَفَ بِهِ وَإِذَا قَيَّضَ اللَّهُ لَهُ أَسْبَاباً خَارِجِيَّةً غَيْرَ دَاخِلَةٍ تَحْتَ قُدْرَةِ الْعَبْدِ فِيهَا صَلَاحُهُ فَقَدْ لَطَفَ لَهُ وَلِهَذَا لَمَّا تَنَقَّلَتْ بِيُوسُفَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ تِلْكَ الْأَحْوَالُ، وَتَطَوَّرَتْ بِهِ الْأَطْوَارُ مِنْ رُؤْيَاهُ، وَحَسَدِ إِخْوَتِهِ لَهُ، وَسَعْيِهِمْ فِي إِبْعَادِهِ جِدًّا، وَاخْتِصَامِهِمْ بِأَبِيهِمْ ثُمَّ مِحْنَتِهِ بِالنِّسْوَةِ ثُمَّ بِالسِّجْنِ ثُمَّ بِالْخُرُوجِ مِنْهُ بِسَبَبِ رُؤْيَا الْمَلِكِ الْعَظِيمَةِ، وَانْفِرَادِهِ بِتَعْبِيرِهَا، وَتَبَوُّءِهِ مِنَ الْأَرْضِ حَيْثُ يَشَاءُ، وَحُصُولِ مَا حَصَلَ عَلَى أَبِيهِ مِنَ الِابْتِلَاءِ، وَالِامْتِحَانِ ثُمَّ حَصَلَ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ الِاجْتِمَاعُ السَّارُّ وَاِزَالَةُ الْاَكْدَارِ وَصَلَاحُ حَالَةِ الْجَمِيعِ وَالِاجْتِبَاءُ الْعَظِيمُ لِيُوسُفَ عَرَفَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ أَنَّ هَذِهِ الْأَشْيَاءَ وَغَيْرَهَا لُطْفٌ لَطَفَ اللَّهُ لَهُمْ بِهِ فَاعْتَرَفَ بِهَذِهِ النِّعْمَةِ فَقَالَ: ﴿إِنَّ رَبِّي لَطِيفٌ لِمَا يَشَاءُ إِنَّهُ هُوَ الْعَلِيمُ الْحَكِيمُ﴾ أَيْ لُطْفُهُ تَعَالَى خَاصٌّ لِمَنْ يَشَاءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ مِمَّنْ يَعْلَمُهُ تَعَالَى مَحَلًّا لِذَلِكَ وَأَهْلاً لَهُ فَلَا يَضَعُهُ إِلَّا فِي مَحَلِّهِ. اللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ حَيْثُ يَضَعُ فَضْلَهُ فَإِذَا رَأَيْتَ اللَّهَ تَعَالَى قَدْ يَسَّرَ الْعَبْدَ لِلْيُسْرَى، وَسَهَّلَ لَهُ طَرِيقَ الْخَيْرِ، وَذَلَّلَ لَهُ صِعَابَهُ، وَفَتَحَ لَهُ أَبْوَابَهُ، وَنَهَجَ لَهُ طُرُقَهُ، وَمَهَّدَ لَهُ أَسْبَابَهُ، وَجَنَّبَهُ الْعُسْرَى فَقَدْ لَطَفَ بِهِ.
وَمِنْ لُطْفِهِ بِعِبَادِهِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ أَنَّهُ يَتَوَلَّاهُمْ بِلُطْفِهِ فَيُخْرِجُهُمْ مِنَ الظُّلُمَاتِ إِلَى النُّورِ مِنْ ظُلُمَاتِ الْجَهْلِ، وَالْكُفْرِ، وَالْبِدَعِ، وَالْمَعَاصِي إِلَى نُورِ الْعِلْمِ وَالْإِيمَانِ وَالطَّاعَةِ، وَمِنْ لُطْفِهِ أَنَّهُ يَرْحَمُهُمْ مِنْ طَاعَةِ أَنْفُسِهِمُ الْأَمَّارَةِ بِالسُّوءِ الَّتِي هَذَا طَبْعُهَا وَدَيْدَنُهَا فَيُوَفِّقُهُمْ لِنَهْيِ النَّفْسِ عَنِ الْهَوَى وَيَصْرِفُ عَنْهُمُ السُّوءَ وَالْفَحْشَاءَ فَتُوجَدُ أَسْبَابُ الْفِتْنَةِ، وَجَوَاذِبُ الْمَعَاصِي وَشَهَوَاتُ الْغَيِّ فَيُرْسِلُ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهَا بُرْهَانَ لُطْفِهِ وَنُورَ إِيمَانِهِمُ الَّذِي مَنَّ بِهِ عَلَيْهِمْ فَيَدَعُونَهَا مُطْمَئِنِّينَ لِذَلِكَ مُنْشَرِحَةً لِتَرْكِهَا صُدُورُهُمْ.
وَمِنْ لُطْفِهِ بِعِبَادِهِ أَنَّهُ يُقَدِّرُ أَرْزَاقَهُمْ بِحَسَبِ عِلْمِهِ بِمَصْلَحَتِهِمْ لَا بِحَسَبِ مُرَادَاتِهِمْ فَقَدْ يُرِيدُونَ شَيْئاً وَغَيْرُهُ أَصْلَحُ فَيُقَدِّرُ لَهُمُ الْأَصْلَحَ وَإِنْ كَرِهُوهُ لُطْفاً بِهِمْ، وَبِرّاً، وَإِحْسَاناً ﴿اللَّهُ لَطِيفٌ بِعِبَادِهِ يَرْزُقُ مَنْ يَشَاءُ وَهُوَ الْقَوِيُّ الْعَزِيزُ﴾ ﴿وَلَوْ بَسَطَ اللَّهُ الرِّزْقَ لِعِبَادِهِ لَبَغَوْا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَكِنْ يُنَزِّلُ بِقَدَرٍ مَا يَشَاءُ إِنَّهُ بِعِبَادِهِ خَبِيرٌ بَصِيرٌ﴾.
وَمِنْ لُطْفِهِ بِهِمْ أَنَّهُ يُقَدِّرُ عَلَيْهِمْ أَنْوَاعَ الْمَصَائِبِ، وَضُرُوبَ الْمِحَنِ، وَالْإِبْتِلَاءَ بِالْأَمْرِ وَالنَّهْيِ الشَّاقِّ رَحْمَةً بِهِمْ، وَلُطْفاً، وَسَوْقًا إِلَى كَمَالِهِمْ، وَكَمَالِ نَعِيمِهِمْ ﴿وَعَسَى أَنْ تَكْرَهُوا شَيْئاً وَهُوَ خَيْرٌ لَكُمْ وَعَسَى أَنْ تُحِبُّوا شَيْئاً وَهُوَ شَرٌّ لَكُمْ وَاللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ وَأَنْتُمْ لا تَعْلَمُونَ﴾.
وَمِنْ لَطِيفِ لُطْفِهِ بِعَبْدِهِ إِذْ أَهَّلَهُ لِلْمَرَاتِبِ الْعَالِيَةِ، وَالْمَنَازِلِ السَّامِيَةِ الَّتِي لَا تُدْرَكُ بِالْأَسْبَابِ الْعِظَامِ الَّتِي لَا يُدْرِكُهَا إِلَّا أَرْبَابُ الْهِمَمِ الْعَالِيَةِ، وَالْعَزَائِمِ السَّامِيَةِ أَنْ يُقَدِّرَ لَهُ فِي ابْتِدَاءِ أَمْرِهِ بَعْضَ الْأَسْبَابِ الْمُحْتَمَلَةِ الْمُنَاسِبَةِ لِلْأَسْبَابِ الَّتِي أُهِّلَ لَهَا لِيَتَدَرَّجَ مِنَ الْأَدْنَى إِلَى الْأَعْلَى وَلِتَتَمَرَّنَ نَفْسُهُ وَيَصِيرَ لَهُ مَلَكَةٌ مِنْ جِنْسِ ذَلِكَ الْأَمْرِ وَهَذَا كَمَا قَدَّرَ لِمُوسَى وَمُحَمَّدٍ وَغَيْرِهِمَا مِنَ الْأَنْبِيَاءِ - صَلَوَاتُ اللَّهِ وَسَلَامُهُ عَلَيْهِمْ - فِي ابْتِدَاءِ أَمْرِهِمْ رِعَايَةَ الْغَنَمِ لِيَتَدَرَّجُوا مِنْ رِعَايَةِ الْحَيَوَانِ الْبَهِيمِ وَإِصْلَاحِهِ إِلَى رِعَايَةِ بَنِي آدَمَ وَدَعْوَتِهِمْ وَإِصْلَاحِهِمْ. وَكَذَلِكَ يُذِيقُ عَبْدَهُ حَلَاوَةَ بَعْضِ الطَّاعَاتِ فَيَنْجَذِبُ وَيَرْغَبُ وَيَصِيرُ لَهُ مَلَكَةٌ قَوِيَّةٌ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ عَلَى طَاعَاتٍ أَجَلَّ مِنْهَا وَأَعْلَى وَلَمْ تَكُنْ تَحْصُلُ بِتِلْكَ الْإِرَادَةِ السَّابِقَةِ حَتَّى وَصَلَ إِلَى هَذِهِ الْإِرَادَةِ وَالرَّغْبَةِ التَّامَّةِ.
وَمِنْ لُطْفِهِ بِعَبْدِهِ أَنْ يُقَدِّرَ لَهُ أَنْ يَتَرَبَّى فِي وِلَايَةِ أَهْلِ الصَّلَاحِ، وَالْعِلْمِ، وَالْإِيمَانِ وَبَيْنَ أَهْلِ الْخَيْرِ لِيَكْتَسِبَ مِنْ أَدَبِهِمْ، وَتَأْدِيبِهِمْ وَلِيَنْشَأَ عَلَى صَلَاحِهِمْ وَإِصْلَاحِهِمْ كَمَا أِمْتَنَّ اللَّهُ عَلَى مَرْيَمَ فِي قَوْلِهِ تَعَالَى: ﴿فَتَقَبَّلَهَا رَبُّهَا بِقَبُولٍ حَسَنٍ وَأَنْبَتَهَا نَبَاتاً حَسَناً وَكَفَّلَهَا زَكَرِيَّا كُلَّمَا دَخَلَ عَلَيْهَا زَكَرِيَّا﴾ إِلَى آخِرِ قِصَّتِهَا وَمِنْ ذَلِكَ إِذَا نَشَأَ بَيْنَ أَبَوَيْنِ صَالِحَيْنِ وَأَقَارِبَ أَتْقِيَاءَ أَوْ فِي بَلَدِ صَلَاحٍ أَوْ وَفَّقَهُ اللَّهُ لِمُقَارَنَةِ أَهْلِ الْخَيْرِ وَصُحْبَتِهِمْ أَوْ لِتَرْبِيَةِ الْعُلَمَاءِ الرَّبَّانِيِّينَ فَإِنَّ هَذَا مِنْ أَعْظَمِ لُطْفِهِ بِعَبْدِهِ فَإِنَّ صَلَاحَ الْعَبْدِ مَوْقُوفٌ عَلَى أَسْبَابٍ كَثِيرَةٍ مِنْهَا بَلْ مِنْ أَكْثَرِهَا وَأَعْظَمِهَا نَفْعاً هَذِهِ الْحَالَةُ. وَمِنْ ذَلِكَ إِذَا نَشَأَ الْعَبْدُ فِي بَلَدٍ أَهْلُهُ عَلَى مَذْهَبِ أَهْلِ السُّنَّةِ وَالْجَمَاعَةِ فَإِنَّ هَذَا لُطْفٌ لَهُ وَكَذَلِكَ إِذَا قَدَّرَ اللَّهُ أَنْ يَكُونَ مَشَايِخُهُ الَّذِينَ يَسْتَفِيدُ مِنْهُمُ الْأَحْيَاءُ مِنْهُمْ وَالْأَمْوَاتُ أَهْلَ سُنَّةٍ وَتُقًي فَإِنَّ هَذَا مِنَ اللُّطْفِ الرَّبَّانِيِّ وَلَا يَخْفَى لُطْفُ الْبَارِي فِي وُجُودِ شَيْخِ الْإِسْلَامِ ابْنِ تَيْمِيَّةَ رَحِمَهُ اللَّهُ فِي أَثْنَاءِ قُرُونِ هَذِهِ الْأُمَّةِ وَتَبْيِينِ اللَّهِ بِهِ وَبِتَلَامِذَتِهِ مِنَ الْخَيْرِ الْكَثِيرِ وَالْعِلْمِ الْغَزِيرِ وَجِهَادِ أَهْلِ الْبِدَعِ وَالتَّعْطِيلِ وَالْكُفْرِ ثُمَّ انْتِشَارِ كُتُبِهِ فِي هَذِهِ الْأَوْقَاتِ فَلَا شَكَّ أَنَّ هَذَا مِنْ لُطْفِ اللَّهِ لِمَنِ انْتَفَعَ بِهَا وَأَنَّهُ يَتَوَقَّفُ خَيْرٌ كَثِيرٌ عَلَى وُجُودِهَا فَلِلَّهِ الْحَمْدُ وَالْمِنَّةُ وَالْفَضْلُ.
وَمِنْ لُطْفِ اللَّهِ بِعَبْدِهِ أَنْ يَجْعَلَ رِزْقَهُ حَلَالًا فِي رَاحَةٍ وَقَنَاعَةٍ يَحْصُلُ بِهِ الْمَقْصُودُ وَلَا يَشْغَلُهُ عَمَّا خُلِقَ لَهُ مِنَ الْعِبَادَةِ وَالْعِلْمِ وَالْعَمَلِ بَلْ يُعِينُهُ عَلَى ذَلِكَ وَيُفَرِّغُهُ وَيُرِيحُ خَاطِرَهُ وَأَعْضَاءَهُ وَلِهَذَا مِنْ لُطْفِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى لِعَبْدِهِ أَنَّهُ رُبَّمَا طَمَحَتْ نَفْسُهُ لِسَبَبٍ مِنَ الْأَسْبَابِ الدُّنْيَوِيَّةِ الَّتِي يَظُنُّ فِيهَا إِدْرَاكَ بُغْيَتِهِ فَيَعْلَمُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى أَنَّهَا تَضُرُّهُ وَتَصُدُّهُ عَمَّا يَنْفَعُهُ فَيَحُولُ بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَهَا فَيَظَلُّ الْعَبْدُ كَارِهاً وَلَمْ يَدْرِ أَنَّ رَبَّهُ قَدْ لَطَفَ بِهِ حَيْثُ أَبْقَى لَهُ الْأَمْرَ النَّافِعَ وَصَرَفَ عَنْهُ الْأَمْرَ الضَّارَّ وَلِهَذَا كَانَ الرِّضَى بِالْقَضَاءِ فِي مِثْلِ هَذِهِ الْأَشْيَاءِ مِنْ أَعْلَى الْمَنَازِلِ.
وَمِنْ لُطْفِ اللَّهِ بِعَبْدِهِ إِذَا قَدَّرَ لَهُ طَاعَةً جَلِيلَةً لَا تُنَالُ إِلَّا بِأَعْوَانٍ أَنْ يُقَدِّرَ لَهُ أَعْوَاناً عَلَيْهَا وَمُسَاعِدِينَ عَلَى حَمْلِهَا قَالَ مُوسَى عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: ﴿وَاجْعَلْ لِي وَزِيراً مِنْ أَهْلِي هَارُونَ أَخِي اشْدُدْ بِهِ أَزْرِي وَأَشْرِكْهُ فِي أَمْرِي كَيْ نُسَبِّحَكَ كَثِيراً وَنَذْكُرَكَ كَثِيراً﴾. وَكَذَلِكَ امْتَنَّ عَلَى عِيسَى بِقَوْلِهِ: ﴿وَإِذْ أَوْحَيْتُ إِلَى الْحَوَارِيِّينَ أَنْ آمِنُوا بِي وَبِرَسُولِي قَالُوا آمَنَّا وَاشْهَدْ بِأَنَّنَا مُسْلِمُونَ﴾.
وَامْتَنَّ عَلَى سَيِّدِ الْخَلْقِ فِي قَوْلِهِ ﴿هُوَ الَّذِي أَيَّدَكَ بِنَصْرِهِ وَبِالْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ وَهَذَا لُطْفٌ لِعَبْدِهِ خَارِجٌ عَنْ قُدْرَتِهِ وَمِنْ هَذَا لُطْفُ اللَّهِ بِالْهَادِينَ إِذَا قَيَّضَ اللَّهُ مَنْ يَهْتَدِي بِهُدَاهُمْ وَيَقْبَلُ إِرْشَادَهُمْ فَتَتَضَاعَفُ بِذَلِكَ الْخَيْرَاتُ وَالْأُجُورُ الَّتِي لَا يُدْرِكُهَا الْعَبْدُ بِمُجَرَّدِ فِعْلِهِ بَلْ هِيَ مَشْرُوطَةٌ بِأَمْرٍ خَارِجِيٍّ.
وَمِنْ لُطْفِ اللَّهِ بِعَبْدِهِ أَنْ يُعْطِيَ عَبْدَهُ مِنَ الْأَوْلَادِ، وَالْأَمْوَالِ، وَالْأَزْوَاجِ مَا بِهِ تَقَرُّ عَيْنُهُ فِي الدُّنْيَا، وَيَحْصُلُ لَهُ السُّرُورُ، ثُمَّ يَبْتَلِيَهُ بِبَعْضِ ذَلِكَ وَيَأْخُذَهُ، وَيُعَوِّضَهُ عَلَيْهِ الْأَجْرَ الْعَظِيمَ إِذَا صَبَرَ وَاحْتَسَبَ فَنِعْمَةُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ بِأَخْذِهِ عَلَى هَذَا الْوَجْهِ أَعْظَمُ مِنْ نِعْمَتِهِ عَلَيْهِ فِي وُجُودِهِ وَقَضَاءِ مُجَرَّدِ وَطَرِهِ الدُّنْيَوِيِّ مِنْهُ وَهَذَا أَيْضاً خَيْرٌ وَأَجْرٌ خَارِجٌ عَنْ أَحْوَالِ الْعَبْدِ بِنَفْسِهِ بَلْ هُوَ لُطْفٌ مِنَ اللَّهِ لَهُ قَيَّضَ لَهُ أَسْبَابًا أَعَاضَهُ عَلَيْهَا الثَّوَابَ الْجَزِيلَ وَالْأَجْرَ الْجَمِيلَ. وَمِنْ لُطْفِ اللَّهِ بِعَبْدِهِ أَنْ يَبْتَلِيَهُ بِبَعْضِ الْمَصَائِبِ فَيُوَفِّقَهُ لِلْقِيَامِ بِوَظِيفَةِ الصَّبْرِ فِيهَا فَيُنِيلَهُ دَرَجَاتٍ عَالِيَهْ لَا يُدْرِكُهَا بِعَمَلِهِ وَقَدْ يُشَدِّدُ عَلَيْهِ الِابْتِلَاءَ بِذَلِكَ كَمَا فَعَلَ بِأَيُّوبَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ وَيُوجِدُ فِي قَلْبِهِ حَلَاوَةَ رَوْحِ الرَّجَاءِ وَتَأْمِيلِ الرَّحْمَةِ وَكَشْفِ الضُّرِّ فَيَخِفُّ أَلَمُهُ وَتَنْشَطُ نَفْسُهُ. وَلِهَذَا مِنْ لُطْفِ اللَّهِ بِالْمُؤْمِنِينَ أَنْ جَعَلَ فِي قُلُوبِهِمُ احْتِسَابَ الْأَجْرِ فَخَفَّتْ مَصَائِبُهُمْ وَهَانَ مَا يَلْقَوْنَ مِنَ الْمَشَاقِّ فِي حُصُولِ مَرْضَاتِهِ.
وَمِنْ لُطْفِ اللَّهِ بِعَبْدِهِ الْمُؤْمِنِ الضَّعِيفِ أَنْ يُعَافِيَهُ مِنْ أَسْبَابِ الِابْتِلَاءِ الَّتِي تُضْعِفُ إِيمَانَهُ وَتُنْقِصُ إِيقَانَهُ. كَمَا أَنَّ مِنْ لُطْفِهِ بِالْمُؤْمِنِ الْقَوِيِّ تَهْيِئَةَ أَسْبَابِ الِابْتِلَاءِ وَالِامْتِحَانِ وَيُعِينُهُ عَلَيْهَا وَيَحْمِلُهَا عَنْهُ وَيَزْدَادُ بِذَلِكَ إِيمَانُهُ وَيَعْظُمُ أَجْرُهُ فَسُبْحَانَ اللَّطِيفِ فِي ابْتِلَائِهِ وَعَافِيَتِهِ وَعَطَائِهِ وَمَنْعِهِ.
وَمِنْ لُطْفِ اللَّهِ بِعَبْدِهِ أَنْ يَسْعَى لِكَمَالِ نَفْسِهِ مَعَ أَقْرَبِ طَرِيقٍ يُوصِلُهُ إِلَى ذَلِكَ مَعَ وُجُودِ غَيْرِهَا مِنَ الطُّرُقِ الَّتِي تَبْعُدُ عَلَيْهِ فَيُيَسِّرُ عَلَيْهِ التَّعَلُّمَ مِنْ كِتَابٍ أَوْ مُعَلِّمٍ يَكُونُ حُصُولُ الْمَقْصُودِ بِهِ أَقْرَبَ وَأَسْهَلَ وَكَذَلِكَ يُيَسِّرُهُ لِعِبَادَةٍ يَفْعَلُهَا بِحَالَةِ الْيُسْرِ وَالسُّهُولَةِ وَعَدَمِ التَّعْوِيقِ عَنْ غَيْرِهَا مِمَّا يَنْفَعُهُ فَهَذَا مِنَ اللُّطْفِ.
وَمِنْ لُطْفِ اللَّهِ بِعَبْدِهِ قَدَّرَ الْوَارِدَاتِ الْكَثِيرَةَ وَالْأَشْغَالَ الْمُتَنَوِّعَةَ وَالتَّدْبِيرَاتِ وَالْمُتَعَلِّقَاتِ الدَّاخِلَةَ وَالْخَارِجَةَ الَّتِي لَوْ قُسِّمَتْ عَلَى أُمَّةٍ مِنَ النَّاسِ لَعَجَزَتْ قُوَاهُمْ عَلَيْهَا أَنْ يَمُنَّ عَلَيْهِ بِخُلُقٍ وَاسِعٍ وَصَدْرٍ مُتَّسِعٍ وَقَلْبٍ مُنْشَرِحٍ بِحَيْثُ يُعْطِي كُلَّ فَرْدٍ مِنْ أَفْرَادِهَا نَظَراً ثَاقِباً وَتَدْبِيراً تَامّاً وَهُوَ غَيْرُ مُكْتَرِثٍ وَلَا مُنْزَعِجٍ لِكَثْرَتِهَا وَتَفَاوُتِهَا بَلْ قَدْ أَعَانَهُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى عَلَيْهَا وَلَطَفَ بِهِ فِيهَا وَلَطَفَ لَهُ فِي تَسْهِيلِ أَسْبَابِهَا وَطُرُقِهَا وَإِذَا أَرَدْتَ أَنْ تَعْرِفَ هَذَا الْأَمْرَ فَانْظُرْ إِلَى حَالَةِ الْمُصْطَفَى صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ الَّذِي بَعَثَهُ اللَّهُ بِصَلَاحِ الدَّارَيْنِ وَحُصُولِ السَّعَادَتَيْنِ وَبَعَثَهُ مُكَمِّلًا لِنَفْسِهِ وَمُكَمِّلًا لِأُمَّةٍ عَظِيمَةٍ هِيَ خَيْرُ الْأُمَمِ وَمَعَ هَذَا مَكَّنَهُ اللَّهُ بِبَعْضِ عُمُرِهِ الشَّرِيفِ فِي نَحْوِ ثُلُثِ عُمُرِهِ أَنْ يَقُومَ بِأَمْرِ اللَّهِ كُلِّهِ عَلَى كَثْرَتِهِ وَتَنَوُّعِهِ وَأَنْ يُقِيمَ لِأُمَّتِهِ جَمِيعَ دِينِهِمْ وَيُعَلِّمَهُمْ جَمِيعَ أُصُولِهِ وَفُرُوعِهِ وَيُخْرِجَ اللَّهُ بِهِ أُمَّةً كَبِيرَةً مِنَ الظُّلُمَاتِ إِلَى النُّورِ وَيَحْصُلَ بِهِ مِنَ الْمَصَالِحِ وَالْمَنَافِعِ وَالْخَيْرِ وَالسَّعَادَةِ لِلْخَاصِّ وَالْعَامِّ مَالَا تَقُومُ بِهِ أُمَّةٌ مِنَ الْخَلْقِ.
وَمِنْ لُطْفِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى بِعَبْدِهِ أَنْ يَجْعَلَ مَا يَبْتَلِيهِ بِهِ مِنَ الْمَعَاصِي سَبَباً لِرَحْمَتِهِ فَيَفْتَحَ لَهُ عِنْدَ وُقُوعِ ذَلِكَ بَابَ التَّوْبَةِ وَالتَّضَرُّعِ وَالِابْتِهَالِ إِلَى رَبِّهِ وَازْدِرَاءِ نَفْسِهِ وَاحْتِقَارِهَا وَزَوَالِ الْعُجْبِ وَالْكِبْرِ مِنْ قَلْبِهِ مَا هُوَ خَيْرٌ لَهُ مِنْ كَثِيرٍ مِنَ الطَّاعَاتِ.
وَمِنْ لُطْفِهِ بِعَبْدِهِ الْحَبِيبِ عِنْدَهُ إِذَا مَالَتْ نَفْسُهُ مَعَ شَهَوَاتِ النَّفْسِ الضَّارَّةِ وَاسْتَرْسَلَتْ فِي ذَلِكَ أَنْ يُنَقِّصَهَا عَلَيْهِ وَيُكَدِّرَهَا فَلَا يَكَادُ يَتَنَاوَلُ مِنْهَا شَيْئاً إِلَّا مَقْرُونًا بِالْمُكَدِّرَاتِ مَحْشُوّاً بِالْغُصَصِ لِئَلَّا يَمِيلَ مَعَهَا كُلَّ الْمَيْلِ، كَمَا أَنَّ مِنْ لُطْفِهِ بِهِ أَنْ يُلَذِّذَ لَهُ التَّقَرُّبَاتِ وَيُحَلِّيَ لَهُ الطَّاعَاتِ لِيَمِيلَ إِلَيْهَا كُلَّ الْمَيْلِ.
وَمِنْ لَطِيفِ لُطْفِ اللَّهِ بِعَبْدِهِ أَنْ يَأْجُرَهُ عَلَى أَعْمَالٍ لَمْ يَعْمَلْهَا بَلْ عَزَمَ عَلَيْهَا فَيَعْزِمُ عَلَى قُرْبَةٍ مِنَ الْقُرَبِ ثُمَّ تَنْحَلُّ عَزِيمَتُهُ لِسَبَبٍ مِنَ الْأَسْبَابِ فَلَا يَفْعَلُهَا فَيَحْصُلُ لَهُ أَجْرُهَا فَانْظُرْ كَيْفَ لَطَفَ اللَّهُ بِهِ فَأَوْقَعَهَا فِي قَلْبِهِ وَأَدَارَهَا فِي ضَمِيرِهِ وَقَدْ عَلِمَ تَعَالَى أَنَّهُ لَا يَفْعَلُهَا سَوْقًا لِبِرِّهِ لِعَبْدِهِ وَإِحْسَانِهِ بِكُلِّ طَرِيقٍ.
وَأَلْطَفُ مِنْ ذَلِكَ أَنْ يُقَيِّضَ لِعَبْدِهِ طَاعَةً أُخْرَى غَيْرَ الَّتِي عَزَمَ عَلَيْهَا هِيَ أَنْفَعُ لَهُ مِنْهَا فَيَدَعَ الْعَبْدُ الطَّاعَةَ الَّتِي تُرْضِى رَبَّهُ لِطَاعَةٍ أُخْرَى هِيَ أَرْضَى لِلَّهِ مِنْهَا فَتَحْصُلُ لَهُ الْمَفْعُولَةُ بِالْفِعْلِ وَالْمَعْزُومُ عَلَيْهَا بِالنِّيَّةِ وَإِذَا كَانَ مَنْ يُهَاجِرُ إِلَى اللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ ثُمَّ يُدْرِكُهُ الْمَوْتُ قَبْلَ حُصُولِ مَقْصُودِهِ قَدْ وَقَعَ أَجْرُهُ عَلَى اللَّهِ مَعَ أَنَّ قَطْعَ الْمَوْتِ بِغَيْرِ اخْتِيَارِهِ فَكَيْفَ بِمَنْ قَطَعَتْ عَلَيْهِ نِيَّتُهُ الْفَاضِلَةُ طَاعَةً قَدْ عَزَمَ عَلَى فِعْلِهَا وَرُبَّمَا اَدَارَ اللَّهُ فِي ضَمِيرِ عَبْدِهِ عِدَّةَ طَاعَاتٍ كُلُّ طَاعَةٍ لَوِ انْفَرَدَتْ لَفَعَلَهَا الْعَبْدُ لِكَمَالِ رَغْبَتِهِ وَلَا يُمْكِنُ فِعْلُ شَيْءٍ مِنْهَا إِلَّا بِتَفْوِيتِ الْأُخْرَى فَيُوَفِّقُهُ لِلْمُوَازَنَةِ بَيْنَهَا وَإِيثَارِ أَفْضَلِهَا فِعْلًا مَعَ رَجَاءِ حُصُولِهَا جَمِيعِهَا عَزْماً وَنِيَّةً.
وَأَلْطَفُ مِنْ هَذَا أَنْ يُقَدِّرَ تَعَالَى لِعَبْدِهِ وَيَبْتَلِيَهُ بِوُجُودِ أَسْبَابِ الْمَعْصِيَةِ وَيُوَفِّرَ لَهُ دَوَاعِيَهَا وَهُوَ تَعَالَى يَعْلَمُ أَنَّهُ لَا يَفْعَلُهَا لِيَكُونَ تَرْكُهُ لِتِلْكَ الْمَعْصِيَةِ الَّتِي تَوَفَّرَتْ أَسْبَابُ فِعْلِهَا مِنْ أَكْبَرِ الطَّاعَاتِ.
كَمَا لَطَفَ بِيُوسُفَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ فِي مُرَاوَدَةِ الْمَرْأَةِ. وَأَحَدُ السَّبْعَةِ الَّذِينَ يُظِلُّهُمُ اللَّهُ فِي ظِلِّهِ يَوْمَ لَا ظِلَّ إِلَّا ظِلُّهُ رَجُلٌ دَعَتْهُ امْرَأَةٌ ذَاتُ مَنْصِبٍ وَجَمَالٍ فَقَالَ: إِنِّي أَخَافُ اللَّهَ رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ.
وَمِنْ لُطْفِ اللَّهِ بِعَبْدِهِ أَنْ يُقَدِّرَ خَيْراً وَإِحْسَاناً مِنْ عَبْدِهِ وَيُجْرِيَهُ عَلَى يَدِ عَبْدِهِ الْآخَرِ وَيَجْعَلَهُ طَرِيقاً إِلَى وُصُولِهِ إِلَى الْمُسْتَحِقِّ فَيُثِيبُ اللَّهُ الْأَوَّلَ وَالْآخَرَ. وَمِنْ لُطْفِ اللَّهِ بِعَبْدِهِ أَنْ يُجْرِيَ بِشَيْءٍ مِنْ مَالِهِ شَيْئاً مِنَ النَّفْعِ وَخَيْراً لِغَيْرِهِ فَيُثِيبَهُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَحْتَسِبُ فَمَنْ غَرَسَ غَرْساً أَوْ زَرَعَ زَرْعاً فَاَصَابَتْ مِنْهُ رُوحٌ مِنَ الْأَرْوَاحِ الْمُحْتَرَمَةِ شَيْئاً آجَرَ اللَّهُ صَاحِبَهُ وَهُوَ لَا يَدْرِي خُصُوصاً إِذَا كَانَتْ عِنْدَهُ نِيَّةٌ حَسَنَةٌ وَعَقَدَ مَعَ رَبِّهِ عَقْداً فِي أَنَّهُ مَهْمَا تَرَتَّبَ عَلَى مَالِهِ شَيْءٌ مِنَ النَّفْعِ فَاَسْأَلُكَ يَارَبِّ أَنْ تَأْجُرَنِي وَتَجْعَلَهُ قُرْبَةً لِي عِنْدَكَ، وَكَذَلِكَ لَوْ كَانَ لَهُ بَهَائِمُ انْتُفِعَ بِدَرِّهَا وَرُكُوبِهَا وَالْحَمْلِ عَلَيْهَا، أَوْ مَسَاكِنُ انْتُفِعَ بِسُكْنَاهَا وَلَوْ شَيْئاً قَلِيلاً، أَوْ مَاعُونٌ وَنَحْوُهُ انْتُفِعَ بِهِ، أَوْ عَيْنٌ شُرِبَ مِنْهَا، وَغَيْرُ ذَلِكَ كَكِتَابٍ انْتُفِعَ بِهِ فِي تَعَلُّمِ شَيْءٍ مِنْهُ، أَوْ مُصْحَفٍ قُرِئَ فِيهِ، وَاللَّهُ ذُو الْفَضْلِ الْعَظِيمِ.
وَمِنْ لُطْفِ اللَّهِ بِعَبْدِهِ أَنْ يَفْتَحَ لَهُ بَاباً مِنْ أَبْوَابِ الْخَيْرِ لَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ عَلَى بَالٍ، وَلَيْسَ ذَلِكَ لِقِلَّةِ رَغْبَتِهِ فِيهِ وَإِنَّمَا هُوَ غَفْلَةٌ مِنْهُ وَذُهُولٌ عَنْ ذَلِكَ الطَّرِيقِ فَلَمْ يَشْعُرْ إِلَّا وَقَدْ وَجَدَ فِي قَلْبِهِ الدَّاعِيَ إِلَيْهِ وَالْمُلْفِتَ إِلَيْهِ فَفَرِحَ بِذَلِكَ وَعَرَفَ أَنَّهَا مِنْ أَلْطَافِ سَيِّدِهِ وَطُرُقِهِ الَّتِي قَيَّضَ وُصُولَهَا إِلَيْهِ فَصَرَفَ لَهَا ضَمِيرَهُ وَوَجَّهَ إِلَيْهَا فِكْرَهُ وَأَدْرَكَ مِنْهَا مَاشَاءَ اللَّهُ".
summary.en:
The author (may Allah have mercy on him) said: "Among His beautiful names is "Al-Latif" (the Subtle, the Kind): the One whose knowledge is so subtle that it perceives hidden things and concealed things, what the breasts contain, and the hidden seeds within the earth; and who is kind to His allies and His chosen ones, so He eases them towards ease and keeps them away from hardship, makes easy for them every path that leads to His pleasure and His honour, and protects them from every cause and means that leads to His anger, by ways they perceive and ways they do not perceive. He decrees for them things they dislike in order to bring them to what they love. So He is kind to them in themselves, making them proceed according to His beautiful customs and His generous favours, and He is kind for them in matters outside of them, in which there is for them every good, righteousness and success. So Al-Latif is close to the meanings of Al-Khabir (the All-Aware), Ar-Ra'uf (the Compassionate) and Al-Karim (the Generous).
Part of His kindness to His servant and ally, upon whom He wishes to complete His goodness, whom He wishes to cover with His generosity and raise to lofty stations, is that He eases him towards ease, keeps him away from hardship, and brings upon him kinds of trials which he dislikes and which are hard on him, while they are the very thing that makes him righteous and the path to his happiness — just as He tested the prophets with the harm of their peoples and with striving in His path, and as Allah mentioned about Yusuf (peace be upon him): how his conditions raised him up, and how Allah was kind to him and kind for him through what He decreed for him of those conditions, which in their outcome brought him a good end in this world and the Hereafter. And as He tests His allies with what they dislike in order to bring them to what they love. How much kindness and generosity Allah has that understandings cannot grasp and imaginations cannot conceive! How often has a servant looked eagerly towards some worldly aim — authority, leadership, or some beloved means — and Allah turns him away from it and turns it away from him, out of mercy to him, lest it harm him in his religion; so the servant remains sad, due to his ignorance and lack of knowledge of his Lord. Had he known what has been stored up for him in the unseen, and that his betterment was intended, he would have praised Allah and thanked Him for that. For Allah is Compassionate and Merciful to His servants, Kind to His allies.
In the transmitted supplication: "O Allah, whatever You have provided me of what I love, make it a strength for me in what You love; and whatever You have kept away from me of what I love, make it free time for me in what You love". O Allah, be kind to us in Your decree, and bless us in what You have decreed, so that we do not love the hastening of what You have delayed, nor the delaying of what You have hastened.
Know that the kindness which the servants seek from Allah, by the tongue of speech and the tongue of [their] state, is part of mercy; indeed, it is a special mercy. The mercy that reaches the servant in a way he does not perceive, or whose causes he does not perceive, is kindness. So when the servant says: O Latif, be kind to me, or for me, and I ask You for Your kindness — its meaning is: Take charge of me with a special guardianship through which my outward and inward conditions are set right, and through which all disliked things are repelled from me, of inner matters and outer matters.
Inner matters are kindness to the servant.
And outer matters are kindness for the servant. So when Allah eases [the way for] His servant, makes easy the path of good and helps him upon it, He has been kind to him; and when Allah arranges for him outside causes, not falling under the servant's ability, in which lies his betterment, He has been kind for him. For this reason, when those conditions moved Yusuf (peace be upon him) along and he passed through stage after stage — from his dream, his brothers' envy of him and their striving hard to send him far away, and their dispute with their father; then his trial with the women, then with prison, then his release from it because of the king's great dream and his being the only one able to interpret it, and his settling in the land wherever he wished; and what befell his father of affliction and trial; then after that came the joyful reunion, the removal of troubles, the rectification of the state of them all, and the great choosing of Yusuf — he (peace be upon him) recognised that these things and others were a kindness by which Allah was kind for them, so he acknowledged this favour and said: ﴾Indeed, my Lord is Subtle in what He wills. Indeed, it is He who is the Knowing, the Wise﴿ — that is, His kindness (the Exalted) is specific to whom He wills of His servants, whom He, the Exalted, knows to be a fitting place for it and worthy of it, so He does not place it except in its proper place. Allah knows best where to place His favour. So when you see that Allah the Exalted has eased the servant towards ease, made easy for him the path of good, smoothed its difficulties for him, opened its doors for him, laid out its paths for him, prepared its causes for him, and kept him away from hardship, then He has been kind to him.
Part of His kindness to His believing servants is that He takes charge of them with His kindness, and brings them out of darknesses into light — from the darknesses of ignorance, disbelief, innovations and sins into the light of knowledge, faith and obedience. And part of His kindness is that He has mercy on them [by saving them] from obeying their souls that constantly command evil — this being their nature and their habit — so He grants them success in forbidding the soul from [its] desire, and turns evil and immorality away from them. The causes of temptation, the attractions of sins and the lusts of error are present, and Allah sends upon them the proof of His kindness and the light of their faith with which He has favoured them, so they abandon them, content with that, their breasts open to leaving them.
Part of His kindness to His servants is that He measures out their provision according to His knowledge of what is best for them, not according to their wishes. They may want something while something else is better, so He decrees for them what is better, even if they dislike it, out of kindness to them, goodness and beneficence: ﴾Allah is Subtle with His servants; He gives provision to whom He wills. And He is the Powerful, the Exalted in Might﴿ ﴾And if Allah had extended [excessively] provision for His servants, they would have committed tyranny throughout the earth. But He sends [it] down in an amount which He wills. Indeed He is, of His servants, Acquainted and Seeing﴿.
Part of His kindness to them is that He decrees for them kinds of calamities and sorts of trials, and testing by difficult commands and prohibitions, out of mercy to them and kindness, and to drive them towards their perfection and the perfection of their bliss: ﴾But perhaps you hate a thing and it is good for you; and perhaps you love a thing and it is bad for you. And Allah knows, while you know not﴿.
Among the subtleties of His kindness to His servant — when He has qualified him for lofty ranks and exalted stations, which are not reached except through great means that none but those of lofty aspirations and exalted resolve attain — is that He decrees for him at the beginning of his affair some manageable means, suited to the means for which he has been qualified, so that he may progress gradually from the lower to the higher, his soul may be trained, and he may acquire a firm disposition of the same kind as that matter. This is as He decreed for Musa and Muhammad and other prophets — may the blessings and peace of Allah be upon them — at the beginning of their affair, the herding of sheep, so that they would progress gradually from tending dumb animals and caring for them to tending the children of Adam, calling them and reforming them. Likewise, He lets His servant taste the sweetness of some acts of obedience, so he is drawn in and becomes eager, and after that acquires a strong disposition for acts of obedience that are greater and higher than them — which would not have come about through that earlier will, until he reached this complete will and desire.
Part of His kindness to His servant is that He decrees for him to be raised under the guardianship of the people of righteousness, knowledge and faith, and among the people of good, so that he may acquire from their manners and their discipline, and grow up upon their righteousness and their reforming — just as Allah favoured Maryam in His saying (the Exalted): ﴾So her Lord accepted her with good acceptance and caused her to grow in a good manner and put her in the care of Zakariyya. Every time Zakariyya entered upon her﴿ to the end of her story. Part of that is when he grows up between two righteous parents and pious relatives, or in a land of righteousness, or Allah grants him success in associating with the people of good and keeping their company, or in being raised by godly scholars; for this is among the greatest of His kindness to His servant, since the servant's righteousness depends on many causes, among them — indeed among the most numerous and greatest of them in benefit — this condition. Part of that is when the servant grows up in a land whose people are upon the way of Ahl as-Sunnah wal-Jama'ah; this is a kindness for him. Likewise, when Allah decrees that his teachers from whom he benefits, the living among them and the dead, are people of the Sunnah and of piety — this is from the Lord's kindness. And not hidden is the kindness of the Creator in the existence of Shaykh al-Islam Ibn Taymiyyah (may Allah have mercy on him) in the midst of the centuries of this Ummah, and the abundant good and plentiful knowledge that Allah made clear through him and his students, and the striving against the people of innovation, of denial [of Allah's attributes] and of disbelief; then the spread of his books in these times. There is no doubt that this is from Allah's kindness for whoever benefits from them, and that much good depends upon their existence. So to Allah belong the praise, the favour and the bounty.
Part of Allah's kindness to His servant is that He makes his provision lawful, with ease and contentment, by which the purpose is achieved and which does not distract him from that for which he was created — worship, knowledge and action — but rather helps him in that, frees him, and gives rest to his mind and his limbs. For this reason, part of Allah the Exalted's kindness for His servant is that his soul may aspire to some worldly means in which he thinks he will attain his desire, but Allah the Exalted knows that it will harm him and turn him away from what benefits him, so He comes between him and it. The servant remains displeased, not realising that his Lord has been kind to him, in that He preserved for him the beneficial matter and turned away from him the harmful matter. For this reason, contentment with the decree in such things is among the highest stations.
Part of Allah's kindness to His servant, when He decrees for him a great act of obedience that cannot be attained except with helpers, is that He decrees for him helpers in it and assistants in carrying it. Musa (peace be upon him) said: ﴾And appoint for me a minister from my family — Harun, my brother. Increase through him my strength and let him share my task, that we may exalt You much and remember You much﴿. Likewise He favoured 'Isa with His saying: ﴾And [remember] when I inspired the disciples: Believe in Me and in My messenger. They said: We have believed, so bear witness that indeed we are Muslims﴿.
And He favoured the master of creation in His saying: ﴾It is He who supported you with His help and with the believers﴿. This is a kindness for His servant outside of his ability. Part of this is Allah's kindness to those who guide [others], when Allah brings forth those who are guided by their guidance and accept their direction, so that good deeds and rewards are multiplied thereby, which the servant does not attain by his action alone; rather, they are conditional upon an external matter.
Part of Allah's kindness to His servant is that He gives His servant children, wealth and spouses by which his eye is comforted in this world and he attains joy; then He tests him with some of that and takes it, and compensates him for it with a great reward if he is patient and seeks the reward [from Allah]. So Allah's favour upon him in taking it in this way is greater than His favour upon him in its existence and the mere fulfilment of his worldly desire from it. This too is good and reward outside the servant's own states; rather, it is a kindness from Allah for him: He arranged causes for him for which He compensated him with abundant recompense and beautiful reward. Part of Allah's kindness to His servant is that He tests him with some calamities and grants him success in fulfilling the duty of patience in them, so He brings him to lofty ranks which he would not reach by his deeds. He may intensify the trial upon him in that, as He did with Ayyub (peace be upon him), and place in his heart the sweetness of the spirit of hope, and the expectation of mercy and of the removal of harm, so his pain is lightened and his soul is invigorated. For this reason, part of Allah's kindness to the believers is that He placed in their hearts the seeking of reward, so their calamities became light and the hardships they meet in attaining His pleasure became easy.
Part of Allah's kindness to His weak believing servant is that He spares him the causes of trial that would weaken his faith and diminish his certainty. Just as part of His kindness to the strong believer is preparing the causes of trial and testing, helping him through them and carrying them for him, so that his faith increases thereby and his reward becomes great. So glory be to Al-Latif in His testing and His granting of well-being, in His giving and His withholding.
Part of Allah's kindness to His servant is that he strives for the perfection of his soul by the nearest path that brings him to that, while there exist other paths that would be long for him. So He makes easy for him learning from a book or a teacher through whom the attainment of the goal is nearer and easier. Likewise, He makes easy for him an act of worship that he performs in a state of ease and facility, without being held back from other things that benefit him. This is from kindness.
Part of Allah's kindness to His servant — [when He has] decreed [for him] many incoming matters, various occupations, and inner and outer affairs to manage and attend to, which, if divided among a whole nation of people, their strength would fall short of them — is that He favours him with an ample character, a spacious breast and an open heart, such that he gives each single one of them penetrating consideration and complete management, while he is not bothered or disturbed by their great number and variety; rather, Allah the Exalted has helped him in them, been kind to him in them, and been kind for him in easing their causes and paths. If you wish to recognise this matter, look at the state of the Chosen One ﷺ, whom Allah sent for the betterment of both abodes and the attainment of both kinds of happiness, and sent him as one who perfected himself and perfected a great nation, the best of nations. Despite this, Allah enabled him, in part of his noble life — about a third of his life — to carry out the entire command of Allah, with its abundance and variety; to establish for his nation all of their religion and teach them all its fundamentals and branches; and Allah brought out through him a great nation from darknesses into light, and achieved through him, of benefits, advantages, good and happiness for the elite and the common people, what no nation of the creation could accomplish.
Part of Allah the Exalted's kindness to His servant is that He makes the sins with which He tests him a cause of His mercy: when that occurs, He opens for him the door of repentance, humble entreaty and earnest supplication to his Lord, belittling and disdaining his own self, and the removal of self-admiration and arrogance from his heart — which is better for him than many acts of obedience.
And part of His kindness to the servant who is beloved to Him, when his soul inclines towards harmful desires of the soul and lets itself go in that, is that He diminishes them for him and makes them turbid, so that he hardly partakes of anything of them except coupled with what spoils it and stuffed with bitterness, lest he incline towards them completely; just as part of His kindness to him is that He makes acts of drawing near delightful to him and makes acts of obedience sweet to him, so that he inclines towards them completely.
Among the subtleties of Allah's kindness to His servant is that He rewards him for deeds he did not do but resolved upon: he resolves upon one of the acts of drawing near, then his resolve is undone for some reason, so he does not do it, yet he obtains its reward. So look how Allah was kind to him: He placed it in his heart and turned it over in his mind, while He, the Exalted, knew that he would not do it — as a way of conveying His goodness and beneficence to His servant by every path.
Even more subtle than that is that He arranges for His servant another act of obedience, other than the one he resolved upon, which is more beneficial for him than it. So the servant leaves the act of obedience that pleases his Lord for another act of obedience that is more pleasing to Allah than it, and so he obtains the one done in action and the one resolved upon by intention. If one who emigrates to Allah and His Messenger and then death overtakes him before attaining his aim has his reward fall upon Allah — even though death cut him off without his choice — then what about one whose excellent intention cut him off from an act of obedience he had resolved to do? Allah may turn over in His servant's mind several acts of obedience, each of which, had it been alone, the servant would have done, because of his complete desire, yet none of them can be done except by forgoing the other; so He grants him success in weighing between them and preferring the best of them in action, while hoping to obtain all of them in resolve and intention.
Even more subtle than this is that He, the Exalted, decrees for His servant and tests him with the presence of the causes of a sin, and provides its motives in abundance, while He, the Exalted, knows that he will not do it, so that his leaving that sin, the causes of which were abundantly present, becomes among the greatest acts of obedience.
Just as He was kind to Yusuf (peace be upon him) in the woman's attempt to seduce him. And one of the seven whom Allah will shade in His shade on the Day when there is no shade but His shade is a man who is called by a woman of status and beauty, and he says: I fear Allah, the Lord of the worlds.
Part of Allah's kindness to His servant is that He decrees good and beneficence from one servant and makes it flow by the hand of another servant, making him a path for its reaching the one who deserves it; so Allah rewards the first and the second. Part of Allah's kindness to His servant is that He causes some benefit and good for others to flow from some of his wealth, so He rewards him from where he does not expect. Whoever plants a tree or sows a crop, and a living being of those deserving respect takes something from it, Allah rewards its owner while he does not know — especially if he has a good intention and has made a pact with his Lord that whenever any benefit results from his wealth, then: I ask You, O Lord, to reward me and make it a means of nearness for me with You. Likewise if he has livestock whose milk, riding and carrying are benefited from; or dwellings whose occupancy is benefited from, even a little; or utensils and the like that are benefited from; or a spring from which [people] drink; and other than that, such as a book benefited from in learning something from it, or a copy of the Quran that is read from. And Allah is the Possessor of great bounty.
Part of Allah's kindness to His servant is that He opens for him one of the doors of good that had not crossed his mind — not because of little desire for it, but only because of heedlessness and inattention to that path — and before he knows it, he finds in his heart what calls him to it and turns him towards it. So he rejoices in that, and knows that it is one of the kindnesses of his Master and His ways which He arranged to reach him; so he turns his mind to it, directs his thought towards it, and attains of it what Allah wills".

lesson.ar: أَنْ يَرْضَى الْعَبْدُ بِمَا يُقَدِّرُهُ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ مِمَّا يَكْرَهُ، وَيُحْسِنَ الظَّنَّ بِلُطْفِ رَبِّهِ فِيمَا صَرَفَهُ عَنْهُ مِنْ مَطَالِبِ الدُّنْيَا، وَيُكْثِرَ مِنْ سُؤَالِهِ: يَا لَطِيفُ الْطُفْ بِي.
lesson.en: Accept with contentment what Allah decrees for you even when you dislike it, trust your Lord's gentleness when He turns some worldly wish away from you, and often ask Him: «Ya Latif, be gentle with me.»

evidence.text: لا تُدْرِكُهُ الأَبْصَارُ وَهُوَ يُدْرِكُ الأَبْصَارَ وَهُوَ اللَّطِيفُ الْخَبِيرُ

summary.ar:
قَالَ الْمُؤَلِّفُ رَحِمَهُ اللَّهُ: "الْمَلِكُ الْمَالِكُ: الَّذِي لَهُ الْمُلْكُ فَهُوَ الْمَوْصُوفُ بِصِفَةِ الْمُلْكِ وَهِيَ صِفَاتُ الْعَظَمَةِ وَالْكِبْرِيَاءِ، وَالْقَهْرِ، وَالتَّدْبِيرِ، الَّذِي لَهُ التَّصَرُّفُ الْمُطْلَقُ، فِي الْخَلْقِ وَالْأَمْرِ وَالْجَزَاءِ.
وَلَهُ جَمِيعُ الْعَالَمِ الْعُلْوِيِّ وَالسُّفْلِيِّ، كُلُّهُمْ عَبِيدٌ، وَمَمَالِيكُ، وَمُضْطَرُّونَ إِلَيْهِ وَهُوَ الْآمِرُ النَّاهِي الْمُعِزُّ الْمُذِلُّ الَّذِي يُصَرِّفُ أُمُورَ عِبَادِهِ كَمَا يُحِبُّ، وَيُقَلِّبُهُمْ كَمَا يَشَاءُ، وَلَهُ مِنْ مَعْنَى الْمُلْكِ مَا يَسْتَحِقُّهُ مِنَ الْأَسْمَاءِ الْحُسْنَى كَالْعَزِيزِ الْجَبَّارِ الْمُتَكَبِّرِ، الْحَكَمِ، الْعَدْلِ، الْخَافِضِ، الرَّافِعِ، الْمُعِزِّ، وَالْمُذِلِّ، الْعَظِيمِ، الْجَلِيلِ، الْكَبِيرِ، الْحَسِيبِ، الْمَجِيدِ، الْوَالِي، الْمُتَعَالِي، مَالِكِ الْمُلْكِ، الْمُتَسَلِّطِ، الْجَامِعِ، إِلَى غَيْرِ ذَٰلِكَ مِنَ الْأَسْمَاءِ الْعَائِدَةِ إِلَى الْمُلْكِ.
summary.en:
The author (may Allah have mercy on him) said: "Al-Malik (the King), Al-Maalik (the Owner): the One to whom the dominion belongs. He is the One described with the attribute of kingship, which are the attributes of greatness, grandeur, subjugation and disposal of affairs; the One who has absolute control over the creation, the command and the recompense.
To Him belongs the entire upper and lower world; all of them are slaves, owned by Him, and in dire need of Him. He is the One who commands and forbids, who honours and humiliates, who directs the affairs of His slaves as He loves and turns them about as He wills. And of the meaning of kingship, He has what He is worthy of among the Most Beautiful Names, such as Al-Aziz (the Almighty), Al-Jabbar (the Compeller), Al-Mutakabbir (the Supreme in Greatness), Al-Hakam (the Judge), Al-Adl (the Just), Al-Khafid (the Abaser), Ar-Rafi' (the Exalter), Al-Mu'izz (the Giver of Honour), Al-Mudhill (the Humiliator), Al-Azim (the Magnificent), Al-Jalil (the Majestic), Al-Kabir (the Great), Al-Hasib (the Reckoner), Al-Majid (the Glorious), Al-Wali (the Governor), Al-Muta'ali (the Most Exalted), Malik al-Mulk (the Owner of Dominion), Al-Mutasallit (the Dominant), Al-Jami' (the Gatherer), and other names that go back to kingship.

lesson.ar: أَنْ يَعْلَمَ الْعَبْدُ أَنَّهُ عَبْدٌ مَمْلُوكٌ لِرَبِّهِ مُضْطَرٌّ إِلَيْهِ، فَيَخْضَعَ لِأَمْرِهِ وَنَهْيِهِ، وَيَرْضَى بِتَصْرِيفِهِ لِأُمُورِهِ، وَلَا يَلْجَأَ فِي حَاجَاتِهِ إِلَّا إِلَى مَالِكِهِ.
lesson.en: Know that you are a slave owned by your Lord and in desperate need of Him: submit to His commands and prohibitions, accept how He directs your affairs, and turn to no one but your Owner in your needs.

evidence.text: مَالِكِ يَوْمِ الدِّينِ

summary.ar:
قَالَ رَحِمَهُ اللَّهُ: "الْمُعْطِي الْمَانِعُ هَٰذِهِ مِنَ الْأَسْمَاءِ الْمُتَقَابِلَةِ الَّتِي لَا يَنْبَغِي أَنْ يُثْنَي عَلَى اللَّهِ بِهَا إِلَّا كُلُّ وَاحِدٍ مِنْهَا مَعَ الْآخَرِ لِأَنَّ الْكَمَالَ الْمُطْلَقَ مِنِ اجْتِمَاعِ الْوَصْفَيْنِ.
فَهُوَ الْمُعْطِي الْمَانِعُ: لَا مَانِعَ لِمَا أَعْطَى، وَلَا مُعْطِيَ لِمَا مَنَعَ، فَجَمِيعُ الْمَصَالِحِ وَالْمَنَافِعِ مِنْهُ تُطْلَبُ، وَإِلَيْهِ يُرْغَبُ فِيهَا، وَهُوَ الَّذِي يُعْطِيهَا لِمَنْ شَاءَ وَيَمْنَعُهَا مَنْ يَشَاءُ بِحِكْمَتِهِ وَرَحْمَتِهِ".
summary.en:
He (may Allah have mercy on him) said: "Al-Mu'ti (the Giver), Al-Mani' (the Withholder): these are among the corresponding names with which Allah should not be praised except each one of them together with the other, because absolute perfection lies in the combination of the two descriptions.
So He is Al-Mu'ti, Al-Mani': there is none to withhold what He gives, and none to give what He withholds. All benefits and good things are sought from Him, and it is to Him that one turns in desire for them. He is the One who gives them to whom He wills and withholds them from whom He wills, by His wisdom and His mercy".

lesson.ar: أَنْ يَطْلُبَ الْعَبْدُ جَمِيعَ مَصَالِحِهِ وَمَنَافِعِهِ مِنَ اللَّهِ وَحْدَهُ وَيَرْغَبَ إِلَيْهِ فِيهَا، وَيَرْضَى بِمَنْعِهِ كَمَا يَشْكُرُ عَطَاءَهُ، فَإِنَّهُ يَمْنَعُ بِحِكْمَتِهِ وَرَحْمَتِهِ.
lesson.en: Seek every benefit and good from Allah alone and direct your desire to Him; accept what He withholds just as you thank Him for what He gives, for He withholds out of wisdom and mercy.

note.ar: سبق زيادة بيان لمعنى هذا الإسم مع اسمه تعالى: "الباسط".
note.en: The meaning of this name has already been explained further together with His name "Al-Basit" (the Extender).

summary.ar: قَالَ رَحِمَهُ اللَّهُ: "الْمُبْدِئُ الْمُعِيدُ قَالَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى: ﴿وَهُوَ الَّذِي يَبْدأُ الْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُ﴾ ابْتَدَأَ خَلْقَهُمْ لِيَبْلُوَهُمْ أَيُّهُمْ أَحْسَنُ عَمَلاً ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُمْ لِيَجْزِيَ الَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوا بِالْحُسْنَى وَيَجْزِئَ الْمُسِيئِينَ بِإِسَأَتِهِمْ. وَكَذَٰلِكَ هُوَ الَّذِي يَبْدَأُ إِيجَادَ الْمَخْلُوقَاتِ شَيْئاً فَشَيْئاً ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهَا كُلَّ وَقْتٍ".
summary.en: He (may Allah have mercy on him) said: "Al-Mubdi' (the Originator), Al-Mu'id (the Restorer): Allah the Exalted said: ﴾And it is He who begins creation; then He repeats it﴿. He began their creation in order to test them as to which of them is best in deed, then He brings them back in order to reward those who did good with the best [reward] and to recompense the evildoers for their evil. Likewise, He is the One who begins bringing created things into existence, one thing after another, then He repeats them at every time".

lesson.ar: أَنْ يَتَذَكَّرَ الْعَبْدُ أَنَّ اللَّهَ خَلَقَ الْعِبَادَ لِيَبْلُوَهُمْ أَيُّهُمْ أَحْسَنُ عَمَلًا، وَأَنَّ رَبَّهُ الَّذِي بَدَأَ خَلْقَهُ سَيُعِيدُهُ لِيَجْزِيَهُ، فَيَسْتَعِدَّ لِلِقَائِهِ بِالْإِحْسَانِ.
lesson.en: Remember that you were created to be tested as to who is best in deeds, and that your Lord who began your creation will bring you back to repay you — so prepare to meet Him by doing good.

note.ar: لم أقف على نص صحيح يدل على تسمية الله تعالى بهذين الاسمين. وقد عدهما ضمن الأسماء الحسنى الزجاج (ص٥٥) والخطابي في شأن الدعاء (ص٧٩) والبيهقي في كتابه الأسماء والصفات (ص٩٥) والغزالي في كتابه المقصد الأسنى شرح أسماء الله الحسنى (ص٦٣).
note.en: I have not found an authentic text naming Allah the Exalted by these two names. They were counted among the Beautiful Names by az-Zajjaj (p. 55), al-Khattabi in Sha'n ad-Du'a' (p. 79), al-Bayhaqi in his book al-Asma' wa as-Sifat (p. 95), and al-Ghazali in his book al-Maqsad al-Asna fi Sharh Asma' Allah al-Husna (p. 63).

name: الْمُتَكَبِّرُ
meaning: The Supremely Great, above all faults

summary.ar: قَالَ رَحِمَهُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى: "الْمُتَكَبِّرُ عَنِ السُّوءِ، وَالنَّقْصِ، وَالْعُيُوبِ لِعَظَمَتِهِ، وَكِبْرِيَائِهِ".
summary.en: He (may Allah have mercy on him) said: "Al-Mutakabbir (the Supreme in Greatness): [exalted] above evil, deficiency and defects, because of His greatness and His grandeur".

lesson.ar: أَنْ يُنَزِّهَ الْعَبْدُ رَبَّهُ عَنْ كُلِّ سُوءٍ وَنَقْصٍ وَعَيْبٍ، وَيَتَوَاضَعَ لَهُ وَلِعِبَادِهِ، فَإِنَّ الْكِبْرِيَاءَ لَا تَلِيقُ إِلَّا بِهِ سُبْحَانَهُ.
lesson.en: Declare your Lord far above every evil, deficiency and fault, and be humble before Him and towards His servants, for supreme greatness befits Him alone.

evidence.text: هُوَ اللَّهُ الَّذِي لا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْمَلِكُ الْقُدُّوسُ السَّلامُ الْمُؤْمِنُ الْمُهَيْمِنُ الْعَزِيزُ الْجَبَّارُ الْمُتَكَبِّرُ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ

summary.ar:
قَالَ رَحِمَهُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى: "هَذِهِ الْأَسْمَاءُ الْعَظِيمَةُ مَعَانِيهَا مُتَقَارِبَةٌ فَهُوَ تَعَالَى كَامِلُ الْقُوَّةِ عَظِيمُ الْقُدْرَةِ شَامِلُ الْعِزَّةِ ﴿إِنَّ الْعِزَّةَ لِلَّهِ جَمِيعاً﴾.
الْعَزِيزُ الَّذِي لَهُ الْعِزَّةُ كُلُّهَا عِزَّةُ الْقُوَّةِ، وَعِزَّةُ الْغَلَبَةِ وَعِزَّةُ الِامْتِنَاعِ، فَمُمْتَنِعٌ أَنْ يَنَالَهُ أَحَدٌ مِنَ الْمَخْلُوقَاتِ وَقَهَرَ جَمِيعَ الْمَوْجُودَاتِ، وَدَانَتْ لَهُ الْخَلِيقَةُ وَخَضَعَتْ لِعَظَمَتِهِ.
فَمَعَانِي الْعِزَّةِ الثَّلَاثُ كُلُّهَا كَامِلَةٌ لِلَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ عِزَّةُ الْقُوَّةِ الدَّالُّ عَلَيْهَا مِنْ أَسْمَائِهِ الْقَوِيُّ الْمَتِينُ، وَهِيَ وَصْفُهُ الْعَظِيمُ الَّذِي لَا تُنْسَبُ إِلَيْهِ قُوَّةُ الْمَخْلُوقَاتِ وَإِنْ عَظُمَتْ، وَعِزَّةُ الِامْتِنَاعِ فَإِنَّهُ هُوَ الْغَنِيُّ بِذَاتِهِ فَلَا يَحْتَاجُ إِلَى أَحَدٍ، وَلَا يَبْلُغُ الْعِبَادُ ضَرَّةْ فَيَضُرُّونَهُ، وَلَا نَفْعَهُ فَيَنْفَعُونَهُ بَلْ هُوَ الضَّارُّ النَّافِعُ الْمُعْطِي الْمَانِعُ، وَعِزَّةُ الْقَهْرِ وَالْغَلَبَةِ لِكُلِّ الْكَائِنَاتِ فَهِيَ كُلُّهَا مَقْصُورَةٌ لِلَّهِ خَاضِعَةٌ لِعَظَمَتِهِ مُنْقَادَةٌ لِإِرَادَتِهِ، فَجَمِيعُ نَوَاصِي الْمَخْلُوقَاتِ بِيَدِهِ، لَا يَتَحَرَّكُ مِنْهَا مُتَحَرِّكٌ وَلَا يَتَصَرَّفُ مُتَصَرِّفٌ إِلَّا بِحَوْلِهِ وَقُوَّتِهِ وَإِذْنِهِ، فَمَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ كَانَ، وَمَا لَمْ يَشَأْ لَمْ يَكُنْ، وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِهِ، فَمِنْ قُوَّتِهِ وَاقْتِدَارِهِ أَنَّهُ خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ، وَالْأَرْضَ، وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِي سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ، وَأَنَّهُ خَلَقَ الْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ يُمِيتُهُمْثُمَّ يُحْيِيهِمْ ثُمَّ إِلَيْهِ يُرْجَعُونَ ﴿مَا خَلْقُكُمْ وَلا بَعْثُكُمْ إلا كَنَفْسٍ وَاحِدَةٍ﴾. ﴿وَهُوَ الَّذِي يَبْدأُ الْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُ وَهُوَ أَهْوَنُ عَلَيْه﴾ وَمِنْ آثَارِ قُدْرَتِهِ أَنَّكَ تَرَى الْأَرْضَ هَامِدَةً، فَإِذَا أَنْزَلَ عَلَيْهَا الْمَاءَ اعْتَزَّتْ وَرَبَتْ وَأَنْبَتَتْ مِنْ كُلِّ زَوْجٍ بَهِيجٍ، وَمِنْ آثَارِ قُدْرَتِهِ مَا أَوْقَعَهُ بِالْأُمَمِ الْمُكَذِّبِينَ، وَالْكُفَّارِ الظَّالِمِينَ مِنْ أَنْوَاعِ الْعُقُوبَاتِ وَحُلُولِ الْمَثُلَاتِ، وَأَنَّهُ لَمْ يُغْنِ عَنْهُمْ كَيْدُهُمْ، وَمَكْرُهُمْ، وَلَا أَمْوَالُهُمْ، وَلَا جُنُودُهُمْ، وَلَا حُصُونُهُمْ مِنْ عَذَابِ اللَّهِ مِنْ شَيْءٍ لَمَّا جَاءَ أَمْرُ رَبِّكَ، وَمَا زَادُوهُمْ غَيْرَ تَتْبِيبٍ، وَخُصُوصاً فِي هَذِهِ الْأَوْقَاتِ فَإِنَّ هَذِهِ الْقُوَّةَ الْهَائِلَةَ، وَالْمُخْتَرَعَاتِ الْبَاهِرَةَ الَّتِي وَصَلَتْ إِلَيْهَا مَقْدِرَةُ هَذِهِ الْأُمَمِ هِيَ مِنْ أِقْدَارِ اللَّهِ لَهُمْ وَتَعْلِيمِهِ لَهُمْ، مَا لَمْ يَكُونُوا يَعْلَمُونَهُ، فَمِنْ آيَاتِ اللَّهِ أَنَّ قُوَاهُمْ، وَقُدَرَهُمْ وَمُخْتَرَعَاتِهِمْ لَمْ تُغْنِ عَنْهُمْ شَيْئاً فِي صَدِّ مَا أَصَابَهُمْ مِنَ النَّكَبَاتِ، وَالْعُقُوبَاتِ الْمُهْلِكَةِ مَعَ بَذْلِ جِدِّهِمْ وَاجْتِهَادِهِمْ فِي تَوَقِّي ذَلِكَ، وَلَكِنَّ أَمْرَ اللَّهِ غَالِبٌ، وَقُدْرَتُهُ تَنْقَادُ لَهَا عَنَاصِرُ الْعَالَمِ الْعُلْوِيِّ، وَالسُّفْلِيِّ.
وَمِنْ تَمَامِ عِزَّتِهِ وَقُدْرَتِهِ وَشُمُولِهِمَا أَنَّهُ كَمَا أَنَّهُ هُوَ الْخَالِقُ لِلْعِبَادِ فَهُوَ خَالِقُ أَعْمَالِهِمْ وَطَاعَتِهِمْ وَمَعَاصِيهِمْ، وَهِيَ أَيْضاً أَفْعَالُهُمْ، فَهِيَ تُضَافُ إِلَى اللَّهِ خَلْقاً وَتَقْدِيراً وَتُضَافُ إِلَيْهِمْ فِعْلاً وَمُبَاشَرَةً عَلَى الْحَقِيقَةِ وَلَا مُنَافَاةَ بَيْنَ الْأَمْرَيْنِ، فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ خَالِقُ قُدْرَتِهِمْ وَإِرَادَتِهِمْ، وَخَالِقُ السَّبَبِ التَّامِّ خَالِقٌ لِلْمُسَبَّبِ قَالَ تَعَالَى: ﴿وَاللَّهُ خَلَقَكُمْ وَمَا تَعْمَلُونَ﴾.
وَمِنْ آثَارِ قُدْرَتِهِ مَا ذَكَرَهُ فِي كِتَابِهِ مِنْ نُصْرَةِ أَوْلِيَاءِهِ عَلَى قِلَّةِ عَدَدِهِمْ وَعُدَدِهِمْ عَلَى أَعْدَائِهِمُ الَّذِينَ فَاقُوهُمْ بِكَثْرَةِ الْعَدَدِ، وَالْعُدَّةِ، قَالَ تَعَالَى: ﴿كَمْ مِنْ فِئَةٍ قَلِيلَةٍ غَلَبَتْ فِئَةً كَثِيرَةً بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ﴾.
وَمِنْ آثَارِ قُدْرَتِهِ وَرَحْمَتِهِ مَا يُحْدِثُهُ لِأَهْلِ النَّارِ، وَأَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ مِنْ أَنْوَاعِ الْعِقَابِ، وَأَصْنَافِ النَّعِيمِ الْمُسْتَمِرِّ الْكَثِيرِ الْمُتَتَابِعِ الَّذِي لَا يَنْقَطِعُ، وَلَا يَتَنَاهَى".
summary.en:
He (may Allah have mercy on him) said: "These great names have closely related meanings. He, the Exalted, is perfect in strength, great in power, all-encompassing in might: ﴾Indeed, might belongs to Allah entirely﴿.
Al-'Aziz (the Almighty) is the One to whom belongs all might: the might of strength, the might of dominance, and the might of being unassailable. So it is impossible for any created being to reach Him; He has subdued all existing things, and the creation has submitted to Him and humbled itself before His greatness.
