So the three meanings of might are all perfect for Allah, the Great: the might of strength, which is indicated among His names by Al-Qawi (the Strong) and Al-Matin (the Firm), and it is His great attribute to which the strength of created beings bears no comparison, however great it may be; the might of being unassailable, for He is the One free of need by His very Self, so He needs no one, and the servants cannot attain harming Him so as to harm Him, nor benefiting Him so as to benefit Him — rather He is the One who harms and benefits, who gives and withholds; and the might of subjugation and dominance over all beings, for they are all subjugated to Allah, submissive to His greatness, yielding to His will. The forelocks of all created beings are in His hand; nothing moves among them and nothing acts except by His might, His strength and His permission. Whatever Allah wills happens, and whatever He does not will does not happen, and there is no might nor power except by Him. Part of His strength and power is that He created the heavens, the earth and what is between them in six days, and that He created the creation, then He causes them to die, then gives them life, then to Him they return: ﴾Your creation and your resurrection will not be but as that of a single soul﴿. ﴾And it is He who begins creation; then He repeats it, and that is [even] easier for Him﴿ Among the effects of His power is that you see the earth barren, and when He sends down rain upon it, it quivers and swells and grows [something] of every beautiful kind. Among the effects of His power is what He inflicted upon the nations who denied and the wrongdoing disbelievers of various punishments and exemplary chastisements, and that neither their scheming, nor their plotting, nor their wealth, nor their soldiers, nor their fortresses availed them anything against the punishment of Allah when the command of your Lord came, and they did not increase them other than ruin. This is especially so in these times: this tremendous strength and these dazzling inventions which the capability of these nations has reached are from Allah's enabling them and His teaching them what they did not know. And among the signs of Allah is that their strengths, their capabilities and their inventions did not avail them anything in warding off the disasters and destructive punishments that befell them, despite their exerting their utmost effort and striving to guard against that. But the command of Allah prevails, and the elements of the upper and lower worlds submit to His power.
Part of the completeness and all-inclusiveness of His might and power is that, just as He is the Creator of the servants, He is the Creator of their deeds, their acts of obedience and their acts of disobedience — and they are also their [own] actions. So they are ascribed to Allah in terms of creation and decree, and ascribed to them in terms of doing and carrying out, in reality, and there is no contradiction between the two matters. For Allah is the Creator of their ability and their will, and the Creator of the complete cause is the Creator of the effect. The Exalted said: ﴾While Allah created you and that which you do﴿.
Among the effects of His power is what He mentioned in His Book of His giving victory to His allies, despite their small number and scant equipment, over their enemies who surpassed them in great numbers and equipment. The Exalted said: ﴾How many a small company has overcome a large company by permission of Allah﴿.
Among the effects of His power and His mercy is what He brings about for the people of the Fire and the people of Paradise: kinds of punishment, and varieties of bliss that is lasting, abundant and continuous, that is neither cut off nor comes to an end".

lesson.ar: أَنْ يَعْلَمَ الْعَبْدُ أَنَّ مَا عِنْدَ الْخَلْقِ مِنْ قُوَّةٍ وَمُخْتَرَعَاتٍ إِنَّمَا هُوَ مِنْ تَعْلِيمِ اللَّهِ وَإِقْدَارِهِ لَهُمْ، فَيَشْكُرَهُ عَلَى مَا أَقْدَرَهُ عَلَيْهِ، وَلَا يَغْتَرَّ بِقُوَّتِهِ، بَلْ يَتَوَكَّلَ عَلَى رَبِّهِ الْقَوِيِّ الْمَتِينِ.
lesson.en: Know that whatever strength and inventions people have come only from Allah teaching them and enabling them; so thank Him for the ability He gives you, never be deceived by your own strength, and rely on your Lord, the Strong, the Firm.

evidence.text: إِنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ الرَّزَّاقُ ذُو الْقُوَّةِ الْمَتِينُ

note.ar: سبق الكلام على هذا الاسم مع اسمه تعالى "العزيز".
note.en: This name has already been discussed together with His name "Al-'Aziz" (the Almighty).

summary.ar:
قَالَ رَحِمَهُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى: "مِنْ أَسْمَائِهِ الْمُجِيبُ لِدَعْوَةِ الدَّاعِينَ، وَسُؤَالِ السَّائِلِينَ، وَعِبَادِهِ الْمُسْتَجِيبِينَ، وَإِجَابَتُهُ نَوْعَانِ:
إِجَابَةٌ عَامَّةٌ لِكُلِّ مَنْ دَعَاهُ دُعَاءَ عِبَادَةٍ أَوْ دُعَاءَ مَسْأَلَةٍ قَالَ تَعَالَى: ﴿وَقَالَ رَبُّكُمُ ادْعُونِي أَسْتَجِبْ لَكُمْ﴾ فَدُعَاءُ الْمَسْأَلَةِ يَقُولُ الْعَبْدُ اللَّهُمَّ أَعْطِنِي كَذَا أَوِ اللَّهُمَّ أدْفَعْ عَنِّي كَذَا، فَهَٰذَا يَقَعُ مِنَ الْبَرِّ وَالْفَاجِرِ، وَيَسْتَجِيبُ اللَّهُ فِيهِ لِكُلِّ مَنْ دَعَاهُ بِحَسَبِ الْحَالَةِ الْمُقْتَضِيَةِ، وَبِحَسَبِ مَا تَقْتَضِيهِ حِكْمَتُهُ، وَهَٰذَا يُسْتَدَلُّ بِهِ عَلَى كَرَمِ الْمَوْلَى وَشُمُولِ إِحْسَانِهِ لِلْبَرِّ وَالْفَاجِرِ، وَلَا يَدُلُّ بِمُجَرَّدِهِ عَلَى حُسْنِ حَالِ الدَّاعِي الَّذِي أُجِيبَتْ دَعْوَتُهُ إِنْ لَمْ يَقْتَرِنْ بِذَٰلِكَ مَا يَدُلُّ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَى صِدْقِهِ وَتَعَيُّنِ الْحَقِّ مَعَهُ، كَسُؤَالِ الْأَنْبِيَاءِ وَدُعَائِهِمْ لِقَوْمِهِمْ وَعَلَى قَوْمِهِمْ فَيُجِيبُهُمُ اللَّهُ، فَإِنَّهُ يَدُلُّ عَلَى صِدْقِهِمْ فِيمَا أَخْبَرُوا بِهِ وَكَرَامَتِهِمْ عَلَى رَبِّهِمْ، وَلِهَٰذَا كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَثِيراً مَا يَدْعُو بِدُعَاءٍ يُشَاهِدُ الْمُسْلِمُونَ وَغَيْرُهُمْ إِجَابَتَهُ، وَذَٰلِكَ مِنْ دَلَائِلِ نُبُوَّتِهِ وَآيَاتِ صِدْقِهِ، وَكَذَٰلِكَ مَا يَذْكُرُونَهُ عَنْ كَثِيرٍ مِنْ أَوْلِيَاءِ اللَّهِ مِنْ إِجَابَةِ الدَّعَوَاتِ فَإِنَّهُ مِنْ أَدِلَّةِ كَرَامَاتِهِمْ عَلَى اللَّهِ.
وَأَمَّا الْإِجَابَةُ الْخَاصَّةُ فَلَهَا أَسْبَابٌ عَدِيدَةٌ، مِنْهَا دَعْوَةُ الْمُضْطَرِّ الَّذِي وَقَعَ فِي شِدَّةٍ وَكُرْبَةٍ عَظِيمَةٍ، فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ يُجِيبُ دَعْوَتَهُ، قَالَ تَعَالَى: ﴿أَمَّنْ يُجِيبُ الْمُضْطَرَّ إِذَا دَعَاهُ﴾، وَسَبَبُ ذَٰلِكَ شِدَّةُ الِافْتِقَارِ إِلَى اللَّهِ، وَقُوَّةُ الِانْكِسَارِ، وَانْقِطَاعُ تَعَلُّقِهِ بِالْمَخْلُوقِينَ، وَلِسَعَةِ رَحْمَةِ اللَّهِ الَّتِي يَشْمَلُ بِهَا الْخَلْقَ بِحَسَبِ حَاجَتِهِمْ إِلَيْهَا فَكَيْفَ بِمَنِ اضْطُرَّ إِلَيْهَا، وَمِنْ أَسْبَابِ الْإِجَابَةِ طُولُ السَّفَرِ وَالتَّوَسُّلُ إِلَى اللَّهِ بِأَحَبِّ الْوَسَائِلِ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ أَسْمَائِهِ، وَصِفَاتِهِ، وَنِعَمِهِ. وَكَذَٰلِكَ دَعْوَةُ الْمَرِيضِ، وَالْمَظْلُومِ، وَالصَّائِمِ، وَالْوَالِدِ عَلَى وَلَدِهِ، أَوْ لَهُ فِي الْأَوْقَاتِ وَالْأَحْوَالِ الشَّرِيفَةِ".
summary.en:
He (may Allah have mercy on him) said: "Among His names is Al-Mujib (the Responsive), who answers the supplication of those who supplicate, the requests of those who ask, and His slaves who respond [to Him]. His answering is of two types:
A general answering, for everyone who calls upon Him, whether with the supplication of worship or the supplication of request. The Exalted said: ﴾And your Lord says, 'Call upon Me; I will respond to you.'﴿ In the supplication of request, the slave says, 'O Allah, give me such-and-such,' or 'O Allah, ward off such-and-such from me.' This occurs from the righteous and the wicked alike, and Allah responds in it to everyone who calls upon Him according to what the situation requires and according to what His wisdom requires. This is taken as evidence of the generosity of the Master and of how His kindness encompasses the righteous and the wicked. By itself, however, it does not indicate the good state of the supplicant whose supplication was answered, unless it is accompanied by something that indicates that, and his truthfulness, and that the truth is definitely with him; such as the requests of the prophets and their supplications for their peoples and against their peoples, and Allah answers them, for this indicates their truthfulness in what they informed of and their honour with their Lord. For this reason the Prophet ﷺ often made supplications whose answering the Muslims and others witnessed, and that is among the proofs of his prophethood and the signs of his truthfulness. Likewise what they mention of the answering of supplications for many of the allies of Allah, for it is among the proofs of their honour with Allah.
As for the special answering, it has many causes. Among them is the supplication of the one in dire need who has fallen into hardship and great distress, for Allah answers his supplication. The Exalted said: ﴾Is He [not best] who responds to the desperate one when he calls upon Him﴿. The reason for that is the intensity of [his] need for Allah, the strength of [his] brokenness, and the severing of his attachment to created beings; and also the vastness of Allah's mercy, with which He encompasses the creation according to their need for it, so how much more the one who is in dire need of it! Among the causes of answering are a long journey, and seeking a means of approach to Allah through the means most beloved to Him: His names, His attributes and His favours. Likewise the supplication of the sick, the oppressed, the fasting person, and of the parent against his child or for him, at noble times and in noble circumstances".

lesson.ar: أَنْ يَدْعُوَ الْعَبْدُ رَبَّهُ دُعَاءَ عِبَادَةٍ وَدُعَاءَ مَسْأَلَةٍ، وَيَتَحَرَّى أَسْبَابَ الْإِجَابَةِ: الِافْتِقَارَ وَالِانْكِسَارَ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ، وَالتَّوَسُّلَ إِلَيْهِ بِأَسْمَائِهِ وَصِفَاتِهِ وَنِعَمِهِ، وَالْأَوْقَاتَ وَالْأَحْوَالَ الشَّرِيفَةَ.
lesson.en: Call on Allah both through worship and by asking Him for your needs, and seek out the causes of His answer: humble neediness before Him, calling on Him by His names, attributes and blessings, and the blessed times and states.

evidence.text: إِنَّ رَبِّي قَرِيبٌ مُجِيبٌ

summary.ar: قَالَ رَحِمَهُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى: "الْمَجِيدُ الَّذِي لَهُ الْمَجْدُ الْعَظِيمُ، وَالْمَجْدُ هُوَ عَظَمَةُ الصِّفَاتِ، وَسَعَتُهَا فَكُلُّ وَصْفٍ مِنْ أَوْصَافِهِ عَظِيمٌ شَأْنُهُ فَهُوَ الْعَلِيمُ الْكَامِلُ فِي عِلْمِهِ، الرَّحِيمُ الَّذِي وَسِعَتْ رَحْمَتُهُ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ، الْقَدِيرُ الَّذِي لَا يُعْجِزُهُ شَيْءٌ، الْحَلِيمُ الْكَامِلُ فِي حِلْمِهِ، الْحَكِيمُ الْكَامِلُ فِي حِكْمَتِهِ إِلَى بَقِيَّةِ أَسْمَائِهِ وَصِفَاتِهِ".
summary.en: He (may Allah have mercy on him) said: "Al-Majid (the Glorious) is the One who has immense glory. Glory is the greatness of the attributes and their vastness, so every one of His attributes is immense in its significance. He is Al-Alim (the All-Knowing), perfect in His knowledge; Ar-Rahim (the Most Merciful), whose mercy encompasses all things; Al-Qadir (the All-Capable), whom nothing can render incapable; Al-Halim (the Forbearing), perfect in His forbearance; Al-Hakim (the All-Wise), perfect in His wisdom; and so on through the rest of His names and attributes".

lesson.ar: أَنْ يُعَظِّمَ الْعَبْدُ رَبَّهُ وَيُثْنِيَ عَلَيْهِ بِصِفَاتِ الْمَجْدِ وَالْكَمَالِ، عَالِمًا أَنَّ كُلَّ صِفَةٍ مِنْ صِفَاتِهِ عَظِيمَةٌ وَاسِعَةٌ كَامِلَةٌ.
lesson.en: Glorify your Lord and praise Him with His attributes of glory and perfection, knowing that every one of His attributes is great, vast and perfect.

evidence.text: رَحْمَتُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ عَلَيْكُمْ أَهْلَ الْبَيْتِ إِنَّهُ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ

summary.ar: قَالَ رَحِمَهُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى: "الْمُحِيطُ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عِلْماً، وَقُدْرَةً، وَرَحْمَةً، وَقَهْرًا".
summary.en: He (may Allah have mercy on him) said: "Al-Muhit (the All-Encompassing): the One who encompasses everything in knowledge, power, mercy and subjugation".

lesson.ar: أَنْ يَسْتَحْضِرَ الْعَبْدُ إِحَاطَةَ اللَّهِ بِهِ عِلْمًا وَقُدْرَةً وَقَهْرًا فَيُرَاقِبَهُ وَيَخْشَاهُ، وَإِحَاطَتَهُ بِهِ رَحْمَةً فَيَرْجُوَهُ وَلَا يَقْنَطَ.
lesson.en: Remember that Allah encompasses you with His knowledge, power and might, so be mindful of Him and fear Him; and that He encompasses you with His mercy, so hope in Him and never despair.

evidence.text: وَكَانَ اللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ مُحِيطاً

summary.ar:
قَالَ رَحِمَهُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى: " الْقَابِضُ الْبَاسِطُ، الْخَافِضُ الرَّافِعُ، الْمُعِزُّ الْمُذِلُّ، الْمَانِعُ الْمُعْطِي، الضَّارُّ النَّافِعُ".
"هَذِهِ الْأَسْمَاءُ الْكَرِيمَةُ مِنَ الْأَسْمَاءِ الْمُتَقَابِلَاتِ الَّتِي لَا يَنْبَغِي أَنْ يُثْنَى عَلَى اللَّهِ بِهَا إِلَّا كُلُّ وَاحِدٍ مَعَ الْآخَرِ لِأَنَّ الْكَمَالَ الْمُطْلَقَ مِنِ اجْتِمَاعِ الْوَصْفَيْنِ، فَهُوَ الْقَابِضُ لِلْأَرْزَاقِ وَالْأَرْوَاحِ وَالنُّفُوسِ، وَالْبَاسِطُ لِلْأَرْزَاقِ، وَالرَّحْمَةِ، وَالْقُلُوبِ، وَهُوَ الرَّافِعُ لِلْأَقْوَامِ الْقَائِمِينَ بِالْعِلْمِ وَالْإِيمَانِ الْخَافِضُ لِأَعْدَائِهِ، وَهُوَ الْمُعِزُّ لِأَهْلِ طَاعَتِهِ، وَهَذَا عِزٌّ حَقِيقِيٌّ، فَإِنَّ الْمُطِيعَ لِلَّهِ عَزِيزٌ وَإِنْ كَانَ فَقِيرًا لَيْسَ لَهُ أَعْوَانٌ، الْمُذِلُّ لِأَهْلِ مَعْصِيَتِهِ، وَأَعْدَائِهِ ذُلًّا فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ فَالْعَاصِي وَإِنْ ظَهَرَ بِمَظَاهِرِ الْعِزِّ فَقَلْبُهُ حَشْوُهُ الذُّلُّ وَإِنْ لَمْ يَشْعُرْ بِهِ لِانْغِمَاسِهِ فِي الشَّهَوَاتِ فَإِنَّ الْعِزَّ كُلَّ الْعِزِّ بِطَاعَةِ اللَّهِ، وَالذُّلَّ بِمَعْصِيَتِهِ ﴿وَمَنْ يُهِنِ اللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُ مِنْ مُكْرِمٍ﴾ ﴿مَنْ كَانَ يُرِيدُ الْعِزَّةَ فَلِلَّهِ الْعِزَّةُ جَمِيعاً﴾ ﴿وَلِلَّهِ الْعِزَّةُ وَلِرَسُولِهِ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ وَهُوَ تَعَالَى الْمَانِعُ الْمُعْطِي فَلَا مُعْطِيَ لِمَا مَنَعَ وَلَا مَانِعَ لِمَا أَعْطَى وَهُوَ تَعَالَى النَّافِعُ لِمَنْ شَاءَ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ بِالْمَنَافِعِ الدِّينِيَّةِ وَالدُّنْيَوِيَّةِ، الضَّارُّ لِمَنْ فَعَلَ الْأَسْبَابَ الَّتِي تُوجِبُ ذَلِكَ.
وَهَذِهِ الْأُمُورُ كُلُّهَا تَبَعٌ لِعَدْلِهِ، وَحِكْمَتِهِ، وَحَمْدِهِ، فَإِنَّ لَهُ الْحِكْمَةَ فِي خَفْضِ مَنْ يَخْفِضُهُ، وَيُذِلُّهُ، وَيَحْرِمُهُ، وَلَا حُجَّةَ لِأَحَدٍ عَلَى اللَّهِ، كَمَا لَهُ الْفَضْلُ الْخَفِيُّ عَلَى مَنْ رَفَعَهُ وَأَعْطَاهُ وَيَبْسُطُ لَهُ الْخَيْرَاتِ.
فَعَلَى الْعَبْدِ أَنْ يَعْتَرِفَ بِحِكْمَةِ اللَّهِ، كَمَا عَلَيْهِ أَنْ يَعْتَرِفَ بِفَضْلِهِ وَيَشْكُرَهُ بِلِسَانِهِ وَجَنَانِهِ وَأَرْكَانِهِ.
وَكَمَا أَنَّهُ هُوَ الْمُنْفَرِدُ بِهَذِهِ الْأُمُورِ كُلُّهَا جَارِيَةٌ تَحْتَ أَقْدَارِهِ، فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ جَعَلَ لِرَفْعِهِ وَعَطَائِهِ وَإِكْرَامِهِ أَسْبَابًا، وَلِضِدِّ ذَلِكَ أَسْبَابًا مَنْ قَامَ بِهَا تَرَتَّبَتْ عَلَيْهِ مُسَبَّبَاتُهَا، وَكُلٌّ مُيَسَّرٌ لِمَا خُلِقَ لَهُ أَمَّا أَهْلُ السَّعَادَةِ فَيُيَسَّرُونَ لِعَمَلِ أَهْلِ السَّعَادَةِ، وَأَمَّا أَهْلُ الشَّقَاوَةِ فَيُيَسَّرُونَ لِعَمَلِ أَهْلِ الشَّقَاوَةِ، وَهَذَا يُوجِبُ لِلْعَبْدِ الْقِيَامَ بِتَوْحِيدِ اللَّهِ، وَالِاعْتِمَادَ عَلَى رَبِّهِ فِي حُصُولِ مَا يُحِبُّ، وَيَجْتَهِدُ فِي فِعْلِ الْأَسْبَابِ النَّافِعَةِ فَإِنَّهَا مَحَلُّ حِكْمَةِ اللَّهِ".
summary.en:
He (may Allah have mercy on him) said: "Al-Qabid (the Withholder), Al-Basit (the Extender); Al-Khafid (the Abaser), Ar-Rafi' (the Exalter); Al-Mu'izz (the Giver of honour), Al-Mudhill (the Giver of humiliation); Al-Mani' (the Preventer), Al-Mu'ti (the Giver); Ad-Darr (the Bringer of harm), An-Nafi' (the Bringer of benefit)".
"These noble names are among the names that are paired opposites, by which Allah should not be praised except each one together with the other, because absolute perfection comes from the combination of the two descriptions. So He is the One who withholds provisions, spirits and souls, and the One who extends provisions, mercy and hearts. He is the One who raises the peoples who uphold knowledge and faith, and who lowers His enemies. He is the One who gives honour to the people who obey Him, and this is true honour, for the one who obeys Allah is honoured even if he is poor and has no helpers; and who humiliates the people who disobey Him and His enemies, with humiliation in this world and the Hereafter. So the disobedient one, even if he appears with the outward signs of honour, his heart is filled with humiliation, even if he does not feel it because of his immersion in desires. For honour, all honour, is in obeying Allah, and humiliation is in disobeying Him. ﴾And he whom Allah humiliates - for him there is no bestower of honour﴿ ﴾Whoever desires honour - then to Allah belongs all honour﴿ ﴾And to Allah belongs [all] honour, and to His Messenger, and to the believers﴿. And He, the Exalted, is the Preventer, the Giver: there is no giver of what He withholds, and no preventer of what He gives. And He, the Exalted, is the One who benefits whomever He wills of His servants with religious and worldly benefits, and who harms whoever does the things that bring that about.
All of these matters follow from His justice, His wisdom and His praiseworthiness. For He has wisdom in lowering whomever He lowers, humiliating him and depriving him, and no one has any argument against Allah; just as He has hidden grace towards the one whom He raises and gives, and for whom He extends good things.
So the servant must acknowledge the wisdom of Allah, just as he must acknowledge His grace and thank Him with his tongue, his heart and his limbs.
And just as He alone does all of these things, which run under His decrees, Allah has made causes for His raising, His giving and His honouring, and causes for the opposite of that; whoever carries them out, their effects follow for him. And everyone is facilitated for what he was created for: as for the people of happiness, they are facilitated to do the deeds of the people of happiness, and as for the people of misery, they are facilitated to do the deeds of the people of misery. This requires the servant to uphold the oneness of Allah, to rely upon his Lord for attaining what he loves, and to strive hard in doing the beneficial causes, for they are the place of Allah's wisdom".

lesson.ar: أَنْ يَحْذَرَ الْعَبْدُ الْمَعَاصِيَ فَإِنَّهَا سَبَبُ الذُّلِّ، وَيَطْلُبَ الْعِزَّ بِطَاعَةِ اللَّهِ، مُعْتَرِفًا بِحِكْمَةِ رَبِّهِ فِيمَا يَقْضِيهِ.
lesson.en: Beware of sins, for they are the cause of humiliation; seek honour through obeying Allah, and acknowledge your Lord's wisdom in all that He decrees.

note.ar: سبق الكلام عن هذين الاسمين مع اسمه تعالى "الباسط".
note.en: These two names have already been discussed together with His name "Al-Basit" (the Extender).

summary.ar: قَالَ رَحِمَهُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى: "الْخَالِقُ، الْبَارِئُ، الْمُصَوِّرُ، الَّذِي خَلَقَ جَمِيعَ الْمَوْجُودَاتِ وَبَرَأَهَا، وَسَوَّاهَا بِحِكْمَتِهِ، وَصَوَّرَهَا بِحَمْدِهِ وَحِكْمَتِهِ، وَهُوَ لَمْ يَزَلْ وَلَا يَزَالُ عَلَى هَذَا الْوَصْفِ الْعَظِيمِ".
summary.en: He (may Allah have mercy on him) said: "Al-Khaliq (the Creator), Al-Bari' (the Originator), Al-Musawwir (the Fashioner): the One who created all existing things and originated them, proportioned them by His wisdom, and gave them form by His praise and His wisdom; and He has always been, and will always be, described with this great description".

lesson.ar: أَنْ يَتَفَكَّرَ الْعَبْدُ فِي حِكْمَةِ اللَّهِ فِي تَصْوِيرِ الْمَخْلُوقَاتِ فَيَحْمَدَهُ عَلَيْهَا، وَيَعْلَمَ أَنَّهُ لَا خَالِقَ وَلَا مُصَوِّرَ سِوَاهُ فَيُفْرِدَهُ بِالْعِبَادَةِ.
lesson.en: Reflect on Allah's wisdom in how He has shaped His creation and praise Him for it, knowing there is no creator or fashioner besides Him, so worship Him alone.

note.ar: سبق الكلام عن هذا الاسم مع اسمه تعالى "الباري".
note.en: This name has already been discussed together with His name "Al-Bari'" (the Originator).

summary.ar:
قَالَ رَحِمَهُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى: " الْقَابِضُ الْبَاسِطُ، الْخَافِضُ الرَّافِعُ، الْمُعِزُّ الْمُذِلُّ، الْمَانِعُ الْمُعْطِي، الضَّارُّ النَّافِعُ".
"هَذِهِ الْأَسْمَاءُ الْكَرِيمَةُ مِنَ الْأَسْمَاءِ الْمُتَقَابِلَاتِ الَّتِي لَا يَنْبَغِي أَنْ يُثْنَى عَلَى اللَّهِ بِهَا إِلَّا كُلُّ وَاحِدٍ مَعَ الْآخَرِ لِأَنَّ الْكَمَالَ الْمُطْلَقَ مِنِ اجْتِمَاعِ الْوَصْفَيْنِ، فَهُوَ الْقَابِضُ لِلْأَرْزَاقِ وَالْأَرْوَاحِ وَالنُّفُوسِ، وَالْبَاسِطُ لِلْأَرْزَاقِ، وَالرَّحْمَةِ، وَالْقُلُوبِ، وَهُوَ الرَّافِعُ لِلْأَقْوَامِ الْقَائِمِينَ بِالْعِلْمِ وَالْإِيمَانِ الْخَافِضُ لِأَعْدَائِهِ، وَهُوَ الْمُعِزُّ لِأَهْلِ طَاعَتِهِ، وَهَذَا عِزٌّ حَقِيقِيٌّ، فَإِنَّ الْمُطِيعَ لِلَّهِ عَزِيزٌ وَإِنْ كَانَ فَقِيرًا لَيْسَ لَهُ أَعْوَانٌ، الْمُذِلُّ لِأَهْلِ مَعْصِيَتِهِ، وَأَعْدَائِهِ ذُلًّا فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ فَالْعَاصِي وَإِنْ ظَهَرَ بِمَظَاهِرِ الْعِزِّ فَقَلْبُهُ حَشْوُهُ الذُّلُّ وَإِنْ لَمْ يَشْعُرْ بِهِ لِانْغِمَاسِهِ فِي الشَّهَوَاتِ فَإِنَّ الْعِزَّ كُلَّ الْعِزِّ بِطَاعَةِ اللَّهِ، وَالذُّلَّ بِمَعْصِيَتِهِ ﴿وَمَنْ يُهِنِ اللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُ مِنْ مُكْرِمٍ﴾ ﴿مَنْ كَانَ يُرِيدُ الْعِزَّةَ فَلِلَّهِ الْعِزَّةُ جَمِيعاً﴾ ﴿وَلِلَّهِ الْعِزَّةُ وَلِرَسُولِهِ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ وَهُوَ تَعَالَى الْمَانِعُ الْمُعْطِي فَلَا مُعْطِيَ لِمَا مَنَعَ وَلَا مَانِعَ لِمَا أَعْطَى وَهُوَ تَعَالَى النَّافِعُ لِمَنْ شَاءَ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ بِالْمَنَافِعِ الدِّينِيَّةِ وَالدُّنْيَوِيَّةِ، الضَّارُّ لِمَنْ فَعَلَ الْأَسْبَابَ الَّتِي تُوجِبُ ذَلِكَ.
وَهَذِهِ الْأُمُورُ كُلُّهَا تَبَعٌ لِعَدْلِهِ، وَحِكْمَتِهِ، وَحَمْدِهِ، فَإِنَّ لَهُ الْحِكْمَةَ فِي خَفْضِ مَنْ يَخْفِضُهُ، وَيُذِلُّهُ، وَيَحْرِمُهُ، وَلَا حُجَّةَ لِأَحَدٍ عَلَى اللَّهِ، كَمَا لَهُ الْفَضْلُ الْخَفِيُّ عَلَى مَنْ رَفَعَهُ وَأَعْطَاهُ وَيَبْسُطُ لَهُ الْخَيْرَاتِ.
فَعَلَى الْعَبْدِ أَنْ يَعْتَرِفَ بِحِكْمَةِ اللَّهِ، كَمَا عَلَيْهِ أَنْ يَعْتَرِفَ بِفَضْلِهِ وَيَشْكُرَهُ بِلِسَانِهِ وَجَنَانِهِ وَأَرْكَانِهِ.
وَكَمَا أَنَّهُ هُوَ الْمُنْفَرِدُ بِهَذِهِ الْأُمُورِ كُلُّهَا جَارِيَةٌ تَحْتَ أَقْدَارِهِ، فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ جَعَلَ لِرَفْعِهِ وَعَطَائِهِ وَإِكْرَامِهِ أَسْبَابًا، وَلِضِدِّ ذَلِكَ أَسْبَابًا مَنْ قَامَ بِهَا تَرَتَّبَتْ عَلَيْهِ مُسَبَّبَاتُهَا، وَكُلٌّ مُيَسَّرٌ لِمَا خُلِقَ لَهُ أَمَّا أَهْلُ السَّعَادَةِ فَيُيَسَّرُونَ لِعَمَلِ أَهْلِ السَّعَادَةِ، وَأَمَّا أَهْلُ الشَّقَاوَةِ فَيُيَسَّرُونَ لِعَمَلِ أَهْلِ الشَّقَاوَةِ، وَهَذَا يُوجِبُ لِلْعَبْدِ الْقِيَامَ بِتَوْحِيدِ اللَّهِ، وَالِاعْتِمَادَ عَلَى رَبِّهِ فِي حُصُولِ مَا يُحِبُّ، وَيَجْتَهِدُ فِي فِعْلِ الْأَسْبَابِ النَّافِعَةِ فَإِنَّهَا مَحَلُّ حِكْمَةِ اللَّهِ".
summary.en:
He (may Allah have mercy on him) said: "Al-Qabid (the Withholder), Al-Basit (the Extender); Al-Khafid (the Abaser), Ar-Rafi' (the Exalter); Al-Mu'izz (the Giver of honour), Al-Mudhill (the Giver of humiliation); Al-Mani' (the Preventer), Al-Mu'ti (the Giver); Ad-Darr (the Bringer of harm), An-Nafi' (the Bringer of benefit)".
"These noble names are among the names that are paired opposites, by which Allah should not be praised except each one together with the other, because absolute perfection comes from the combination of the two descriptions. So He is the One who withholds provisions, spirits and souls, and the One who extends provisions, mercy and hearts. He is the One who raises the peoples who uphold knowledge and faith, and who lowers His enemies. He is the One who gives honour to the people who obey Him, and this is true honour, for the one who obeys Allah is honoured even if he is poor and has no helpers; and who humiliates the people who disobey Him and His enemies, with humiliation in this world and the Hereafter. So the disobedient one, even if he appears with the outward signs of honour, his heart is filled with humiliation, even if he does not feel it because of his immersion in desires. For honour, all honour, is in obeying Allah, and humiliation is in disobeying Him. ﴾And he whom Allah humiliates - for him there is no bestower of honour﴿ ﴾Whoever desires honour - then to Allah belongs all honour﴿ ﴾And to Allah belongs [all] honour, and to His Messenger, and to the believers﴿. And He, the Exalted, is the Preventer, the Giver: there is no giver of what He withholds, and no preventer of what He gives. And He, the Exalted, is the One who benefits whomever He wills of His servants with religious and worldly benefits, and who harms whoever does the things that bring that about.
All of these matters follow from His justice, His wisdom and His praiseworthiness. For He has wisdom in lowering whomever He lowers, humiliating him and depriving him, and no one has any argument against Allah; just as He has hidden grace towards the one whom He raises and gives, and for whom He extends good things.
So the servant must acknowledge the wisdom of Allah, just as he must acknowledge His grace and thank Him with his tongue, his heart and his limbs.
And just as He alone does all of these things, which run under His decrees, Allah has made causes for His raising, His giving and His honouring, and causes for the opposite of that; whoever carries them out, their effects follow for him. And everyone is facilitated for what he was created for: as for the people of happiness, they are facilitated to do the deeds of the people of happiness, and as for the people of misery, they are facilitated to do the deeds of the people of misery. This requires the servant to uphold the oneness of Allah, to rely upon his Lord for attaining what he loves, and to strive hard in doing the beneficial causes, for they are the place of Allah's wisdom".

lesson.ar: أَنْ يَطْلُبَ الْعَبْدُ الْعِزَّةَ مِنَ اللَّهِ وَحْدَهُ بِطَاعَتِهِ، فَلَا يَلْتَمِسُهَا بِمَعْصِيَتِهِ، وَيَشْكُرَهُ عَلَى مَا أَعْطَاهُ.
lesson.en: Seek honour from Allah alone by obeying Him, never by disobeying Him, and thank Him for what He has given you.

note.ar: سبق الكلام عن هذبن الاسمين مع اسمه تعالى "الباسط".
note.en: These two names have already been discussed together with His name "Al-Basit" (the Extender).

summary.ar:
قَالَ رَحِمَهُ اللَّهُ: "الْمُعْطِي الْمَانِعُ هَٰذِهِ مِنَ الْأَسْمَاءِ الْمُتَقَابِلَةِ الَّتِي لَا يَنْبَغِي أَنْ يُثْنَي عَلَى اللَّهِ بِهَا إِلَّا كُلُّ وَاحِدٍ مِنْهَا مَعَ الْآخَرِ لِأَنَّ الْكَمَالَ الْمُطْلَقَ مِنِ اجْتِمَاعِ الْوَصْفَيْنِ.
فَهُوَ الْمُعْطِي الْمَانِعُ: لَا مَانِعَ لِمَا أَعْطَى، وَلَا مُعْطِيَ لِمَا مَنَعَ، فَجَمِيعُ الْمَصَالِحِ وَالْمَنَافِعِ مِنْهُ تُطْلَبُ، وَإِلَيْهِ يُرْغَبُ فِيهَا، وَهُوَ الَّذِي يُعْطِيهَا لِمَنْ شَاءَ وَيَمْنَعُهَا مَنْ يَشَاءُ بِحِكْمَتِهِ وَرَحْمَتِهِ".
summary.en:
He (may Allah have mercy on him) said: "Al-Mu'ti (the Giver), Al-Mani' (the Withholder): these are among the corresponding names with which Allah should not be praised except each one of them together with the other, because absolute perfection lies in the combination of the two descriptions.
So He is Al-Mu'ti, Al-Mani': there is none to withhold what He gives, and none to give what He withholds. All benefits and good things are sought from Him, and it is to Him that one turns in desire for them. He is the One who gives them to whom He wills and withholds them from whom He wills, by His wisdom and His mercy".

lesson.ar: أَنْ يَطْلُبَ الْعَبْدُ جَمِيعَ الْمَصَالِحِ وَالْمَنَافِعِ مِنْ رَبِّهِ وَحْدَهُ وَيَرْغَبَ إِلَيْهِ فِيهَا، وَيَرْضَى بِمَا أَعْطَى وَمَا مَنَعَ لِعِلْمِهِ أَنَّهُ عَنْ حِكْمَةٍ وَرَحْمَةٍ.
lesson.en: Seek every good and benefit from your Lord alone and turn to Him in hope, and be content with what He gives and what He withholds, knowing it comes from wisdom and mercy.

note.ar: سبق الكلام عن هذا الاسم مع اسمه تعالى "المانع".
note.en: This name has already been discussed together with His name "Al-Mani'" (the Withholder).

summary.ar: قَالَ رَحِمَهُ اللَّهُ: "الْمُبْدِئُ الْمُعِيدُ قَالَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى: ﴿وَهُوَ الَّذِي يَبْدأُ الْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُ﴾ ابْتَدَأَ خَلْقَهُمْ لِيَبْلُوَهُمْ أَيُّهُمْ أَحْسَنُ عَمَلاً ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُمْ لِيَجْزِيَ الَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوا بِالْحُسْنَى وَيَجْزِئَ الْمُسِيئِينَ بِإِسَأَتِهِمْ. وَكَذَٰلِكَ هُوَ الَّذِي يَبْدَأُ إِيجَادَ الْمَخْلُوقَاتِ شَيْئاً فَشَيْئاً ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهَا كُلَّ وَقْتٍ".
summary.en: He (may Allah have mercy on him) said: "Al-Mubdi' (the Originator), Al-Mu'id (the Restorer): Allah the Exalted said: ﴾And it is He who begins creation; then He repeats it﴿. He began their creation in order to test them as to which of them is best in deed, then He brings them back in order to reward those who did good with the best [reward] and to recompense the evildoers for their evil. Likewise, He is the One who begins bringing created things into existence, one thing after another, then He repeats them at every time".

lesson.ar: أَنْ يُوقِنَ الْعَبْدُ بِأَنَّ اللَّهَ يُعِيدُهُ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهِ لِيَجْزِيَهُ، فَيُحْسِنَ الْعَمَلَ فِي دَارِ الِابْتِلَاءِ اسْتِعْدَادًا لِذَلِكَ الْيَوْمِ.
lesson.en: Be certain that Allah will bring you back after death to reward you for your deeds, so make your deeds good in this world of testing, preparing for that Day.

note.ar: سبق الكلام عن هذا الاسم مع اسمه تعالى المبدئ.
note.en: This name has already been discussed together with His name Al-Mubdi' (the Originator).

summary.ar:
قَالَ رَحِمَهُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى: قَالَ تَعَالَى ﴿يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ أَنْتُمُ الْفُقَرَاءُ إِلَى اللَّهِ وَاللَّهُ هُوَ الْغَنِيُّ الْحَمِيد﴾.
فَهُوَ الْغَنِيُّ بِذَاتِهِ، الَّذِي لَهُ الْغِنَى التَّامُّ الْمُطْلَقُ، مِنْ جَمِيعِ الْوُجُوهِ، وَالِاعْتِبَارَاتِ لِكَمَالِهِ، وَكَمَالِ صِفَاتِهِ.
فَلَا يَتَطَرَّقُ إِلَيْهَا نَقْصٌ بِوَجْهٍ مِنَ الْوُجُوهِ، وَلَا يُمْكِنُ أَنْ يَكُونَ إِلَّا غَنِيّاً، لِأَنَّ غِنَاهُ مِنْ لَوَازِمِ ذَاتِهِ، كَمَا لَا يَكُونُ إِلَّا خَالِقاً قَادِراً رَازِقاً مُحْسِناً فَلَا يَحْتَاجُ إِلَى أَحَدٍ بِوَجْهٍ مِنَ الْوُجُوهِ.
فَهُوَ الْغَنِيُّ الَّذِي بِيَدِهِ خَزَائِنُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ، وَخَزَائِنُ الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ الْمُغْنِي جَمِيعَ خَلْقِهِ غِنًي عَامّاً، وَالْمُغْنِي لِخَوَاصِّ خَلْقِهِ مِمَّا أَفَاضَ عَلَى قُلُوبِهِمْ مِنَ الْمَعَارِفِ الرَّبَّانِيَّةِ وَالْحَقَائِقِ الْإِيمَانِيَّةِ.
وَمِنْ كَمَالِ غِنَاهُ وَكَرَمِهِ أَنَّهُ يَأْمُرُ عِبَادَهُ بِدُعَائِهِ، وَيَعِدُهُمْ بِإِجَابَةِ دَعَوَاتِهِمْ، وَإِسْعَافِهِمْ بِجَمِيعِ مُرَادَاتِهِمْ، وَيُؤْتِيهِمْ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ مَا سَأَلُوهُ، وَمَا لَمْ يَسْأَلُوهُ، وَمِنْ كَمَالِ غِنَاهُ أَنَّهُ لَوِ اجْتَمَعَ أَوَّلُ الْخَلْقِ وَآخِرُهُمْ فِي صَعِيدٍ وَاحِدٍ فَسَأَلُوهُ، فَأَعْطَى كُلًّا مِنْهُمْ مَا سَأَلَهُ وَمَا بَلَغَتْ أَمَانِيُّهُ مَا نَقَصَ مِنْ مُلْكِهِ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ، وَمِنْ كَمَالِ غِنَاهُ، وَسَعَةِ عَطَايَاهُ مَا يَبْسُطُهُ عَلَى أَهْلِ دَارِ كَرَامَتِهِ مِنَ النَّعِيمِ، وَاللَّذَّاتِ الْمُتَتَابِعَاتِ، وَالْخَيْرَاتِ الْمُتَوَاصِلَاتِ، مِمَّا لَا عَيْنٌ رَأَتْ وَلَا أُذُنٌ سَمِعَتْ وَلَا خَطَرَ عَلَى قَلْبِ بَشَرٍ.
وَمِنْ كَمَالِ غِنَاهُ أَنَّهُ لَمْ يَتَّخِذْ صَاحِباً وَلَا وَلَداً وَلَا شَرِيكاً فِي الْمُلْكِ، وَلَا وَلِيّاً مِنَ الذُّلِّ، وَهُوَ الْغَنِيُّ الَّذِي كَمُلَ بِنُعُوتِهِ، وَأَوْصَافِهِ، الْمُغْنِي لِجَمِيعِ مَخْلُوقَاتِهِ.
summary.en:
He (may Allah have mercy on him) said: The Exalted said: ﴾O mankind, you are those in need of Allah, while Allah is the Free of need, the Praiseworthy﴿.
So He is Al-Ghani (the Free of Need) by His very Self, to whom belongs complete and absolute freedom from need in every respect and every consideration, because of His perfection and the perfection of His attributes.
No deficiency can touch them in any respect, and He cannot be other than free of need, because His freedom from need is inseparable from His Self — just as He cannot be other than Creator, Able, Provider, Beneficent. So He does not need anyone in any respect.
He is Al-Ghani in whose hand are the treasuries of the heavens and the earth, and the treasuries of this world and the Hereafter; Al-Mughni (the Enricher), who enriches all His creation with a general enrichment, and who enriches the elect of His creation with what He has poured into their hearts of divine knowledge and the realities of faith.
Part of the perfection of His freedom from need and His generosity is that He commands His servants to call upon Him, promises them to answer their supplications and to grant them all they desire, and gives them from His bounty what they asked and what they did not ask. Part of the perfection of His freedom from need is that if the first of the creation and the last of them gathered on a single plain and asked Him, and He gave each of them what he asked and what his hopes reached, that would not decrease His dominion by the weight of an atom. And part of the perfection of His freedom from need and the vastness of His gifts is what He spreads out for the people of the abode of His honour of bliss, successive delights and continuous good things — such as no eye has seen, no ear has heard, and has never occurred to the heart of a human being.
Part of the perfection of His freedom from need is that He has not taken a companion or a son, nor had a partner in dominion, nor any protector out of weakness. He is Al-Ghani, who is perfect in His qualities and His attributes, Al-Mughni to all His creatures.

lesson.ar: أَنْ يَطْلُبَ الْعَبْدُ الْغِنَى مِنْ رَبِّهِ وَحْدَهُ، وَيَسْأَلَهُ أَنْ يُغْنِيَ قَلْبَهُ بِالْمَعَارِفِ الرَّبَّانِيَّةِ وَالْحَقَائِقِ الْإِيمَانِيَّةِ.
lesson.en: Seek sufficiency from your Lord alone, and ask Him to enrich your heart with knowledge of Him and the realities of faith.

evidence.text: وَوَجَدَكَ عَائِلاً فَأَغْنَى

note.ar: سبق الكلام عن هذا الاسم مع اسمه تعالى "الغني".
note.en: This name has already been discussed together with His name "Al-Ghaniyy" (the Rich).

summary.ar: قَالَ رَحِمَهُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى: " وَمِنْ أَسْمَائِهِ الْمُغِيثُ وَهُوَ الْمُنْقِذُ مِنَ الشَّدَائِدِ الْفَادِحَةِ وَالْكُرُوبِ ﴿قُلْ مَنْ يُنَجِّيكُمْ مِنْ ظُلُمَاتِ الْبَرِّ وَالْبَحْرِ﴾ فَالْمُغِيثُ يَتَعَلَّقُ بِالشَّدَائِدِ وَالْمَشَقَّاتِ فَهُوَ الْمُغِيثُ لِجَمِيعِ الْمَخْلُوقَاتِ عِنْدَمَا تَتَعَسَّرُ أُمُورُهَا وَتَقَعُ فِي الشَّدَائِدِ وَالْكُرُبَاتِ: يُطْعِمُ جَائِعَهُمْ وَيَكْسُو عَارِيَهُمْ وَيُخَلِّصُ مَكْرُوبَهُمْ وَيُنَزِّلُ الْغَيْثَ عَلَيْهِمْ فِي وَقْتِ الضَّرُورَةِ وَالْحَاجَةِ، وَكَذَٰلِكَ يُجِيبُ إِغَاثَةَ اللَّهْفَانِ أَيْ دُعَاءَ مَنْ دَعَاهُ فِي حَالَةِ اللَّهَفِ وَالشِّدَّةِ وَالِاضْطِرَارِ، فَمَنِ اسْتَغَاثَهُ أَغَاثَهُ، وَفِي الْكِتَابِ وَالسُّنَّةِ مِنْ ذِكْرِ تَفْرِيجِهِ لِلْكُرُوبَاتِ وَإِزَالَتِهِ الشَّدَائِدَ وَتَيْسِيرِهِ لِلْعَسِيرِ شَيْءٌ كَثِيرٌ جِدّاً مَعْرُوفٌ".
summary.en: He (may Allah have mercy on him) said: " Among His names is Al-Mughith (the Rescuer), and He is the One who saves from grievous hardships and distresses. ﴾Say, 'Who rescues you from the darknesses of the land and sea?'﴿ So Al-Mughith relates to hardships and difficulties: He is the Rescuer of all created beings when their affairs become difficult and they fall into hardships and distresses. He feeds their hungry, clothes their naked, delivers their distressed, and sends down rain upon them at the time of necessity and need. Likewise, He answers the call for help of the anguished, that is, the supplication of whoever calls upon Him in a state of anguish, hardship and dire need; whoever seeks His rescue, He rescues him. In the Book and the Sunnah there is a very great deal, well known, of mention of His relieving distresses, removing hardships and making the difficult easy".

lesson.ar: أَنْ يَفْزَعَ الْعَبْدُ إِلَى رَبِّهِ وَحْدَهُ فِي الشَّدَائِدِ وَالْكُرُبَاتِ وَيَسْتَغِيثَ بِهِ، فَإِنَّ مَنِ اسْتَغَاثَهُ أَغَاثَهُ.
lesson.en: Flee to your Lord alone in hardship and distress and cry to Him for help, for whoever seeks His help, He helps.

note.ar: لم أقف على نص صحيح يدل على أنه اسم لله تعالى.
note.en: I have not found an authentic text showing that it is a name of Allah the Exalted.

summary.ar:
قَالَ الْمُؤَلِّفُ رَحِمَهُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى: " الْمُقَدِّمُ وَالْمُؤَخِّرُ مِنْ أَسْمَائِهِ الْحُسْنَى الْمُزْدَوِجَةِ الْمُتَقَابِلَةِ الَّتِي لَا يُطْلَقُ وَاحِدٌ بِمُفْرَدِهِ عَلَى اللَّهِ إِلَّا مَقْرُوناً بِالْآخَرِ فَإِنَّ الْكَمَالَ مِنِ اجْتِمَاعِهِمَا فَهُوَ تَعَالَى الْمُقَدِّمُ لِمَنْ شَاءَ وَالْمُؤَخِّرُ لِمَنْ شَاءَ بِحِكْمَتِهِ.
وَهَٰذَا التَّقْدِيمُ يَكُونُ كَوْنِيّاً كَتَقْدِيمِ بَعْضِ الْمَخْلُوقَاتِ عَلَى بَعْضٍ وَتَأْخِيرِ بَعْضِهَا عَلَى بَعْضٍ، وَكَتَقْدِيمِ الْأَسْبَابِ عَلَى مُسَبَّبَاتِهَا وَالشُّرُوطِ عَلَى مَشْرُوطَاتِهَا.
وَأَنْوَاعُ التَّقْدِيمِ وَالتَّأْخِيرِ فِي الْخَلْقِ، وَالتَّقْدِيرِ بَحْرٌ لَا سَاحِلَ لَهُ، وَيَكُونُ شَرْعِيّاً كَمَا فَضَّلَ الْأَنْبِيَاءَ عَلَى الْخَلْقِ، وَفَضَّلَ بَعْضَهُمْ عَلَى بَعْضٍ، وَفَضَّلَ بَعْضَ عِبَادِهِ عَلَى بَعْضٍ، وَقَدَّمَهُمْ فِي الْعِلْمِ، وَالْإِيمَانِ، وَالْعَمَلِ، وَالْأَخْلَاقِ، وَسَائِرِ الْأَوْصَافِ، وَأَخَّرَ مَنْ أَخَّرَ مِنْهُمْ بِشَيْءٍ مِنْ ذَٰلِكَ وَكُلُّ هَٰذَا تَبَعٌ لِحِكْمَتِهِ وَهَٰذَانِ الْوَصْفَانِ وَمَا أَشْبَهَهُمَا مِنَ الصِّفَاتِ الذَّاتِيَّةِ لِكَوْنِهِمَا قَائِمَيْنِ بِاللَّهِ وَاللَّهُ مُتَّصِفٌ بِهِمَا، وَمِنْ صِفَاتِ الْأَفْعَالِ لِأَنَّ التَّقْدِيمَ وَالتَّأْخِيرَ مُتَعَلِّقٌ بِالْمَخْلُوقَاتِ ذَوَاتِهَا، وَأَفْعَالِهَا، وَمَعَانِيهَا، وَأَوْصَافِهَا، وَهِيَ نَاشِئَةٌ عَنْ إِرَادَةِ اللَّهِ وَقُدْرَتِهِ، فَهَٰذَا هُوَ التَّقْسِيمُ الصَّحِيحُ لِصِفَاتِ الْبَارِئِ وَإِنَّ صِفَاتِ الذَّاتِ مُتَعَلِّقَةٌ بِالذَّاتِ، وَصِفَاتِ أَفْعَالِهِ مِنْ مُتَّصِفَهْ بِهَا الذَّاتُ وَمُتَعَلِّقَهْ بِمَا يَنْشَأُ عَنْهَا مِنَ الْأَقْوَالِ وَالْأَفْعَالِ".
summary.en:
The author (may Allah have mercy on him) said: " Al-Muqaddim (the One who brings forward) and Al-Mu'akhkhir (the One who puts back) are among His paired, corresponding Most Beautiful Names, neither of which is applied to Allah on its own except coupled with the other, for perfection lies in their combination. So He, the Exalted, brings forward whom He wills and puts back whom He wills, by His wisdom.
This bringing forward may be in the realm of creation, such as bringing some created things before others and putting some after others, and like placing causes before their effects and conditions before what depends on them.
The kinds of bringing forward and putting back in creation and decree are an ocean without a shore. And it may be in the realm of the religious law, as He favoured the prophets over the creation, favoured some of them over others, favoured some of His slaves over others, and brought them forward in knowledge, faith, deeds, character and all other qualities, and put back whom He put back among them in any of that. All of this follows His wisdom. These two descriptions, and those similar to them, are among the attributes of the Essence, since they subsist in Allah and Allah is described by them; and [they are] among the attributes of action, because bringing forward and putting back relate to created things: their essences, their actions, their meanings and their qualities, and these arise from the will of Allah and His power. This is the correct division of the attributes of Al-Bari' (the Maker): that the attributes of the Essence are connected to the Essence, and the attributes of His actions are ones with which the Essence is described and which are connected to the sayings and actions that arise from them".

lesson.ar: أَنْ يَرْضَى الْعَبْدُ بِتَقْدِيمِ اللَّهِ وَتَأْخِيرِهِ لِعِلْمِهِ أَنَّهُ تَبَعٌ لِحِكْمَتِهِ، وَيَسْأَلَهُ أَنْ يُقَدِّمَهُ فِي الْعِلْمِ وَالْإِيمَانِ وَالْعَمَلِ وَالْأَخْلَاقِ.
lesson.en: Accept what Allah brings forward and what He puts back, knowing it follows His wisdom, and ask Him to advance you in knowledge, faith, good deeds and character.

evidence.text: اللهم اغفر لي ماقدمت وما أخرت وما أسررت وما أعلنت وما أسرفت، وما أنت أعلم به مني أنت المقدم وأنت المؤخر لا إله إلا أنت

ref.ar: أخرجه مسلم (١/ ٥٣٥) كتاب صلاة المسافرين باب الدعاء في صلاة الليل وقيامه من حديث علي رضي الله عنه
ref.en: Recorded by Muslim (1/535), Book of the Prayer of Travellers, chapter on supplication in the night prayer, from the hadith of 'Ali (may Allah be pleased with him).

summary.ar: قَالَ رَحِمَهُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى: "الْمُقِيتُ الَّذِي أَوْصَلَ إِلَى كُلِّ مَوْجُودٍ مَابِهِ يَقْتَاتُ وَأَوْصَلَ إِلَيْهَا أَرْزَاقَهَا وَصَرَّفَهَا كَيْفَ يَشَاءُ بِحُكْمِهِ وَحَمْدِهِ".
summary.en: He (may Allah have mercy on him) said: "Al-Muqit (the Nourisher): the One who has delivered to every existing thing that by which it is nourished, delivered to them their provisions, and disposed of them as He wills, by His wisdom and His praiseworthiness".

lesson.ar: أَنْ يَعْلَمَ الْعَبْدُ أَنَّ قُوتَهُ وَرِزْقَهُ مِنَ اللَّهِ وَحْدَهُ، فَيَطْلُبَهُ مِنْهُ وَيَشْكُرَهُ عَلَيْهِ.
lesson.en: Know that your nourishment and provision come from Allah alone, so ask Him for it and thank Him for it.

evidence.text: وَكَانَ اللَّهُ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ مُقِيتاً

summary.ar:
قَالَ الْمُؤَلِّفُ رَحِمَهُ اللَّهُ: "الْمَلِكُ الْمَالِكُ: الَّذِي لَهُ الْمُلْكُ فَهُوَ الْمَوْصُوفُ بِصِفَةِ الْمُلْكِ وَهِيَ صِفَاتُ الْعَظَمَةِ وَالْكِبْرِيَاءِ، وَالْقَهْرِ، وَالتَّدْبِيرِ، الَّذِي لَهُ التَّصَرُّفُ الْمُطْلَقُ، فِي الْخَلْقِ وَالْأَمْرِ وَالْجَزَاءِ.
وَلَهُ جَمِيعُ الْعَالَمِ الْعُلْوِيِّ وَالسُّفْلِيِّ، كُلُّهُمْ عَبِيدٌ، وَمَمَالِيكُ، وَمُضْطَرُّونَ إِلَيْهِ وَهُوَ الْآمِرُ النَّاهِي الْمُعِزُّ الْمُذِلُّ الَّذِي يُصَرِّفُ أُمُورَ عِبَادِهِ كَمَا يُحِبُّ، وَيُقَلِّبُهُمْ كَمَا يَشَاءُ، وَلَهُ مِنْ مَعْنَى الْمُلْكِ مَا يَسْتَحِقُّهُ مِنَ الْأَسْمَاءِ الْحُسْنَى كَالْعَزِيزِ الْجَبَّارِ الْمُتَكَبِّرِ، الْحَكَمِ، الْعَدْلِ، الْخَافِضِ، الرَّافِعِ، الْمُعِزِّ، وَالْمُذِلِّ، الْعَظِيمِ، الْجَلِيلِ، الْكَبِيرِ، الْحَسِيبِ، الْمَجِيدِ، الْوَالِي، الْمُتَعَالِي، مَالِكِ الْمُلْكِ، الْمُتَسَلِّطِ، الْجَامِعِ، إِلَى غَيْرِ ذَٰلِكَ مِنَ الْأَسْمَاءِ الْعَائِدَةِ إِلَى الْمُلْكِ.
summary.en:
The author (may Allah have mercy on him) said: "Al-Malik (the King), Al-Maalik (the Owner): the One to whom the dominion belongs. He is the One described with the attribute of kingship, which are the attributes of greatness, grandeur, subjugation and disposal of affairs; the One who has absolute control over the creation, the command and the recompense.
To Him belongs the entire upper and lower world; all of them are slaves, owned by Him, and in dire need of Him. He is the One who commands and forbids, who honours and humiliates, who directs the affairs of His slaves as He loves and turns them about as He wills. And of the meaning of kingship, He has what He is worthy of among the Most Beautiful Names, such as Al-Aziz (the Almighty), Al-Jabbar (the Compeller), Al-Mutakabbir (the Supreme in Greatness), Al-Hakam (the Judge), Al-Adl (the Just), Al-Khafid (the Abaser), Ar-Rafi' (the Exalter), Al-Mu'izz (the Giver of Honour), Al-Mudhill (the Humiliator), Al-Azim (the Magnificent), Al-Jalil (the Majestic), Al-Kabir (the Great), Al-Hasib (the Reckoner), Al-Majid (the Glorious), Al-Wali (the Governor), Al-Muta'ali (the Most Exalted), Malik al-Mulk (the Owner of Dominion), Al-Mutasallit (the Dominant), Al-Jami' (the Gatherer), and other names that go back to kingship.

lesson.ar: أَنْ يَخْضَعَ الْعَبْدُ لِأَمْرِ مَلِكِهِ وَنَهْيِهِ، وَيَعْلَمَ أَنَّهُ عَبْدٌ مَمْلُوكٌ مُضْطَرٌّ إِلَيْهِ، فَلَا يَلْجَأُ إِلَّا إِلَيْهِ.
lesson.en: Submit to the commands and prohibitions of your King, knowing that you are His owned slave, in need of Him, so turn to no one but Him.

evidence.text: فَتَعَالَى اللَّهُ الْمَلِكُ الْحَقُّ لا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْكَرِيمِ

note.ar: سبق الكلام عن هذا الاسم مع اسمه تعالى "المالك".
note.en: This name has already been discussed together with His name "Al-Maalik" (the Owner).

summary.ar: قَالَ رَحِمَهُ اللَّهُ: "الْمُهَيْمِنُ: الْمُطَّلِعُ عَلَى خَفَايَا الْأُمُورِ، وَخَبَايَا الصُّدُورِ الَّذِي أَحَاطَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عِلْمًا".
summary.en: He (may Allah have mercy on him) said: "Al-Muhaymin (the Overseer): the One who is aware of hidden matters and of what is concealed in the breasts, who encompasses all things in knowledge".

lesson.ar: أَنْ يُرَاقِبَ الْعَبْدُ رَبَّهُ الْمُطَّلِعَ عَلَى خَبَايَا صَدْرِهِ، فَيُصْلِحَ سَرِيرَتَهُ كَمَا يُصْلِحُ عَلَانِيَتَهُ.
lesson.en: Be mindful of your Lord, who sees what is hidden in your heart, and set right your inner self just as you set right what others see.

evidence.text: الْمُهَيْمِنُ الْعَزِيزُ الْجَبَّارُ

summary.ar:
قَالَ الْمُؤَلِّفُ رَحِمَهُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى: " الْمُقَدِّمُ وَالْمُؤَخِّرُ مِنْ أَسْمَائِهِ الْحُسْنَى الْمُزْدَوِجَةِ الْمُتَقَابِلَةِ الَّتِي لَا يُطْلَقُ وَاحِدٌ بِمُفْرَدِهِ عَلَى اللَّهِ إِلَّا مَقْرُوناً بِالْآخَرِ فَإِنَّ الْكَمَالَ مِنِ اجْتِمَاعِهِمَا فَهُوَ تَعَالَى الْمُقَدِّمُ لِمَنْ شَاءَ وَالْمُؤَخِّرُ لِمَنْ شَاءَ بِحِكْمَتِهِ.
وَهَٰذَا التَّقْدِيمُ يَكُونُ كَوْنِيّاً كَتَقْدِيمِ بَعْضِ الْمَخْلُوقَاتِ عَلَى بَعْضٍ وَتَأْخِيرِ بَعْضِهَا عَلَى بَعْضٍ، وَكَتَقْدِيمِ الْأَسْبَابِ عَلَى مُسَبَّبَاتِهَا وَالشُّرُوطِ عَلَى مَشْرُوطَاتِهَا.
وَأَنْوَاعُ التَّقْدِيمِ وَالتَّأْخِيرِ فِي الْخَلْقِ، وَالتَّقْدِيرِ بَحْرٌ لَا سَاحِلَ لَهُ، وَيَكُونُ شَرْعِيّاً كَمَا فَضَّلَ الْأَنْبِيَاءَ عَلَى الْخَلْقِ، وَفَضَّلَ بَعْضَهُمْ عَلَى بَعْضٍ، وَفَضَّلَ بَعْضَ عِبَادِهِ عَلَى بَعْضٍ، وَقَدَّمَهُمْ فِي الْعِلْمِ، وَالْإِيمَانِ، وَالْعَمَلِ، وَالْأَخْلَاقِ، وَسَائِرِ الْأَوْصَافِ، وَأَخَّرَ مَنْ أَخَّرَ مِنْهُمْ بِشَيْءٍ مِنْ ذَٰلِكَ وَكُلُّ هَٰذَا تَبَعٌ لِحِكْمَتِهِ وَهَٰذَانِ الْوَصْفَانِ وَمَا أَشْبَهَهُمَا مِنَ الصِّفَاتِ الذَّاتِيَّةِ لِكَوْنِهِمَا قَائِمَيْنِ بِاللَّهِ وَاللَّهُ مُتَّصِفٌ بِهِمَا، وَمِنْ صِفَاتِ الْأَفْعَالِ لِأَنَّ التَّقْدِيمَ وَالتَّأْخِيرَ مُتَعَلِّقٌ بِالْمَخْلُوقَاتِ ذَوَاتِهَا، وَأَفْعَالِهَا، وَمَعَانِيهَا، وَأَوْصَافِهَا، وَهِيَ نَاشِئَةٌ عَنْ إِرَادَةِ اللَّهِ وَقُدْرَتِهِ، فَهَٰذَا هُوَ التَّقْسِيمُ الصَّحِيحُ لِصِفَاتِ الْبَارِئِ وَإِنَّ صِفَاتِ الذَّاتِ مُتَعَلِّقَةٌ بِالذَّاتِ، وَصِفَاتِ أَفْعَالِهِ مِنْ مُتَّصِفَهْ بِهَا الذَّاتُ وَمُتَعَلِّقَهْ بِمَا يَنْشَأُ عَنْهَا مِنَ الْأَقْوَالِ وَالْأَفْعَالِ".
summary.en:
The author (may Allah have mercy on him) said: " Al-Muqaddim (the One who brings forward) and Al-Mu'akhkhir (the One who puts back) are among His paired, corresponding Most Beautiful Names, neither of which is applied to Allah on its own except coupled with the other, for perfection lies in their combination. So He, the Exalted, brings forward whom He wills and puts back whom He wills, by His wisdom.
This bringing forward may be in the realm of creation, such as bringing some created things before others and putting some after others, and like placing causes before their effects and conditions before what depends on them.
The kinds of bringing forward and putting back in creation and decree are an ocean without a shore. And it may be in the realm of the religious law, as He favoured the prophets over the creation, favoured some of them over others, favoured some of His slaves over others, and brought them forward in knowledge, faith, deeds, character and all other qualities, and put back whom He put back among them in any of that. All of this follows His wisdom. These two descriptions, and those similar to them, are among the attributes of the Essence, since they subsist in Allah and Allah is described by them; and [they are] among the attributes of action, because bringing forward and putting back relate to created things: their essences, their actions, their meanings and their qualities, and these arise from the will of Allah and His power. This is the correct division of the attributes of Al-Bari' (the Maker): that the attributes of the Essence are connected to the Essence, and the attributes of His actions are ones with which the Essence is described and which are connected to the sayings and actions that arise from them".

lesson.ar: أَنْ يُسَلِّمَ الْعَبْدُ لِحِكْمَةِ اللَّهِ فِيمَا أَخَّرَهُ، وَيَسْأَلَهُ أَلَّا يُؤَخِّرَهُ عَنِ الْخَيْرِ فِي الْعِلْمِ وَالْإِيمَانِ وَالْعَمَلِ.
lesson.en: Submit to Allah's wisdom in whatever He puts back, and ask Him not to hold you back from good in knowledge, faith and deeds.

evidence.text: اللهم اغفر لي ماقدمت وما أخرت وما أسررت وما أعلنت وما أسرفت، وما أنت أعلم به مني أنت المقدم وأنت المؤخر لا إله إلا أنت

ref.ar: أخرجه مسلم (١/ ٥٣٥) كتاب صلاة المسافرين باب الدعاء في صلاة الليل وقيامه من حديث علي رضي الله عنه
ref.en: Recorded by Muslim (1/535), Book of the Prayer of Travellers, chapter on supplication in the night prayer, from the hadith of 'Ali (may Allah be pleased with him).

note.ar: سبق الكلام عن هذا الاسم مع اسمه تعالى "المقدم".
note.en: This name has already been discussed together with His name "Al-Muqaddim" (the One who brings forward).

name: الْمُؤْمِنُ
meaning: The One Who Confirms the Truth

summary.ar: قَالَ رَحِمَهُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى: "الْمُؤْمِنُ الَّذِي أَثْنَى عَلَى نَفْسِهِ بِصِفَاتِ الْكَمَالِ، وَبِكَمَالِ الْجَلَالِ وَالْجَمَالِ، الَّذِي أَرْسَلَ رُسُلَهُ وَأَنْزَلَ كُتُبَهُ بِالْآيَاتِ، وَالْبَرَاهِينِ وَصَدَّقَ رُسُلَهُ بِكُلِّ آيَةٍ وَبُرْهَانٍ، يَدُلُّ عَلَى صِدْقِهِمْ وَصِحَّةِ مَاجَاؤُا بِهِ".
summary.en: He (may Allah have mercy on him) said: "Al-Mu'min (the Affirmer of Truth, the Giver of Security): the One who has praised Himself with the attributes of perfection, and with perfect majesty and beauty; who sent His messengers and revealed His Books with signs and proofs, and confirmed the truthfulness of His messengers with every sign and proof that indicates their truthfulness and the soundness of what they brought".

lesson.ar: أَنْ يُصَدِّقَ الْعَبْدُ رُسُلَ اللَّهِ فِيمَا جَاؤُوا بِهِ، وَيُثْنِيَ عَلَى رَبِّهِ بِمَا أَثْنَى بِهِ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ مِنْ صِفَاتِ الْكَمَالِ.
lesson.en: Believe the messengers of Allah in what they brought, and praise your Lord with the attributes of perfection with which He has praised Himself.

evidence.text: هُوَ اللَّهُ الَّذِي لا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْمَلِكُ الْقُدُّوسُ السَّلامُ الْمُؤْمِنُ الْمُهَيْمِنُ الْعَزِيزُ الْجَبَّارُ الْمُتَكَبِّرُ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ

summary.ar:
قَالَ رَحِمَهُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى: " الْقَابِضُ الْبَاسِطُ، الْخَافِضُ الرَّافِعُ، الْمُعِزُّ الْمُذِلُّ، الْمَانِعُ الْمُعْطِي، الضَّارُّ النَّافِعُ".
"هَذِهِ الْأَسْمَاءُ الْكَرِيمَةُ مِنَ الْأَسْمَاءِ الْمُتَقَابِلَاتِ الَّتِي لَا يَنْبَغِي أَنْ يُثْنَى عَلَى اللَّهِ بِهَا إِلَّا كُلُّ وَاحِدٍ مَعَ الْآخَرِ لِأَنَّ الْكَمَالَ الْمُطْلَقَ مِنِ اجْتِمَاعِ الْوَصْفَيْنِ، فَهُوَ الْقَابِضُ لِلْأَرْزَاقِ وَالْأَرْوَاحِ وَالنُّفُوسِ، وَالْبَاسِطُ لِلْأَرْزَاقِ، وَالرَّحْمَةِ، وَالْقُلُوبِ، وَهُوَ الرَّافِعُ لِلْأَقْوَامِ الْقَائِمِينَ بِالْعِلْمِ وَالْإِيمَانِ الْخَافِضُ لِأَعْدَائِهِ، وَهُوَ الْمُعِزُّ لِأَهْلِ طَاعَتِهِ، وَهَذَا عِزٌّ حَقِيقِيٌّ، فَإِنَّ الْمُطِيعَ لِلَّهِ عَزِيزٌ وَإِنْ كَانَ فَقِيرًا لَيْسَ لَهُ أَعْوَانٌ، الْمُذِلُّ لِأَهْلِ مَعْصِيَتِهِ، وَأَعْدَائِهِ ذُلًّا فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ فَالْعَاصِي وَإِنْ ظَهَرَ بِمَظَاهِرِ الْعِزِّ فَقَلْبُهُ حَشْوُهُ الذُّلُّ وَإِنْ لَمْ يَشْعُرْ بِهِ لِانْغِمَاسِهِ فِي الشَّهَوَاتِ فَإِنَّ الْعِزَّ كُلَّ الْعِزِّ بِطَاعَةِ اللَّهِ، وَالذُّلَّ بِمَعْصِيَتِهِ ﴿وَمَنْ يُهِنِ اللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُ مِنْ مُكْرِمٍ﴾ ﴿مَنْ كَانَ يُرِيدُ الْعِزَّةَ فَلِلَّهِ الْعِزَّةُ جَمِيعاً﴾ ﴿وَلِلَّهِ الْعِزَّةُ وَلِرَسُولِهِ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ وَهُوَ تَعَالَى الْمَانِعُ الْمُعْطِي فَلَا مُعْطِيَ لِمَا مَنَعَ وَلَا مَانِعَ لِمَا أَعْطَى وَهُوَ تَعَالَى النَّافِعُ لِمَنْ شَاءَ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ بِالْمَنَافِعِ الدِّينِيَّةِ وَالدُّنْيَوِيَّةِ، الضَّارُّ لِمَنْ فَعَلَ الْأَسْبَابَ الَّتِي تُوجِبُ ذَلِكَ.
وَهَذِهِ الْأُمُورُ كُلُّهَا تَبَعٌ لِعَدْلِهِ، وَحِكْمَتِهِ، وَحَمْدِهِ، فَإِنَّ لَهُ الْحِكْمَةَ فِي خَفْضِ مَنْ يَخْفِضُهُ، وَيُذِلُّهُ، وَيَحْرِمُهُ، وَلَا حُجَّةَ لِأَحَدٍ عَلَى اللَّهِ، كَمَا لَهُ الْفَضْلُ الْخَفِيُّ عَلَى مَنْ رَفَعَهُ وَأَعْطَاهُ وَيَبْسُطُ لَهُ الْخَيْرَاتِ.
فَعَلَى الْعَبْدِ أَنْ يَعْتَرِفَ بِحِكْمَةِ اللَّهِ، كَمَا عَلَيْهِ أَنْ يَعْتَرِفَ بِفَضْلِهِ وَيَشْكُرَهُ بِلِسَانِهِ وَجَنَانِهِ وَأَرْكَانِهِ.
وَكَمَا أَنَّهُ هُوَ الْمُنْفَرِدُ بِهَذِهِ الْأُمُورِ كُلُّهَا جَارِيَةٌ تَحْتَ أَقْدَارِهِ، فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ جَعَلَ لِرَفْعِهِ وَعَطَائِهِ وَإِكْرَامِهِ أَسْبَابًا، وَلِضِدِّ ذَلِكَ أَسْبَابًا مَنْ قَامَ بِهَا تَرَتَّبَتْ عَلَيْهِ مُسَبَّبَاتُهَا، وَكُلٌّ مُيَسَّرٌ لِمَا خُلِقَ لَهُ أَمَّا أَهْلُ السَّعَادَةِ فَيُيَسَّرُونَ لِعَمَلِ أَهْلِ السَّعَادَةِ، وَأَمَّا أَهْلُ الشَّقَاوَةِ فَيُيَسَّرُونَ لِعَمَلِ أَهْلِ الشَّقَاوَةِ، وَهَذَا يُوجِبُ لِلْعَبْدِ الْقِيَامَ بِتَوْحِيدِ اللَّهِ، وَالِاعْتِمَادَ عَلَى رَبِّهِ فِي حُصُولِ مَا يُحِبُّ، وَيَجْتَهِدُ فِي فِعْلِ الْأَسْبَابِ النَّافِعَةِ فَإِنَّهَا مَحَلُّ حِكْمَةِ اللَّهِ".
summary.en:
He (may Allah have mercy on him) said: "Al-Qabid (the Withholder), Al-Basit (the Extender); Al-Khafid (the Abaser), Ar-Rafi' (the Exalter); Al-Mu'izz (the Giver of honour), Al-Mudhill (the Giver of humiliation); Al-Mani' (the Preventer), Al-Mu'ti (the Giver); Ad-Darr (the Bringer of harm), An-Nafi' (the Bringer of benefit)".
"These noble names are among the names that are paired opposites, by which Allah should not be praised except each one together with the other, because absolute perfection comes from the combination of the two descriptions. So He is the One who withholds provisions, spirits and souls, and the One who extends provisions, mercy and hearts. He is the One who raises the peoples who uphold knowledge and faith, and who lowers His enemies. He is the One who gives honour to the people who obey Him, and this is true honour, for the one who obeys Allah is honoured even if he is poor and has no helpers; and who humiliates the people who disobey Him and His enemies, with humiliation in this world and the Hereafter. So the disobedient one, even if he appears with the outward signs of honour, his heart is filled with humiliation, even if he does not feel it because of his immersion in desires. For honour, all honour, is in obeying Allah, and humiliation is in disobeying Him. ﴾And he whom Allah humiliates - for him there is no bestower of honour﴿ ﴾Whoever desires honour - then to Allah belongs all honour﴿ ﴾And to Allah belongs [all] honour, and to His Messenger, and to the believers﴿. And He, the Exalted, is the Preventer, the Giver: there is no giver of what He withholds, and no preventer of what He gives. And He, the Exalted, is the One who benefits whomever He wills of His servants with religious and worldly benefits, and who harms whoever does the things that bring that about.
All of these matters follow from His justice, His wisdom and His praiseworthiness. For He has wisdom in lowering whomever He lowers, humiliating him and depriving him, and no one has any argument against Allah; just as He has hidden grace towards the one whom He raises and gives, and for whom He extends good things.
So the servant must acknowledge the wisdom of Allah, just as he must acknowledge His grace and thank Him with his tongue, his heart and his limbs.
And just as He alone does all of these things, which run under His decrees, Allah has made causes for His raising, His giving and His honouring, and causes for the opposite of that; whoever carries them out, their effects follow for him. And everyone is facilitated for what he was created for: as for the people of happiness, they are facilitated to do the deeds of the people of happiness, and as for the people of misery, they are facilitated to do the deeds of the people of misery. This requires the servant to uphold the oneness of Allah, to rely upon his Lord for attaining what he loves, and to strive hard in doing the beneficial causes, for they are the place of Allah's wisdom".

lesson.ar: أَنْ يَعْتَمِدَ الْعَبْدُ عَلَى رَبِّهِ وَحْدَهُ فِي حُصُولِ مَا يُحِبُّ، وَيَجْتَهِدَ فِي فِعْلِ الْأَسْبَابِ النَّافِعَةِ الَّتِي جَعَلَهَا اللَّهُ مُوصِلَةً إِلَى الْمَنَافِعِ.
lesson.en: Rely on your Lord alone to obtain what you love, and work hard at the beneficial means that Allah has made to lead to benefit.

note.ar: سبق الكلام عن هذا الاسم مع اسمه تعالى "الباسط".
note.en: This name has already been discussed together with His name "Al-Basit" (the Extender).

summary.ar:
قَالَ رَحِمَهُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى: "وَمِنْ أَسْمَائِهِ الْحُسْنَى النُّورُ فَالنُّورُ وَصْفُهُ الْعَظِيمُ، وَأَسْمَاؤُهُ حُسْنَى، وَصِفَاتُهُ أَكْمَلُ الصِّفَاتِ لَهُ تَعَالَى رَحْمَةٌ، وَحَمْدٌ، وَحِكْمَةٌ، وَهُوَ نُورُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ الَّذِي نَوَّرَ قُلُوبَ الْعَارِفِينَ بِمَعْرِفَتِهِ، وَالْإِيمَانِ بِهِ وَنَوَّرَ أَفْئِدَتَهُمْ بِهِدَايَتِهِ، وَهُوَ الَّذِي أَنَارَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ بِالْأَنْوَارِ الَّتِي وَضَعَهَا. وَحِجَابُهُ النُّورُ لَوْ كَشَفَهُ لَأَحْرَقَتْ سُبُحَاتُ وَجْهِهِ مَاانْتَهَى إِلَيْهِ بَصَرُهُ مِنْ خَلْقِهِ. وَبِنُورِهِ اسْتَنَارَتْ جَنَّاتُ النَّعِيمِ. وَالنُّورُ الَّذِي هُوَ وَصْفُهُ مِنْ جُمْلَةِ نُعُوتِهِ الْعَظِيمَةِ وَأَمَّا النُّورُ الْمَخْلُوقُ فَهُوَ نَوْعَانِ:
نُورٌ حِسِّيٌّ كَنُورِ الشَّمْسِ، وَالْقَمَرِ، وَالْكَوَاكِبِ، وَسَائِرِ الْمَخْلُوقَاتِ الْمُدْرَكِ نُورُهَا بِالْأَبْصَارِ.
وَالثَّانِي نُورٌ مَعْنَوِيٌّ، وَهُوَ نُورُ الْمَعْرِفَةِ، وَالْإِيمَانِ، وَالطَّاعَةِ فَإِنَّ لَهَا نُورًا فِي قُلُوبِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ بِحَسَبِ مَا قَامَ فِي قُلُوبِهِمْ مِنْ حَقَائِقِ الْمَعْرِفَةِ مَوَاجِيدِ الْإِيمَانِ، وَحَلَاوَةِ الطَّاعَةِ، وَسُرُورِ الْمَحَبَّةِ.
وَهَٰذَا النُّورُ هُوَ الَّذِي يَمْنَعُ صَاحِبَهُ مِنَ الْمَعَاصِي وَيَجْذِبُهُ إِلَى الْخَيْرِ وَيَدْعُوهُ إِلَى كَمَالِ الْإِخْلَاصِ لِلَّهِ، وَلِهَٰذَا كَانَ مِنْ دُعَاءِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: "اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ فِي قَلْبِي نُوراً وَفِي سَمْعِي نُوراً وَفِي بَصَرِي نُوراً وَمِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَيَّ نُوراً وَمِنْ خَلْفِي نُوراً وَفَوْقِي نُوراً وَتَحْتِي نُوراً اللَّهُمَّ اَعْطِنِي نُورًا وَزِدْنِي نُورًا".
وَهَٰذَا النُّورُ الَّذِي يُعْطِيهِ اللَّهُ عَبْدَهُ أَعْظَمُ مِنَّةٍ مِنْهَا عَلَيْهِ وَأَصْلُ الْخَيْرِ. وَهَٰذَا النُّورُ مَهْمَا قَوِيَ فَإِنَّهُ مَخْلُوقٌ، فَإِيَّاكَ أَنْ تَضْعُفَ بَصِيرَتُكَ وَيَقِلَّ تَمْيِيزُكَ وَعِلْمُكَ فَتَظُنَّ هَٰذَا النُّورَ نُورَ الْعِيَانِ وَمُشَاهَدَةَ الْقَلْبِ لِنُورِ الذَّاتِ الْمُقَدَّسَةِ، وَإِنَّمَا هُوَ نُورُ الْمَعْرِفَةِ- وَالْإِيمَانِ، وَيُبْتَلَى بِهَٰذَا بَعْضُ الصُّوفِيَّةِ الَّذِينَ تَرِدُ عَلَيْهِمُ الْوَارِدَةُ الْقَوِيَّةُ فَيَقَعُ مِنْهُمْ مِنَ الشَّطْحِ، وَالْخَطَلِ مَا يُنَافِي الْعِلْمَ، وَالْإِيمَانَ كَمَا أَنَّ كَثِيفَ الطَّبْعِ جَافِيَ الْقَلْبِ قَدْ تَرَاكَمَتْ عَلَيْهِ الظُّلُمَاتُ، وَتَوَالَتْ عَلَيْهِ الْغَفَلَاتُ فَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ مِنْ هَٰذَا النُّورِ حَظٌّ، وَلَا نَصِيبٌ بَلْ رُبَّمَا ازْدَرَى مِنْ سَفَاهَةِ عَقْلِهِ وَقِلَّةِ وَجْدِهِ هَٰذِهِ الْأَحْوَالَ وَزَهِدَ فِيهَا، فَمَتَى مَنَّ اللَّهُ عَلَى الْعَبْدِ بِمَعْرِفَةٍ صَحِيحَهْ مُتَلَقَّاةٍ مِنَ الْكِتَابِ، وَالسُّنَّةِ، وَتَفَقَّهَ فِي أَسْمَاءِ اللَّهِ، وَصِفَاتِهِ، وَتَعَبَّدَ لِلَّهِ بِهَا، وَاجْتَهَدَ أَنْ يُحَقِّقَ مَقَامَ الْإِحْسَانِ فَيَعْبُدَ اللَّهَ كَأَنَّهُ يَرَاهُ فَإِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ يَرَاهُ فَإِنَّهُ يَرَاهُ وَلَهِجَ بِذِكْرِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى اسْتَنَارَ قَلْبُهُ، وَحَصَلَ لَهُ مِنْ لَذَّةِ الْمَعْرِفَةِ، وَمَوَاجِيدِ الْإِيمَانِ أَعْظَمُ اللَّذَّاتِ، وَذَٰلِكَ فَضْلُ اللَّهِ يُؤْتِيهِ مَنْ يَشَاءُ وَاللَّهُ ذُو الْفَضْلِ الْعَظِيمِ.
وَالْمُؤْمِنُ إِذَا كَمُلَ إِيمَانُهُ أَنَارَ اللَّهُ قَلْبَهُ فَانْكَشَفَتْ لَهُ حَقَائِقُ الْأَشْيَاءِ، وَحَصَلَ لَهُ فُرْقَانٌ يُفَرِّقُ بِهِ بَيْنَ الْحَقِّ، وَالْبَاطِلِ، وَصَارَ هَٰذَا النُّورُ هُوَ مَادَّةَ حَيَاةِ الْعَبْدِ، وَقُوَّتَهُ عَلَى الْخَيْرِ عِلْماً، وَعَمَلاً، وَانْكَشَفَتْ عَنْهُ الشُّبُهَاتُ الْقَادِمَةُ فِي الْعِلْمِ وَالْيَقِينِ، وَالشَّهَوَاتُ النَّاشِئَةُ عَنِ الْغَفْلَةِ وَالظُّلْمَةِ وَكَانَ قَلْبُهُ نُورًا وَكَلَامُهُ نُورًا وَعَمَلُهُ نُورًا وَالنُّورُ مُحِيطٌ بِهِ مِنْ جِهَاتِهِ.
وَالْكَافِرُ أَوِ الْمُنَافِقُ أَوِ الْمُعَارِضُ أَوِ الْمُعْرِضُ الْغَافِلُ كُلُّ هَٰؤُلَاءِ يَتَخَبَّطُونَ فِي الظُّلُمَاتِ كُلٌّ لَهُ مِنَ الظُّلْمَةِ بِحَسَبِ مَا مَعَهُ مِنْ مَوَادِّهَا وَأَسْبَابِهَا وَاللَّهُ الْمُوَفِّقُ وَحْدَهُ.
summary.en:
He (may Allah have mercy on him) said: "And among His Most Beautiful Names is An-Nur (the Light). Light is His great attribute; His names are most beautiful, and His attributes are the most perfect of attributes. To Him, the Exalted, belong mercy, praise and wisdom. He is the Light of the heavens and the earth, who has illuminated the hearts of those who know Him with knowledge of Him and faith in Him, and illuminated their hearts with His guidance. He is the One who lit up the heavens and the earth with the lights that He placed [in them]. His veil is light; if He were to remove it, the splendour of His Face would burn whatever of His creation His sight reaches. By His light the Gardens of Bliss are illuminated. The light that is His attribute is among His great descriptions. As for created light, it is of two types:
Sensory light, such as the light of the sun, the moon, the stars and all other created things whose light is perceived by the eyes.
The second is inner light, which is the light of knowledge, faith and obedience; for these have a light in the hearts of the believers according to what has settled in their hearts of the realities of knowledge, the heartfelt experiences of faith, the sweetness of obedience and the joy of love.
This light is what prevents its possessor from sins, draws him to good, and calls him to perfect sincerity to Allah. For this reason, among the supplications of the Prophet ﷺ was: "O Allah, place light in my heart, light in my hearing, light in my sight, light in front of me, light behind me, light above me and light beneath me. O Allah, give me light and increase me in light."
This light which Allah gives His slave is the greatest favour upon him and the root of good. However strong this light becomes, it is created. So beware lest your insight weaken and your discernment and knowledge diminish, so that you think this light is the light of direct seeing and the heart's witnessing of the light of the Holy Essence; rather, it is only the light of knowledge and faith. Some of the Sufis are afflicted with this: strong spiritual experiences come upon them, and there occur from them ecstatic utterances and blunders that contradict knowledge and faith. Just as the one of coarse nature and hard heart, upon whom darknesses have piled up and heedlessness has followed upon heedlessness, has no share or portion of this light; rather, perhaps, out of the foolishness of his intellect and the scarcity of his feeling, he scorns these states and turns away from them. So whenever Allah favours the slave with sound knowledge received from the Book and the Sunnah, and he gains understanding of the names and attributes of Allah, worships Allah through them, strives to realise the station of excellence, so that he worships Allah as though he sees Him, and if he does not see Him, then He sees him, and his tongue is constantly occupied with the remembrance of Allah the Exalted, his heart becomes illuminated, and he attains, from the delight of knowledge and the heartfelt experiences of faith, the greatest of delights. That is the bounty of Allah, which He gives to whom He wills, and Allah is the possessor of great bounty.
When the believer's faith becomes complete, Allah illuminates his heart, so the realities of things become unveiled to him, and he attains a criterion by which he distinguishes between truth and falsehood. This light becomes the substance of the slave's life and his strength for good, in knowledge and in action. The doubts that impair knowledge and certainty are removed from him, as are the desires that arise from heedlessness and darkness. His heart becomes light, his speech light and his deeds light, and light surrounds him on all sides.
The disbeliever, or the hypocrite, or the opponent, or the heedless one who turns away: all of these stumble about in darknesses, each having of darkness in proportion to what he has of its materials and causes. And Allah alone grants success.

lesson.ar: أَنْ يَطْلُبَ الْعَبْدُ نُورَ قَلْبِهِ بِالْمَعْرِفَةِ الصَّحِيحَةِ الْمُتَلَقَّاةِ مِنَ الْكِتَابِ وَالسُّنَّةِ، وَالتَّفَقُّهِ فِي أَسْمَاءِ اللَّهِ وَصِفَاتِهِ وَالتَّعَبُّدِ لَهُ بِهَا، وَالْإِكْثَارِ مِنْ ذِكْرِهِ، وَيَدْعُوَ بِدُعَاءِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ: «اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ فِي قَلْبِي نُورًا».
lesson.en: Seek light for your heart through sound knowledge taken from the Quran and Sunnah, understanding Allah's names and attributes and worshipping Him by them, and remembering Him often; and pray as the Prophet ﷺ prayed: «O Allah, place light in my heart».

evidence.text: اللَّهُ نُورُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْض

summary.ar: قَالَ رَحِمَهُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى: "الْهَادِي أَيِ الَّذِي يَهْدِي وَيُرْشِدُ عِبَادَهُ إِلَى جَمِيعِ الْمَنَافِعِ وَإِلَى دَفْعِ الْمَضَارِّ، وَيُعَلِّمُهُمْ مَا لَا يَعْلَمُونَ وَيَهْدِيهِمْ بِهِدَايَةِ التَّوْفِيقِ وَالتَّسْدِيدِ وَيُلْهِمُهُمُ التَّقْوَى وَيَجْعَلُ قُلُوبَهُمْ مُنِيبَةً إِلَيْهِ مُنْقَادَةً لِأَمْرِهِ".
summary.en: He (may Allah have mercy on him) said: "Al-Hadi (the Guide), that is, the One who guides and directs His slaves to all that benefits them and to warding off what harms them, teaches them what they do not know, guides them with the guidance of enabling success and keeping on the right course, inspires them with piety, and makes their hearts turn to Him in repentance and submit to His command".

lesson.ar: أَنْ يَطْلُبَ الْعَبْدُ الْهِدَايَةَ مِنْ رَبِّهِ وَحْدَهُ فِي كُلِّ أُمُورِهِ، وَيَسْأَلَهُ التَّوْفِيقَ وَالتَّسْدِيدَ وَالتَّقْوَى وَإِنَابَةَ الْقَلْبِ إِلَيْهِ.
lesson.en: Seek guidance from your Lord alone in all your affairs, and ask Him for success, right direction, taqwa and a heart that turns to Him.

note.ar: لم أقف على دليل يدل على اسميته لله تعالى وإنما ورد بلفظ الصفة كما قال تعالى: ﴿وَكَفَى بِرَبِّكَ هَادِياً وَنَصِيراً﴾ (الفرقان: ٣١).
note.en: I have not found evidence that it is a name of Allah the Exalted; it has only come in the wording of a description, as He the Exalted said: ﴾But sufficient is your Lord as a guide and a helper﴿ (Al-Furqan: 31).

summary.ar:
قَالَ رَحِمَهُ اللَّهُ:
"الْوَاحِدُ الْأَحَدُ هُوَ الَّذِي تَوَحَّدَ بِجَمِيعِ الْكَمَالَاتِ، وَتَفَرَّدَ بِكُلِّ كَمَالٍ، وَمَجْدٍ وَجَلَالٍ، وَجَمَالٍ، وَحَمْدٍ، وَحِكْمَةٍ، وَرَحْمَةٍ، وَغَيْرِهَا مِنْ صِفَاتِ الْكَمَالِ فَلَيْسَ لَهُ فِيهَا مَثِيلٌ وَلَا نَظِيرٌ، وَلَا مُنَاسِبٌ بِوَجْهٍ مِنَ الْوُجُوهِ فَهُوَ الْأَحَدُ فِي حَيَاتِهِ، وَقَيُّومِيَّتِهِ، وَعِلْمِهِ، وَقُدْرَتِهِ، وَعَظَمَتِهِ، وَجَلَالِهِ، وَجَمَالِهِ، وَحَمْدِهِ، وَحِكْمَتِهِ، وَرَحْمَتِهِ، وَغَيْرِهَا مِنْ صِفَاتِهِ، مَوْصُوفٌ بِغَايَةِ الْكَمَالِ، وَنِهَايَتِهِ مِنْ كُلِّ صِفَةٍ مِنْ هَذِهِ الصِّفَاتِ فَيَجِبُ عَلَى الْعَبِيدِ تَوْحِيدُهُ، عَقْدًا، وَقَوْلًا، وَعَمَلًا، بِأَنْ يَعْتَرِفُوا بِكَمَالِهِ الْمُطْلَقِ، وَتَفَرُّدِهِ بِالْوَحْدَانِيَّةِ، وَيُفْرِدُوهُ بِأَنْوَاعِ الْعِبَادَةِ".
summary.en:
He (may Allah have mercy on him) said:
"Al-Wahid Al-Ahad (the One, the Unique) is the One who is alone in all perfections, and unique in every perfection, glory, majesty, beauty, praise, wisdom, mercy and the other attributes of perfection; so He has no like and no equal in them, and nothing comparable in any way at all. So He is the One (Al-Ahad) in His life, His self-subsistence, His knowledge, His power, His greatness, His majesty, His beauty, His praise, His wisdom, His mercy and His other attributes. He is described with the utmost perfection, and its furthest limit, in each one of these attributes. So it is obligatory upon the servants to affirm His oneness in belief, in word and in deed, by acknowledging His absolute perfection and His uniqueness in oneness, and by devoting all kinds of worship to Him alone".

lesson.ar: أَنْ يُوَحِّدَ الْعَبْدُ رَبَّهُ عَقْدًا وَقَوْلًا وَعَمَلًا، فَيَعْتَرِفَ بِكَمَالِهِ الْمُطْلَقِ وَتَفَرُّدِهِ بِالْوَحْدَانِيَّةِ، وَيُفْرِدَهُ بِأَنْوَاعِ الْعِبَادَةِ.
lesson.en: Affirm your Lord's Oneness in belief, word and deed: acknowledge His absolute perfection and uniqueness, and direct every kind of worship to Him alone.

evidence.text: قُلِ اللَّهُ خَالِقُ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَهُوَ الْوَاحِدُ الْقَهَّارُ

note.ar: سبق الكلام عن هذا الاسم مع اسمه تعالى الأحد.
note.en: This name has already been discussed together with His name Al-Ahad (the One).

summary.ar: قَالَ رَحِمَهُ اللَّهُ: "الْوَاسِعُ الصِّفَاتِ وَالنُّعُوتِ وَمُتَعَلَّقَاتِهَا بِحَيْثُ لَا يُحْصِى أَحَدٌ ثَنَاءً عَلَيْهِ، بَلْ هُوَ كَمَا اَثْنَى عَلَى نَفْسِهِ، وَاسِعُ الْعَظَمَةِ، وَالسُّلْطَانِ، وَالْمُلْكِ، وَاسِعُ الْفَضْلِ، وَالْإِحْسَانِ عَظِيمُ الْجُودِ وَالْكَرَمِ".
summary.en: He (may Allah have mercy on him) said: "Al-Wasi' (the All-Encompassing, the Vast): vast in attributes and descriptions and in what they relate to, such that no one can enumerate [all] praise of Him; rather, He is as He has praised Himself. Vast in greatness, authority and dominion; vast in bounty and kindness; immense in generosity and munificence".

lesson.ar: أَنْ يَرْجُوَ الْعَبْدُ فَضْلَ رَبِّهِ الْوَاسِعَ وَيَسْأَلَهُ مِنْ جُودِهِ وَكَرَمِهِ، وَيُثْنِيَ عَلَيْهِ بِمَا أَثْنَى بِهِ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ مُعْتَرِفًا بِعَجْزِهِ عَنْ إِحْصَاءِ الثَّنَاءِ عَلَيْهِ.
lesson.en: Hope for your Lord's vast bounty and ask from His generosity, and praise Him as He has praised Himself, admitting that you can never fully count His praise.

evidence.text: وَاللَّهُ يَعِدُكُمْ مَغْفِرَةً مِنْهُ وَفَضْلاً وَاللَّهُ وَاسِعٌ عَلِيمٌ

summary.ar:
قَالَ رَحِمَهُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى: "الْوَدُودُ هُوَ الْمُحِبُّ الْمَحْبُوبُ بِمَعْنَى وَادٍّ وَمَوْدُودٍ فَهُوَ الَّذِي يُحِبُّ أَنْبِيَاءَهُ وَرُسُلَهُ وَأَتْبَاعَهُمْ وَيُحِبُّونَهُ فَهُوَ أَحَبُّ إِلَيْهِمْ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِ امْتَلَئَتْ قُلُوبُهُمْ مِنْ مَحَبَّتِهِ، وَلَهِجَتْ أَلْسِنَتُهُمْ بِالثَّنَاءِ عَلَيْهِ، وَانْجَذَبَتْ أَفْئِدَتُهُمْ إِلَيْهِ وُدّاً وَاِخْلَاصاً وَإِنَابَةً مِنْ جَمِيعِ الْوُجُوهِ.
وَلَا تُعَادِلُ مَحَبَّةَ اللَّهِ مِنْ أَصْفِيَائِهِ مَحَبَّةٌ أُخْرَى، لَا فِي أَصْلِهَا وَلَا فِي كَيْفِيَّتِهَا وَلَا فِي مُتَعَلَّقَاتِهَا وَهَٰذَا هُوَ الْفَرْضُ وَالْوَاجِبُ أَنْ تَكُونَ مَحَبَّةُ اللَّهِ فِي قَلْبِ الْعَبْدِ سَابِقَةً لِكُلِّ مَحَبَّةٍ غَالِبَةً كُلَّ مَحَبَّةٍ وَيَتَعَيَّنُ أَنْ تَكُونَ بَقِيَّةُ الْمَحَابِّ تَبَعاً لَهَا.
وَمَحَبَّةُ اللَّهِ هِيَ رُوحُ الْأَعْمَالِ، وَجَمِيعُ الْعُبُودِيَّةِ الظَّاهِرَةِ، وَالْبَاطِنَةِ نَاشِئَةٌ عَنْ مَحَبَّةِ اللَّهِ، وَمَحَبَّةُ الْعَبْدِ لِرَبِّهِ فَضْلٌ مِنَ اللَّهِ وَإِحْسَانٌ، لَيْسَتْ بِحَوْلِ الْعَبْدِ، وَلَا قُوَّتِهِ فَهُوَ تَعَالَى الَّذِي أَحَبَّ عَبْدَهُ فَجَعَلَ الْمَحَبَّةَ فِي قَلْبِهِ ثُمَّ لَمَّا أَحَبَّهُ الْعَبْدُ بِتَوْفِيقِهِ جَازَاهُ اللَّهُ بِحُبٍّ آخَرَ، فَهَٰذَا هُوَ الْإِحْسَانُ الْمَحْضُ عَلَى الْحَقِيقَةِ، إِذْ مِنْهُ السَّبَبُ وَمِنْهُ الْمُسَبَّبُ لَيْسَ الْمَقْصُودُ مِنْهَا الْمُعَارَضَةَ وَإِنَّمَا ذَٰلِكَ مَحَبَّةٌ مِنْهُ تَعَالَى لِلشَّاكِرِينَ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ وَلِشُكْرِهِمْ، فَالْمَصْلَحَةُ كُلُّهَا عَائِدَةٌ إِلَى الْعَبْدِ، فَتَبَارَكَ الَّذِي جَعَلَ وَأَوْدَعَ الْمَحَبَّةَ فِي قُلُوبِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، ثُمَّ لَمْ يَزَلْ يُنَمِّيهَا وَيُقَوِّيهَا حَتَّى وَصَلَتْ فِي قُلُوبِ الْأَصْفِيَاءِ إِلَى حَالَةٍ تَتَضَاءَلُ عِنْدَهَا جَمِيعُ الْمَحَابِّ، وَتُسَلِّيهِمْ عَنِ الْأَحْبَابِ وَتُهَوِّنُ عَلَيْهِمُ الْمَصَائِبَ وَتُلَذِّذُ لَهُمْ مَشَقَّةَ الطَّاعَةِ، وَتُثْمِرُ لَهُمْ مَا يَشَاءُونَ مِنْ أَصْنَافِ الْكَرَامَاتِ الَّتِي أَعْلَاهَا مَحَبَّةُ اللَّهِ وَالْفَوْزُ بِرِضَاهُ وَالْأُنْسُ بِقُرْبِهِ، فَمَحَبَّةُ الْعَبْدِ لِرَبِّهِ مَحْفُوفَةٌ بِمَحَبَّتَيْنِ مِنْ رَبِّهِ: فَمَحَبَّةٌ قَبْلَهَا صَارَ بِهَا مُحِبًّ لِرَبِّهِ، وَمَحَبَّةٌ بَعْدَهَا شُكْراً مِنَ اللَّهِ عَلَى مَحَبَّةٍ صَارَ بِهَا مِنْ أَصْفِيَائِهِ الْمُخْلَصِينَ، وَأَعْظَمُ سَبَبٍ يَكْتَسِبُ بِهِ الْعَبْدُ مَحَبَّةَ رَبِّهِ الَّتِي هِيَ أَعْظَمُ الْمَطَالِبِ، الْإِكْثَارُ مِنْ ذِكْرِهِ وَالثَّنَاءِ عَلَيْهِ وَكَثْرَةُ الْأِنَابَةِ إِلَيْهِ، وَقُوَّةُ التَّوْكِيلِ عَلَيْهِ، وَالتَّقَرُّبُ إِلَيْهِ بِالْفَرَائِضِ وَالنَّوَافِلِ، وَتَحْقِيقُ الْإِخْلَاصِ لَهُ فِي الْأَقْوَالِ وَالْأَفْعَالِ، وَمُتَابَعَةُ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ ظَاهِراً وَبَاطِناً قَالَ تَعَالَى: ﴿قُلْ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ تُحِبُّونَ اللَّهَ فَاتَّبِعُونِي يُحْبِبْكُمُ اللَّهُ﴾".
summary.en:
He (may Allah have mercy on him) said: "Al-Wadud (the Most Loving) is the One who loves and is loved, in the sense of both the Loving and the Beloved. So He is the One who loves His prophets, His messengers and their followers, and they love Him; He is more beloved to them than everything. Their hearts are filled with love of Him, their tongues are constantly occupied with praising Him, and their hearts are drawn to Him in love, sincerity and turning [to Him] in every respect.
The love of Allah in [the hearts of] His chosen ones is not equalled by any other love: not in its origin, nor in its manner, nor in what it relates to. This is the obligation and duty: that the love of Allah in the slave's heart should precede every love and prevail over every love, and it is necessary that all other loves be subordinate to it.
The love of Allah is the soul of deeds, and all outward and inward servitude arises from the love of Allah. The slave's love for his Lord is a bounty and kindness from Allah, not by the slave's own might or power. It is He, the Exalted, who loved His slave and placed love in his heart; then, when the slave loved Him by His enabling, Allah rewarded him with another love. This is pure kindness in reality, since from Him comes the cause and from Him comes the effect. The aim of it is not compensation; rather, it is love from Him, the Exalted, for the grateful among His slaves and for their gratitude, so the entire benefit returns to the slave. So blessed is He who placed and deposited love in the hearts of the believers, then continued to make it grow and to strengthen it until, in the hearts of the chosen ones, it reached a state before which all other loves shrink, which consoles them for [the loss of] loved ones, makes calamities easy for them, makes the hardship of obedience delightful to them, and yields for them whatever they wish of the kinds of honours, the highest of which are the love of Allah, attaining His pleasure, and intimacy in His nearness. So the slave's love for his Lord is surrounded by two loves from his Lord: a love before it, through which he became a lover of his Lord, and a love after it, as gratitude from Allah for a love through which he became one of His sincere chosen ones. The greatest means by which the slave earns the love of his Lord, which is the greatest of goals, is to remember Him much, to praise Him, to turn to Him often, to have strong reliance upon Him, to draw near to Him with obligatory and voluntary deeds, to realise sincerity to Him in words and deeds, and to follow the Prophet ﷺ outwardly and inwardly. The Exalted said: ﴾Say, 'If you should love Allah, then follow me, [so] Allah will love you.'﴿".

lesson.ar: أَنْ يُقَدِّمَ الْعَبْدُ مَحَبَّةَ اللَّهِ عَلَى كُلِّ مَحَبَّةٍ وَيَجْعَلَ بَقِيَّةَ الْمَحَابِّ تَبَعًا لَهَا، وَيَسْعَى لِنَيْلِ مَحَبَّتِهِ بِالْإِكْثَارِ مِنْ ذِكْرِهِ، وَالتَّقَرُّبِ إِلَيْهِ بِالْفَرَائِضِ وَالنَّوَافِلِ، وَمُتَابَعَةِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ.
lesson.en: Put your love for Allah before every other love and let all other loves follow it, and seek His love by remembering Him much, drawing near to Him with obligatory and voluntary deeds, and following the Prophet ﷺ.

evidence.text: وَهُوَ الْغَفُورُ الْوَدُودُ

summary.ar:
قَالَ رَحِمَهُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى:
"الْوَكِيلُ: الْمُتَوَلِّي لِتَدْبِيرِ خَلْقِهِ بِعِلْمِهِ وَكَمَالِ قُدْرَتِهِ وَشُمُولِ حِكْمَتِهِ وَالَّذِي تَوَلَّى أَوْلِيَاءَهُ فَيَسَّرَهُمْ لِلْيُسْرَى وَجَنَّبَهُمُ الْعُسْرَى وَكَفَاهُمُ الْأُمُورَ. فَمَنِ أتَّخَذَهُ وَكِيلاً كَفَاهُ. ﴿اللَّهُ وَلِيُّ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا يُخْرِجُهُمْ مِنَ الظُّلُمَاتِ إِلَى النُّورِ﴾".
summary.en:
He (may Allah have mercy on him) said:
"Al-Wakil (the Disposer of Affairs, the Trustee): the One who takes charge of managing His creation by His knowledge, His perfect power and His all-encompassing wisdom; and who has taken His allies under His care, so He eases them towards ease, keeps them away from hardship and suffices them in [their] affairs. So whoever takes Him as a trustee, He suffices him. ﴾Allah is the ally of those who believe. He brings them out from darknesses into the light﴿".

lesson.ar: أَنْ يَتَّخِذَ الْعَبْدُ رَبَّهُ وَكِيلًا فَيَتَوَكَّلَ عَلَيْهِ فِي جَمِيعِ أُمُورِهِ، فَإِنَّ مَنِ اتَّخَذَهُ وَكِيلًا كَفَاهُ.
lesson.en: Take Allah as your Trustee and rely on Him in all your affairs, for whoever takes Him as Trustee, He suffices him.

evidence.text: اللَّهُ خَالِقُ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَكِيلٌ

summary.ar:
قَالَ رَحِمَهُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى: "مِنْ أَسْمَائِهِ تَعَالَى: الْبَرُّ الْوَهَّابُ الْكَرِيمُ الَّذِي شَمِلَ الْكَائِنَاتِ بِأَسْرِهَا بِبِرِّهِ، وَهِبَاتِهِ، وَكَرَمِهِ، فَهُوَ مُولِى الْجَمِيلِ، وَدَائِمُ الْإِحْسَانِ، وَوَاسِعُ الْمَوَاهِبِ، وَصْفُهُ الْبِرُّ وَآثَارُ هَذَا الْوَصْفِ جَمِيعُ النِّعَمِ الظَّاهِرَةِ، وَالْبَاطِنَةِ، فَلَا يَسْتَغْنِي مَخْلُوقٌ عَنْ إِحْسَانِهِ وَبِرِّهِ طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ، وَتَدُلُّ هَذِهِ الْأَسْمَاءُ عَلَى سَعَةِ رَحْمَتِهِ، وَمَوَاهِبِهِ الَّتِي عَمَّ بِهَا جَمِيعَ الْوُجُودِ بِحَسَبِ مَا تَقْتَضِيهِ حِكْمَتُهُ. وَإِحْسَانُهُ عَامٌّ وَخَاصٌّ:
فَالْعَامُّ الْمَذْكُورُ فِي قَوْلِهِ: ﴿رَبَّنَا وَسِعْتَ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ رَحْمَةً وَعِلْماً﴾ وَ ﴿وَرَحْمَتِي وَسِعَتْ كُلَّ شَيْء﴾ ﴿وَمَا بِكُمْ مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ فَمِنَ اللَّهِ﴾.
وَهَذَا يَشْتَرِكُ فِيهِ الْبَرُّ، وَالْفَاجِرُ، وَأَهْلُ السَّمَاءِ، وَأَهْلُ الْأَرْضِ، وَالْمُكَلَّفُونَ، وَغَيْرُهُمْ.
وَالْخَاصُّ: رَحْمَتُهُ وَنِعَمُهُ عَلَى الْمُتَّقِينَ حَيْثُ قَالَ: ﴿فَسَأَكْتُبُهَا لِلَّذِينَ يَتَّقُونَ وَيُؤْتُونَ الزَّكَاةَ وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ بِآياتِنَا يُؤْمِنُونَ الَّذِينَ يَتَّبِعُونَ الرَّسُولَ النَّبِيَّ الأُمِّيَّ﴾ الْآيَةَ.
وَقَالَ: ﴿إِنَّ رَحْمَتَ اللَّهِ قَرِيبٌ مِنَ الْمُحْسِنِينَ﴾.
وَفِي دُعَاءِ سُلَيْمَانَ: ﴿وَأَدْخِلْنِي بِرَحْمَتِكَ فِي عِبَادِكَ الصَّالِحِينَ﴾.
وَهَذِهِ الرَّحْمَةُ الْخَاصَّةُ الَّتِي يَطْلُبُهَا الْأَنْبِيَاءُ وَأَتْبَاعُهُمْ، تَقْتَضِي التَّوْفِيقَ لِلْإِيمَانِ وَالْعِلْمِ وَالْعَمَلِ وَصَلَاحِ الْأَحْوَالِ كُلِّهَا، وَالسَّعَادَةِ الْأَبَدِيَّةِ، وَالْفَلَاحِ، وَالنَّجَاحِ، وَهِيَ الْمَقْصُودُ الْأَعْظَمُ لِخَوَاصِّ الْخَلْقِ.
summary.en:
He (may Allah have mercy on him) said: "Among His names, the Exalted, are: Al-Barr (the Most Kind, the Source of all goodness), Al-Wahhab (the Bestower), Al-Karim (the Most Generous), who has encompassed all created things, in their entirety, with His kindness, His gifts and His generosity. So He is the Granter of beautiful favour, constant in doing good, vast in giving. His description is kindness, and the effects of this description are all the outward and inward blessings, so no created being can do without His goodness and kindness for the blink of an eye. These names indicate the vastness of His mercy and His gifts, with which He has covered all of existence according to what His wisdom requires. His goodness is general and specific:
The general is that mentioned in His saying: ﴾Our Lord, You have encompassed all things in mercy and knowledge﴿ and ﴾But My mercy encompasses all things﴿ ﴾And whatever you have of favour - it is from Allah﴿.
In this the righteous and the wicked, the people of the heaven and the people of the earth, those who are legally responsible and others, all share.
And the specific: His mercy and His blessings upon the pious, where He said: ﴾So I will decree it [especially] for those who fear Me and give zakah and those who believe in Our verses - Those who follow the Messenger, the unlettered prophet﴿ to the end of the verse.
And He said: ﴾Indeed, the mercy of Allah is near to the doers of good﴿.
And in the supplication of Sulayman: ﴾And admit me by Your mercy into [the ranks of] Your righteous servants﴿.
This specific mercy, which the prophets and their followers seek, requires being granted success in faith, knowledge and deeds, the rectification of all states, eternal happiness, prosperity and success; and it is the greatest aim of the elite of creation.

lesson.ar: أَنْ يَسْأَلَ الْعَبْدُ رَبَّهُ الْوَهَّابَ مِنْ هِبَاتِهِ الْخَاصَّةِ الَّتِي يَطْلُبُهَا الْأَنْبِيَاءُ وَأَتْبَاعُهُمْ: التَّوْفِيقِ لِلْإِيمَانِ وَالْعِلْمِ وَالْعَمَلِ وَصَلَاحِ الْأَحْوَالِ كُلِّهَا.
lesson.en: Ask Al-Wahhab for the special gifts the prophets and their followers sought: success in faith, knowledge and good deeds, and the rightness of all your affairs.

evidence.text: وَهَبْ لَنَا مِنْ لَدُنْكَ رَحْمَةً إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْوَهَّابُ

note.ar: سبق الكلام عن هذا الاسم مع اسمه "البر".
note.en: This name has already been discussed together with His name "Al-Barr" (the Source of Goodness).
